<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, interactive-widget=resizes-content">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
<meta name="referrer" content="same-origin">
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; script-src 'sha256-aXQt88T4RGI1T1ieKB4xKh4um+xVdTc6po8+uLpASzs='; style-src 'sha256-9gmtwfWCwK+0zFD9sxD9vLRINT58KqdUtT332X+kfOk='; img-src data: 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; connect-src 'self'">
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64,">
<title>Phone · caracole · Phone</title>
<style>
:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;
  /* The page's four corner radii: marks and code, controls, boxes and sheets, pills. Every stylesheet takes one. */
  --radius-s: 4px;
  --radius-m: 8px;
  --radius-l: 12px;
  --radius-pill: 999px;
  /* A pixel at the text's size, as Android's sp is: 1px at the pages' own size, twice that with the text shown twice as
     large. A zoom of the text alone (the Android app's pinch, the WebView's text zoom; a browser's Zoom text only)
     sizes the text and its line heights, never a length in px or rem: the root's line height, 16px (html, below),
     grows with it, so 1rlh / 16 does (@supports, below). What is sized in it (a song's buttons and chevron, its card's
     tiles, an artist's band) grows with the words beside it, until a song's line fills the window's width: its
     title's least room, a button to play from, its key and its chevron are 192 of them (rows.css, library.css), with
     88px of the page's, an opened card's (card.css) and the line's paddings, borders and gaps, so from there on (past
     about 170 % on a phone 412 px wide) it grows no more, the line one row with its chevron on the screen, and the text
     grows on, its title cut shorter. Never in a font size or a line height, which the zoom sizes already (they would
     grow twice). */
  --sp: 1px;
  --bg: #f6f5f1;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --raised: #f1efea;
  --text: #1d1c1a;
  --muted: #645f57;
  --border: #e3dfd6;
  --border-strong: #cdc7bb;
  /* A glyph's quiet colour (what a song's line holds): below --muted, yet 3:1 or more against every background, as a
     graphic needs (WCAG 1.4.11); never a text's. */
  --faint: #857f74;
  --control-edge: #8d877c;
  --accent: #b4441e;
  --accent-hover: #9a3915;
  --on-accent: #ffffff;
  /* A second accent, an artist's name over their songs: umber, a warm brown of the rust's family, which sits on the
     paper as the buttons do. Contrast 7.0:1 on --raised, 8.0:1 on --surface; in the dark, 7.9:1 and 9.1:1. */
  --artist: #7a4219;
  --focus: #1f6feb;
  --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(31 30 28 / 6%), 0 6px 18px rgb(31 30 28 / 5%);
  /* A song opened in the library, a card over the list, and what is sunk in it (its chips, its tiles' downloads). */
  --card: #faf9f6;
  --sunk: #f3f1ec;
  --card-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(31 30 28 / 12%);
  --found: #1d6b43; --found-bg: #def1e5;
  --wanted: #7a4c00; --wanted-bg: #fbeed2;
  --ignored: #5c5c5c; --ignored-bg: #ebebeb;
  --review: #5b34a8; --review-bg: #ece4fa;
  --auto: #0e5c6e; --auto-bg: #dbf0f5;
  --failed: #a3261b; --failed-bg: #fbe1dd;
  /* How much of --accent washes a song you have fetched, among a search's results (rows.css). */
  --have-tint: 9%;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --bg: #131312;
    --surface: #1c1b1a;
    --raised: #282725;
    --text: #edebe7;
    --muted: #aaa59c;
    --border: #34322f;
    --border-strong: #4b4844;
    --faint: #7d786f;
    --control-edge: #7a756e;
    --accent: #f0895c;
    --accent-hover: #f5a47f;
    --on-accent: #1b0e07;
    --artist: #e3b48a;
    --focus: #6ea8fe;
    --shadow: none;
    --card: #211f1e;
    --sunk: #181716;
    --card-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 28%);
    --found: #83d6a6; --found-bg: #133222;
    --wanted: #f2c46e; --wanted-bg: #36290d;
    --ignored: #b8b8b8; --ignored-bg: #2d2d2d;
    --review: #c6adff; --review-bg: #2b2047;
    --auto: #8fd6e8; --auto-bg: #102f37;
    --failed: #ff9d92; --failed-bg: #3d1713;
    --have-tint: 15%;
  }
}
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; line-height: 16px; }  /* --sp's 16: body sets the text's own */
@supports (height: 1rlh) { :root { --sp: min(calc(1rlh / 16), max(1px, calc((100vw - 88px) / 192))); } }
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font: 16px/1.45 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial,
    "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;
}
a { color: inherit; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
code { font: .9em ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  background: var(--raised); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.page { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 16px 56px; }
.masthead { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px 16px;
  padding: 20px 0 8px; }
.masthead h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.015em; }
.app { margin: 0 0 4px; color: var(--accent); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em;
  line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase; }
.app a { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 0; text-decoration: none; }
@media (hover: hover) { .app a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } }
.app .mark { flex: none; width: auto; height: 1.5em; color: var(--text); }
.links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.navlink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }
.navlink:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.navlink .n { min-width: 22px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent);
  font-size: .78rem; line-height: 22px; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
/* The header of the pages caracole serve writes itself (web/top.py): the logo and the name, which lead home, the page's
   title after them, its links at the end, all one line; a muted line under it for what the page is of. On a phone the
   mark alone leads, a thumb's target. */
.top { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 12px; padding: 14px 0 6px; }
.top .app { display: inline-flex; flex: none; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin: 0; text-decoration: none; }
@media (hover: hover) { .top .app:hover .word { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } }
.top .sep { flex: none; color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1; }
.top h1 { flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 0; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1.25;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.top .links { flex: none; margin-left: auto; }
.top .navlink { padding: 0 14px; font-size: .92rem; }
.top-sub { margin: 0 0 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
/* Which library the page shows (library_name.py): its name after caracole's, muted, behind a thin rule, and the badge
   of a library that isn't the usual one ("Scratch library", "Demo") after it, a pill in --wanted's colours with a
   dashed edge. On a phone, with a badge, the two are a line of their own under the header; with none, the name is in
   the tab's title alone. */
.libname { display: inline-flex; flex: 0 1 auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; margin: 0;
  padding-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border-strong); color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem;
  font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: normal; line-height: 1.3; text-transform: none; }
.libname .name { min-width: 0; max-width: 18em; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.libname .scratch { flex: none; padding: 1px 9px; border: 1px dashed currentColor; border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  color: var(--wanted); background: var(--wanted-bg); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .06em;
  line-height: 1.5; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }
@media (max-width: 559px) {
  .top .app .word, .top .libname:not(:has(.scratch)) { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
  .top .libname { order: 1; flex-basis: 100%; padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .top .app { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; justify-content: center; }
}
.btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 13px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-m); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); font: inherit;
  font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 550; text-decoration: none; overflow-wrap: anywhere; cursor: pointer; }
.btn:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.btn:disabled { color: var(--muted); border-style: dashed; cursor: default; }
.btn.primary { min-height: 44px; background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent);
  font-weight: 650; }
.btn.primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); }
.btn.small { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; font-size: .85rem; }
.badge { padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; }
.badge.found, .badge.done { color: var(--found); background: var(--found-bg); }
.badge.wanted, .badge.queued, .badge.running { color: var(--wanted); background: var(--wanted-bg); }
.badge.ignored { color: var(--ignored); background: var(--ignored-bg); }
.badge.review { color: var(--review); background: var(--review-bg); }
.badge.auto { color: var(--auto); background: var(--auto-bg); }
.badge.failed { color: var(--failed); background: var(--failed-bg); }
.f { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; }
.f em { font-style: normal; font-weight: 500; }
.f input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-m); border: 1px solid var(--control-edge);
  background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; }
.f input:focus { border-color: var(--focus); outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 30%, transparent); }
.footer { margin-top: 40px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; }
.visually-hidden { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
@media (min-width: 720px) {
  .page { padding: 0 24px 64px; }
  .masthead { padding-top: 32px; }
  .masthead h1 { font-size: 2.1rem; }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .btn, .btn.small { min-height: 44px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .btn, .navlink { transition: background-color .12s, border-color .12s; }
}

.picker { min-width: 0; }
.picker > summary ~ * { margin-top: 8px; }
.picker > summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; list-style: none;
  cursor: pointer; }
.picker > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.picker > summary:not(.btn) { min-height: 32px; color: var(--review); font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 650; }
.picker > summary:not(.btn)::before { content: "›"; display: inline-block; width: 1em; font-size: 1.15rem;
  line-height: 1; text-align: center; }
.picker[open] > summary:not(.btn)::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.picker > summary.btn { border-color: var(--review); color: var(--review); background: var(--review-bg); }
.picker-n { margin-left: .35em; font-weight: 500; }
.pick-form { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; }
.choices { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; list-style: none; }
.choices legend { margin: 0 0 6px; padding: 0; font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 650; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.choice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 8px 4px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-l); background: var(--raised); }
.choice:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--accent); }
.choice-pick { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; }
label.choice-pick { cursor: pointer; }
.choice-pick input { flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.choice-text { display: grid; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 0; }
.choice-name { font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.choice-why { color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.choice-link { flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-m); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); font-size: .82rem;
  font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }
.choice-link:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.pick-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 20px; }
.pick-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer; }
.pick-check input { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.pick-hint { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; }
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .picker > summary:not(.btn), .choice-link { min-height: 44px; }
}

/* Until the page's scripts have drawn it (drawn.js), it waits unseen: painted before, as a slow machine may paint it,
   its list would be empty, the request form open under the bar and the library shown though you left the Songbooks
   tab open, and all of it would move once they have run. Should they never get that far, it shows after two seconds;
   with no script at all, at once. */
@media (scripting: enabled) {
  body.drawing .page { visibility: hidden; animation: drawn 0s 2s forwards; }
}
@keyframes drawn { to { visibility: visible; } }
.summary { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
/* The library's header, one line: caracole, the tabs (Library, Songbooks and, served, Requests), and what needs
   attention (wanted songs) at its end. Placed by area, so that a number changing its width (a tab's count) moves
   nothing; on a phone the numbers, when there are any, are a line of their own. */
.masthead.lib { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-areas: "app name tabs sum"; align-items: center; gap: 4px 14px; padding: 12px 0 0; }
.masthead.lib .app { grid-area: app; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; }
/* The library's name, and a badge for one that isn't the usual library (base.css's .libname): on a phone, the badge a
   small pill in the tab row, before the tabs, its name left to the tab's title; with no badge, the name in the tab's
   title alone. */
.masthead.lib .libname { grid-area: name; }
@media (max-width: 719px) {
  .masthead.lib { grid-template-columns: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "app name tabs" "sum sum sum";
    gap: 4px 8px; }
  .masthead.lib .libname { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
  .masthead.lib .libname:has(.scratch) { position: static; justify-self: start; width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0;
    padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; overflow: visible; clip: auto; }
  .masthead.lib .libname:has(.scratch) .name { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
  .masthead.lib .libname .scratch { font-size: .62rem; padding: 0 6px; line-height: 1.6; }
}
.masthead.lib .tabs { grid-area: tabs; min-width: 0; margin: 0; border-bottom: 0; }
/* On a phone each tab is a thumb's (library-screens.css, 48 px) and a row too wide for the page scrolls sideways by
   itself, never the page (tabs.js keeps the chosen tab in its view). */
@media (max-width: 719px) {
  .masthead.lib .tabs { gap: 0; overflow: auto hidden; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scrollbar-width: none;
    padding-bottom: 1px; }  /* room for the chosen tab's line, which hangs 1px below the row */
  .masthead.lib .tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .masthead.lib .tab { padding: 0 10px; font-size: .9rem; gap: 4px; }
}
.masthead.lib .summary { grid-area: sum; justify-self: end; gap: 8px; margin: 0; }
.masthead.lib .summary:empty { display: none; }
/* The page's tabs, in the masthead (tabs.js): each shows its panel; a count beside its name (songbooks, requests that
   wait or run), none when there are none. */
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin: 2px 0 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.tab { display: inline-flex; flex: none; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 36px; margin-bottom: -1px;
  padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; background: none; color: var(--muted); font: inherit;
  font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; }
.tab:hover { color: var(--text); }
.tab[aria-selected="true"] { border-bottom-color: var(--accent); color: var(--text); }
.tab .n { min-width: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--raised); color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .75rem; line-height: 20px; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tab .n:empty { display: none; }
.stat { padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--raised); color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.stat b { color: var(--text); font-weight: 650; }
.request { margin: 8px 0 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-l); background: var(--surface); }
.request > summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 650; list-style: none; }
.request > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.plus { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: calc(26 * var(--sp)); height: calc(26 * var(--sp)); border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1; }
.plus span { display: inline-block; }
.request[open] > summary .plus span { transform: rotate(45deg); }  /* the + turns into a ×, the square stays */
.request-form { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 0 16px 16px; }
.fields { display: grid; gap: 12px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr)); }
.request-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 20px; }
.check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
.check input { width: calc(20 * var(--sp)); height: calc(20 * var(--sp)); margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.hint { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; }
/* Kept at the top, side to side across the page, with an edge once the page scrolls under it (.stuck). Its height,
   --bar-h (library.js measures it: 0px until then), is where what sticks under it sticks, and what a jump to a line
   leaves above it (library-screens.css). */
:root { --bar-h: 0px; }
.searchbar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2; margin: 0 -16px; padding: 10px 16px 8px; background: var(--bg); }
.searchbar.stuck { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--border-strong), 0 8px 16px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 35%); }
.bar-edge { height: 0; }
.field { position: relative; }
.field input {
  width: 100%; height: calc(46 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-l); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none;
}
.field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; }
.field input:not(:placeholder-shown) { padding-right: calc(48 * var(--sp)); }  /* room for the clear button */
.field input::-webkit-search-cancel-button { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; }
.field input:focus { border-color: var(--focus); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 30%, transparent); }
.clear { position: absolute; top: 1px; right: 1px; width: calc(44 * var(--sp)); height: calc(44 * var(--sp)); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-l);
  background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; }
/* Searching (body.search-mode): the ← at the box's left that leaves the search, the text typed after it. */
.leave { position: absolute; top: 1px; left: 1px; width: calc(44 * var(--sp)); height: calc(44 * var(--sp)); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-l);
  background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; }
.field:has(> .leave:not([hidden])) input { padding-left: calc(44 * var(--sp)); }
/* On a phone, search takes the screen: the logo and tabs slide away (--mast-h measured by searchMode before the class
   goes on), hidden once gone so no tab is reachable behind the bar. */
@media (max-width: 719px) {
  body.search-mode .masthead.lib { margin-top: calc(-1 * var(--mast-h, 0px)); visibility: hidden; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .masthead.lib { transition: margin-top .2s ease, visibility 0s linear 0s; }
  body.search-mode .masthead.lib { transition: margin-top .2s ease, visibility 0s linear .2s; }
}
.bar-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.bar-row .field { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
/* One line, its height kept: what typing and Enter do, or how the search of the sites goes. */

/* A card's head (cardHead): its name, artist and close button. In place it takes no room and sticks under the bar

   top, .card-top: out of the flow, at the top of the card's content); else the line says it all. One line, cut

.card-close { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: calc(44 * var(--sp)); height: calc(44 * var(--sp)); padding: 0; border: 0;

.tool.on > .glyph { color: var(--accent); }
.filter-n { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: calc(20 * var(--sp)); height: calc(20 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 6px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: .74rem; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.clear-filters, .clear-all { min-height: calc(32 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 6px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-m); background: none;

.fsec + .fsec { margin-top: 14px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }

.fhead { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2px 8px;
  margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .09em;
  text-transform: uppercase; }

  background: var(--bg); }

  min-width: 0; min-height: calc(30 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 6px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-m); background: none; color: var(--muted);
  font: inherit; font-size: .84rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; }

.seg [aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--seg-on); color: var(--text);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 8%); }
.seg .n, .fchip .n { color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

  var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: inherit;
  font-size: .84rem; font-weight: 550; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; }

.fchip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.fchip[aria-pressed="true"] .n, .fchip[aria-pressed="true"] .glyph { color: var(--accent); }
.fchip:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }
/* The twelve tonics, by the circle of fifths: one with no song in the mode chosen dashed. */
.tonics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 5px; margin-top: 8px; }
.tonics button { min-height: calc(32 * var(--sp)); padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: .84rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; }
.tonics button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }

  padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }

.filter-panel .show-n, .filter-panel:modal .live { display: none; }
.filter-panel:modal .show-n { display: inline-flex; }
@media (max-width: 719px) {
  .masthead.lib .summary { justify-self: start; }
  .masthead.lib .app .word { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }
  .masthead.lib .tab .n { min-width: calc(16 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 4px; }
  .tools { gap: 6px; }
  /* Icons alone beside the search, a thumb's worth each: the words are there for a screen reader, and Filter keeps the
     number of its filters on. */
  .bar-row .tool { justify-content: center; min-width: calc(44 * var(--sp)); min-height: calc(44 * var(--sp)); padding: 0; font-size: 0; }
  /* Sort's orders keep their words: the browser draws its menu in its options' own font, which they would inherit
     at 0 px (a menu of empty rows), and indents them by the menu's padding. */
  .bar-row .tool-menu select.tool { width: calc(44 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 calc(12 * var(--sp)); }
  .bar-row .tool-menu option { font-size: .88rem; }
  .bar-row .tool-menu .glyph { left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }
  .bar-row .tool .filter-n { position: absolute; top: calc(-5 * var(--sp)); right: calc(-5 * var(--sp)); font-size: .7rem; }

}
/* A thumb's targets: every control of the toolbar and of the panel. */
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .tool, .bar-row .tool, .tag, .clear-filters, .clear-all, .fchip, .tonics button { min-height: calc(44 * var(--sp)); }
  .seg [role="radio"] { min-height: calc(44 * var(--sp)); }

@keyframes dim-in { from { opacity: 0; } }

.actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.read-page { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; margin: 6px 0 0; }

@media (pointer: coarse) { .read-page .btn { min-height: 44px; } }
.actions form { margin: 0; }
.subhead { margin: 2px 0 -2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase; }
.source { flex: none; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: calc(16 * var(--sp)); height: calc(16 * var(--sp));
  border-radius: var(--radius-s); vertical-align: calc(-3 * var(--sp)); }
/* A site with no icon (yet), or no site: a badge a little bigger than an icon, so its letters read. */

  border-radius: var(--radius-s); background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: -.02em; line-height: 1; vertical-align: calc(-5 * var(--sp)); }

.btn.sourced { gap: 7px; }

/* An artist's name that searches for them: a button, the name alone, underlined under the pointer. */
button.artist { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0;
  background: none; color: var(--muted); font: inherit; font-size: .9rem; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.artist-name { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

/* A title that opens the sheet: the heading as it was, underlined under the pointer. */

.title-link:hover > h2 { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

   which fills the title's cell; underlined under the pointer and at the keyboard's focus. */

.title-get { flex: 1 1 auto; display: block; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; line-height: inherit; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; cursor: pointer; }

  text-underline-offset: 3px; }

  grid-template-areas: "src title act act" ". sub sub more"; align-items: center; gap: 2px 10px;
  min-width: 0; padding: 8px 10px 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); scroll-margin-top: 84px; }
.row:first-child { border-top: 0; }

.row-title { grid-area: title; min-width: 0; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; font-size: .98rem; font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.3; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
/* A row's title link fills its line: as easy to hit as the button beside it. */
.row > .title-link { grid-area: title; display: flex; align-items: center; align-self: stretch; width: auto;
  min-width: 0; }

  gap: 4px 6px; min-width: 0; margin: 0 0 0 auto; color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; }
.row-key { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.row-action form { margin: 0; }
.row .btn { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 11px; font-size: .85rem; }
/* A request's line: a line of the row's own, under the title, the artist and the button (a lookup's steps under it,
   steps.css's). */
.row > .progress { grid-column: 2 / -1; font-size: .85rem; }
.row-more { grid-area: more; justify-self: end; display: grid; place-items: center; width: var(--row-more); height: 30px;
  padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-m); background: transparent; color: var(--muted);
  font: inherit; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; }
.row-more:hover, .row-more[aria-expanded="true"] { border-color: var(--border); background: var(--raised);
  color: var(--text); }

.row-panel .note { margin: 0; }
.row-group .subhead { margin: 4px 0 6px; }

.versions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .row { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 14rem) 9.5rem var(--row-more);
    grid-template-areas: "src title artist meta act more"; padding: 3px 10px 3px 12px; }
  .row-sub { display: contents; }
  .row-artist { grid-area: artist; justify-self: start; max-width: 100%; }
  .row-meta { grid-area: meta; margin: 0; }
  .row .btn { min-height: 30px; }
  .row-more { height: 28px; }
}
/* A dense list's line (resultRow's ``dense``): one row, its title and right after it a button for each thing a song of
   yours holds to play from (card.js plays), then its action, its key and its chevron; on a phone under it its status

   720px all of it on one row, every column but the title's as wide on every line (the action's as wide as it is,
   before the key), so that the keys and the chevrons line up. Its action is a word or a glyph in the accent's colour,

.dl svg.glyph { flex: none; width: calc(13 * var(--sp)); height: calc(13 * var(--sp)); }

/* A tile's drawer, opened from its chevron, right under it, touching it (the tiles' gap taken back), as wide: its
   downloads, then a part a source of its versions (its head, a row a version), its ✕ at its top right. */
.drawer { position: relative; margin-top: calc(-8 * var(--sp)); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-l, 12px) var(--radius-l, 12px); background: var(--surface); }
/* Its downloads, a row, wrapped where they don't fit: the ✕'s room is kept on the rows beside it alone, by a float
   as tall as the ✕ reaches (a flex row would keep it on every row). */
.drawer-files { display: flow-root; padding: 8px 0 8px 12px; }  /* the ✕'s float kept inside it */
.drawer-files::before { content: ""; float: right; width: calc(34 * var(--sp)); height: calc(29 * var(--sp)); }
.drawer-files > * { margin: 2px 14px 2px 0; vertical-align: middle; }
.drawer-files .lead { display: inline-block; color: var(--muted); font-size: .76rem; font-weight: 650; }
.drawer-part + .drawer-part, .drawer-files + .drawer-part { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.drawer-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 10px; min-height: calc(46 * var(--sp));
  padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.drawer-close + .drawer-part > .drawer-head { padding-right: calc(48 * var(--sp)); }  /* room for the ✕ */
.drawer-what { margin: 0; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 600; }
.drawer-said { color: var(--muted); font-size: .84rem; }
.drawer-head form { margin: 0; }
.drawer-head .pin-note { flex: 1 1 100%; margin: 0; color: var(--review); font-size: .84rem; }
.drawer-close { position: absolute; top: calc(7 * var(--sp)); right: calc(8 * var(--sp)); z-index: 1; display: grid; place-items: center;
  width: calc(30 * var(--sp)); height: calc(30 * var(--sp)); margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-m, 8px); background: transparent;
  color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; }
.drawer-close:hover { border-color: var(--border); background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); }
.drawer-close svg.glyph { width: calc(18 * var(--sp)); height: calc(18 * var(--sp)); }
.vrows { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.vrow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "ver stars" "note note" "act act";
  align-items: center; gap: 4px 12px; min-height: calc(46 * var(--sp)); padding: 8px 12px; }
.vrow + .vrow { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.vrow .ver { grid-area: ver; font-weight: 600; }
.vrow .stars { grid-area: stars; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.vrow .stars .new { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 650; }
.vrow .stars b { color: var(--wanted); font-weight: 650; }
.vrow .note { grid-area: note; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .84rem; }
.vrow .note b { color: var(--found); font-weight: 600; }
.vrow .note .dl { margin-right: 14px; }
.vrow .note:empty { display: none; }
.vbtns { grid-area: act; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.vbtns form { margin: 0; }
.vrow .btn { min-height: calc(30 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 11px; border-radius: var(--radius-m, 8px); font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 600; }
.vrow .btn.go { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent); background: transparent;
  color: var(--accent); }
.inuse { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: calc(5 * var(--sp)); min-height: calc(30 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-m, 8px);
  background: var(--found-bg); color: var(--found); font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; }
.inuse svg.glyph { width: calc(14 * var(--sp)); height: calc(14 * var(--sp)); }
.vrow.cur { background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--found) 9%, transparent), transparent 60%); }
.vrow.gone .ver { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
.drawer-rest { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; padding: 10px 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; }
.drawer-rest form { margin: 0; }
/* A card under 560 px (a phone's, the laptop's pane): a version's number and rating, its note under them, its
   buttons under that; a part's source's mark beside what it lists, its counts under that. Wider, one row each. */
@container tiles (max-width: 34.9375rlh) {
  .drawer-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 2px 10px; }
  .drawer-head > :not(.source):not(.drawer-what) { grid-column: 2; justify-self: start; }
}
@container tiles (min-width: 35rlh) {
  .vrow { grid-template-columns: calc(88 * var(--sp)) calc(152 * var(--sp)) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; grid-template-areas: "ver stars note act"; }
  .vrow .note { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .vbtns { justify-content: flex-end; }
}

/* Which sites have it (card.js sitesOf): its label, then a mark a site, as a search's line shows a site's song's. */
.card-sites { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 12px; }
.card-sites .card-label { margin: 0; }

/* Its progressions: chips with a search's mark, which find your songs that play one, unlike a file or an action. */
.progs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.prog { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: calc(7 * var(--sp)); min-height: calc(32 * var(--sp)); margin: 0; padding: 0 12px 0 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: var(--sunk); color: var(--text); font: inherit;
  font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 550; cursor: pointer; }
.prog:hover { border-color: var(--control-edge); }
.prog svg.glyph { flex: none; width: calc(14 * var(--sp)); height: calc(14 * var(--sp)); color: var(--artist); }
.prog-text { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.prog { max-width: calc(256 * var(--sp)); }
.progs-more { min-height: calc(32 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 11px; border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: none; color: var(--muted);
  font: inherit; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; }
.progs-more:hover { color: var(--text); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
.find-elsewhere { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.find-elsewhere .card-label { margin: 0; }
.find-elsewhere .subhead { margin: 0 0 4px; }

/* Its foot: what changes the song, then at the far end info.json, quiet, and Remove, red from the start but outlined,
   never the main thing to do. */
.foot { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.foot form { margin: 0; }
.foot .btn svg.glyph { flex: none; width: calc(16 * var(--sp)); height: calc(16 * var(--sp)); margin-right: calc(7 * var(--sp)); color: var(--muted); }
/* "⋯", at the foot's far end: info.json and Remove, in a menu that opens upward over the card. */
.foot-more { position: relative; margin-left: auto; }
.foot-more > summary { list-style: none; }
.foot-more > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.foot-more-btn { min-width: calc(38 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 10px; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--muted); }
.foot-more[open] > .foot-more-btn { border-color: var(--control-edge); background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); }
.foot-menu { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: calc(100% + 6px); z-index: 3; display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: calc(200 * var(--sp));
  padding: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-l, 12px); background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow: var(--pop-shadow); }
.foot-menu form { margin: 0; }
.foot-menu .btn, .foot-menu .info-file { justify-content: flex-start; width: 100%; }
.info-file { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: calc(36 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 6px; }
.info-file svg.glyph { width: calc(15 * var(--sp)); height: calc(15 * var(--sp)); margin-right: calc(4 * var(--sp)); }
.btn.remove { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--failed) 45%, transparent); background: transparent;
  color: var(--failed); }
.btn.remove svg.glyph { color: var(--failed); }
.btn.remove:hover { border-color: var(--failed); background: var(--failed-bg); }

/* A thumb's targets: every chevron, link, download, button and close of the card, 44 px; a tile 58 px tall (each in the
   text's pixels, --sp). */
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .dl, .prog, .vrow .btn, .inuse, .info-file, .progs-more, a.tile-source { min-height: calc(44 * var(--sp)); }
  .foot-more-btn { min-width: calc(44 * var(--sp)); }
  .dl { min-width: calc(44 * var(--sp)); justify-content: center; }
  .tile-open { padding: calc(9 * var(--sp)) calc(4 * var(--sp)) calc(9 * var(--sp)) calc(10 * var(--sp)); }
  .tile-ico { width: calc(38 * var(--sp)); height: calc(38 * var(--sp)); border-radius: var(--radius-m, 8px); }
  .tile-more { width: calc(44 * var(--sp)); height: calc(44 * var(--sp)); }
  .drawer-close + .drawer-part > .drawer-head { padding-right: calc(60 * var(--sp)); }
  .drawer-files { padding-top: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }  /* its first row level with the ✕ */
  .drawer-files::before { width: calc(46 * var(--sp)); height: calc(46 * var(--sp)); }
  .drawer-close { top: calc(2 * var(--sp)); width: calc(44 * var(--sp)); height: calc(44 * var(--sp)); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .tile-more svg.glyph { transition: transform .15s; }
}

/* A song's line's buttons (card.js plays) */
/* What a song of yours holds to play from, a button each right after its title (card.js plays): an icon tile, no
   words. Its instrument's glyph in the accent (an auto sheet's in its own colour), the marks of the sites its versions
   came from at its foot and the count at its corner. With a mouse a 30 px tile, on a touch screen a 48 px one, each in
   the text's pixels (base.css --sp), so a tile grows as the words beside it do; its count's digits centred by the
   grid, never by a line height, which the text's zoom sizes past where --sp stops. The buttons take what the title needs of the row but 4rem, and wrap to
   a second row of their own where more won't fit: a long title is cut short first. */
.line-plays { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: calc(6 * var(--sp)); padding: 0; }
.play { --mark-size: calc(11 * var(--sp)); position: relative; flex: none; display: inline-grid; place-items: center;
  width: calc(30 * var(--sp)); height: calc(30 * var(--sp)); padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-m, 8px); background: var(--raised);
  color: var(--text); font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; }
.play:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, var(--raised)); }
.play svg.glyph { flex: none; width: calc(18 * var(--sp)); height: calc(18 * var(--sp)); color: var(--accent); }
.play.auto svg.glyph { color: var(--auto); }
.play .n { position: absolute; top: calc(1 * var(--sp)); right: calc(1 * var(--sp)); display: grid; place-items: center;
  min-width: var(--mark-size); height: var(--mark-size); padding: 0 calc(2 * var(--sp));
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: var(--raised); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text); margin: 0; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1;
  text-align: center; }
.play .marks { display: flex; position: absolute; right: calc(1 * var(--sp)); bottom: calc(1 * var(--sp)); gap: calc(1 * var(--sp)); }
.play .marks > .source { width: auto; min-width: var(--mark-size); height: var(--mark-size); padding: 0 calc(1 * var(--sp));
  border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-s, 4px); background: var(--raised); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--surface);
  font-size: 6px; line-height: 11px; vertical-align: 0; }
.play .marks > img.source { width: var(--mark-size); padding: calc(1 * var(--sp)); }
/* While a filter of instruments is on, each line's button of one that is on (card.js plays, its ``data-inst``) is
   filled with the accent, its glyph in the accent's text colour. */
[data-lit~="sheet"] .line-plays .play[data-inst~="sheet"],
[data-lit~="guitar"] .line-plays .play[data-inst~="guitar"],
[data-lit~="ukulele"] .line-plays .play[data-inst~="ukulele"],
[data-lit~="harmonica"] .line-plays .play[data-inst~="harmonica"],
[data-lit~="score"] .line-plays .play[data-inst~="score"] { background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--on-accent); }
[data-lit~="sheet"] .line-plays .play[data-inst~="sheet"] :is(svg.glyph),
[data-lit~="guitar"] .line-plays .play[data-inst~="guitar"] :is(svg.glyph),
[data-lit~="ukulele"] .line-plays .play[data-inst~="ukulele"] :is(svg.glyph),
[data-lit~="harmonica"] .line-plays .play[data-inst~="harmonica"] :is(svg.glyph),
[data-lit~="score"] .line-plays .play[data-inst~="score"] :is(svg.glyph) { color: inherit; }
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  /* A play button a thumb's 48 px tile, 8 px from the next; its count and its sites' marks (letters at 8 px) inside
     its corners. */
  .line-plays { gap: calc(8 * var(--sp)); }
  .play { --mark-size: calc(16 * var(--sp)); width: calc(48 * var(--sp)); height: calc(48 * var(--sp)); border-radius: var(--radius-l, 12px); }
  .play svg.glyph { width: calc(24 * var(--sp)); height: calc(24 * var(--sp)); }
  .play .n { top: calc(3 * var(--sp)); right: calc(3 * var(--sp)); padding: 0 calc(3 * var(--sp)); font-size: 10px; }
  .play .marks { right: calc(3 * var(--sp)); bottom: calc(3 * var(--sp)); gap: calc(2 * var(--sp)); }
  .play .marks > .source { min-width: var(--mark-size); height: var(--mark-size); padding: 0 calc(2 * var(--sp)); font-size: 8px;
    line-height: 16px; }
  .play .marks > img.source { width: var(--mark-size); padding: calc(1 * var(--sp)); }
}

/* A request's steps (web/outcome.py's). On the library page, a song's line, or a search result's row, while its lookup
   runs: its request line is a bar of them in one row (library.js showLine, ``barred``), a segment a step
   (``.step-segs``, for the eye alone), then the step in hand, its site and its place, "Sheet · Ultimate Guitar · 3 of
   7". Those done, and a plain one (over and no failure, "Match: not on UG"), in the accent; the one that runs at half,
   pulsing where motion is welcome; those to come grey; a skipped one, with nothing to do for the song, an outline; a
   failed one red and taller, its "!" in it. The segments' ends are square.
   Under the line (library.js drawSteps, ``.steps``): once its lookup ended otherwise than Ready, that bar as it left
   them, frozen (``.step-bar``), with the step that failed first; and the list of them (``.step-list``, library.js
   stepList), which shows while the song's card is open, in the frozen bar's place, the bar of a lookup that runs
   staying on the line's row above it: a line a step, its mark (done and plain ✓, running ◐, waiting ○, skipped –,
   failed !), its name and its site, and what it found, quieter; once over, the skipped ones folded into one last line.
   The Requests tab draws the same list (requests.js, through stepList) for the request that runs and every finished
   one. A step's name is bold, the site it names after it: "Sheet · LaCuerda". */
.progress.barred, .step-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted);
  font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }
.progress.barred::before { content: none; }  /* the line's dot: the bar says it runs */
.step-bar { font-size: .85rem; }
.step-segs { display: flex; flex: none; align-items: center; gap: 3px; width: 112px; }
/* Each one, kept under .step-segs: filter.css's .seg is the Filter panel's segmented control. */
.step-segs > .seg { display: block; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; height: 6px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0;
  background: var(--border-strong); }
.step-segs > .seg.done, .step-segs > .seg.plain { background: var(--accent); }
.step-segs > .seg.running { background: var(--accent); opacity: .5; }
.step-segs > .seg.skipped { background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--control-edge); }
.step-segs > .seg.failed { height: 12px; background: var(--failed); color: var(--surface); font-size: 10px;
  font-style: normal; font-weight: 800; line-height: 12px; text-align: center; }
.step-at { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.step-at b { color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; }
.step-count { flex: none; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .step-segs > .seg.running { animation: step-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes step-pulse { 50% { opacity: .2; } }
}
/* Under the line, across it, as its request line is; nothing shown (the line the bar, its card closed), no room taken.
   Its card open, the list in the frozen bar's place; its card in the laptop's pane (.selected), the list there, under
   the card's head (library.css), and the frozen bar here. */
.line > .steps { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 3px 0 4px; }
.row > .steps { grid-column: 2 / -1; margin: 3px 0 2px; }
.steps:not(:has(> .step-bar)), .steps > .step-list { display: none; }
.line:not(.selected):has(> .line-more[aria-expanded="true"]) > .steps { display: block; }
.line:not(.selected):has(> .line-more[aria-expanded="true"]) > .steps > .step-list { display: grid; }
.line:not(.selected):has(> .line-more[aria-expanded="true"]) > .steps > .step-bar { display: none; }
.step-list { gap: 2px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-size: .85rem; }
/* A step's line: its mark hanging in the margin, its name whole, what it found beside it (on a phone, under it). */
.step { position: relative; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 0 8px; min-width: 0;
  padding-left: calc(1.1em + 8px); }
.step-glyph { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 1.1em; text-align: center; }
.step.done .step-glyph, .step.plain .step-glyph, .step.running .step-glyph { color: var(--accent); }
.step.failed .step-glyph { color: var(--failed); }
.step.waiting, .step.skipped, .step.skipped-all { color: var(--muted); }
.step.running { font-weight: 600; }
.step-name b { font-weight: 600; }
.step-found { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
@media (max-width: 719px) { .step-found { flex-basis: 100%; } }
/* A request that waits: Cancel beside its place (library.js cancelButton), a text button as the removal's Undo. */
.progress .cancel { min-height: 32px; margin: 0; padding: 0 6px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 2px; cursor: pointer; }
.progress .cancel:hover { background: var(--raised); }
.progress .cancel:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }
@media (pointer: coarse) { .progress .cancel { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px;  } }
.list section.artist, .list .line, .requested .line { scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--bar-h) + 8px); }  /* below the
   bar kept at the top (--bar-h: library.css) */
@media (min-width: 720px) {
  .jump { flex-wrap: wrap; overflow: visible; }
  .searchbar { margin: 0 -24px; padding: 12px 24px 8px; }
  .masthead.lib { padding-top: 18px; }
}
/* A thumb's targets: the tabs, the letters and "+ N more" (the toolbar's and the Filter panel's are filter.css's).
   Every .btn has its 44 px from BASE_STYLE, and a line's, its chevron and an artist's name theirs from ROWS_STYLE. */
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .tab { min-height: 48px; }
  .btn.more-by { min-height: 44px; }
  .tab { min-width: 44px; justify-content: center; }  /* Sites, the shortest name */
  .progress .undo { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; }
  .jump button { min-width: 44px; height: 44px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .plus span { transition: transform .15s; }
  .progress[data-tone="running"]::before { animation: pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
}
@keyframes pulse { 50% { opacity: .25; } }
/* The Songbooks tab: the songbooks as lines, then the one opened as a set list; side by side from 900px, and on a
   phone one at a time, the set list with its way back to the list. */
.books { padding-top: 10px; }
.books-in { display: grid; gap: 12px; align-items: start; }
@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .books-in { grid-template-columns: minmax(13rem, 18rem) minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .book-back { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 899px) {
  .books-in.has-book > .book-list { display: none; }
  .book-back { justify-self: start; margin: 0 0 6px -4px; }
}
.book-list { display: grid; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.book-lines { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-l);
  background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow: hidden; }
.book-lines > li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.book-line { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; margin: 0; padding: 4px 12px; border: 0; background: none;
  color: var(--text); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
button.book-line:hover { background: var(--raised); }
.book-line[aria-current="true"] { background: var(--raised); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.book-name { font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.3; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.book-meta { color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; line-height: 1.35; }
.book-line.gone .book-name { color: var(--muted); }
.new-book { justify-self: start; }
.sb-error { margin: 0; color: var(--failed); font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.book { display: grid; min-width: 0; padding: 10px 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-l);
  background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.book-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 2px 12px; }
.book-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.3; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.book-head h2:focus { outline: none; }
.book-head .book-meta { font-size: .85rem; }
.book.gone { align-content: start; }  /* kept as tall as it was: nothing under it moves */
.book.gone h2 { color: var(--muted); }

/* The sync (sync.js): on caracole serve's page the Sync tab, the last, its three panels side by side from 960px
   (Sync with a server, Export, Import a file), and on both devices the sheet it runs in, a dialog over the page dimmed:
   from 720px a box in the middle, on a phone a sheet from the bottom. The sheet's four views: what to sync (three
   parts, each with what waits in it), a card for each conflict (each side's version, the two buttons named for the
   sides), the sync on its way, and what it did, a section a kind of change, each closed, a coloured arrow the way it
   went. Its colours: green taken, blue given, orange both, yellow songbooks, purple indexes; a number up green, down
   red, each with its sign, never a colour alone. */
:root {
  --sync-take: #1d6b43; --sync-give: #1f5fbf; --sync-both: #9a5300; --sync-book: #7a6200; --sync-index: #6b3fb5;
  --sync-take-bg: #e3f2e8; --sync-give-bg: #e2ecfb; --sync-both-bg: #fbecd9;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --sync-take: #8fd18f; --sync-give: #8fb8ef; --sync-both: #f0b061; --sync-book: #e7d27a; --sync-index: #c9a7ef;
    --sync-take-bg: #1d2a1d; --sync-give-bg: #1a2230; --sync-both-bg: #2a2113;
  }
}
/* caracole serve's tab bar, the one with a Sync tab (the phone's and a page written to the library stay one row,
   unsplit, at any width), from 720px: Library and Songbooks on the left, Sites, Requests and Sync on the right. The
   Requests count, which comes and goes as requests wait or run, keeps its room, so that no tab beside it moves with
   it: Sites and Requests, aligned on the right, and on a phone's width Sync, after it. */
@media (min-width: 720px) {
  .masthead.lib:has(#tab-sync) { grid-template-columns: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }
  .masthead.lib .tabs:has(#tab-sync) #tab-sites { margin-inline-start: auto; }
}
.masthead.lib .tabs:has(#tab-sync) #tab-requests .n:empty { display: inline-block; visibility: hidden; }
[data-icon] { display: inline-flex; flex: none; }
[data-icon] svg, .sync-lane svg, .sync-pair svg, .sync-side-head svg, .sync-dev svg { width: 100%; height: 100%;
  fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
[data-icon] .dot, .sync-side-head .dot, .sync-pair .dot, .sync-dev .dot { fill: currentColor; stroke: none; }

/* --- the tab's three panels ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.sync { padding-top: 12px; }
.sync-panels { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .sync-panels { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); align-items: stretch; }
}
.sync-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; padding: 14px 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-l); background: var(--surface); }
.sync-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }
.sync-panel-head [data-icon] { width: 22px; height: 22px; color: var(--accent); }
.sync-panel-said, .sync-last { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-last:empty, .sync-tested:empty { display: none; }
.sync-panel-go { display: flex; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 4px; }
.sync-with { margin: 0; }
.sync-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.sync-row input { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  border: 1px solid var(--control-edge); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: .95rem; }
.sync-row input:focus { border-color: var(--focus); outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 30%, transparent); }
.sync-row .btn { flex: none; min-height: 44px; }
.sync-tested { margin: 0; font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-tested[data-tone="done"] { color: var(--found); }
.sync-tested[data-tone="failed"] { color: var(--failed); }
.sync-tested[data-tone="running"] { color: var(--muted); }
label.btn { cursor: pointer; }
.sync .btn.primary:disabled, .sync-sheet .btn.primary:disabled { border-color: var(--control-edge);
  background: var(--raised); color: var(--muted); }

/* --- the sheet ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.sync-sheet { width: min(580px, calc(100vw - 32px)); max-width: none; max-height: calc(100% - 48px); margin: auto;
  padding: 18px 20px 16px; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-l); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--card-shadow); }
.sync-sheet[open] { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.sync-sheet::backdrop { background: rgb(0 0 0 / 45%); }
.sync-sheet .grab { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 719px) {
  .sync-sheet { position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0; width: 100%; max-height: calc(100% - 24px); margin: 0;
    padding: 8px 16px calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border-width: 1px 0 0; border-radius: var(--radius-l) var(--radius-l) 0 0;
    box-shadow: 0 -16px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%); }
  .sync-sheet .grab { display: block; flex: none; width: 40px; height: 4px; margin: 0 auto 2px; border-radius: var(--radius-s);
    background: var(--border-strong); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) and (max-width: 719px) {
  .sync-sheet[open] { animation: sheet-up .22s ease-out; }
}
.sync-top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; }
.sync-check { width: 24px; height: 24px; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--sync-take); }
.sync-heads { min-width: 0; }
.sync-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.12rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-title .sync-name { color: var(--accent); }
.sync-sub { margin: 2px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .86rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-sub:empty { display: none; }
.sync-sheet:has(#sync-done:not([hidden])) .sync-title { font-weight: 450; }
.sync-title .sync-name { font-weight: 700; }
/* Where it is: Compared, Your choice, then each part synced. */
.sync-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.sync-chips li { padding: 2px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; }
.sync-chips li[data-state="done"] { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sync-take) 55%, transparent);
  background: var(--sync-take-bg); color: var(--sync-take); }
.sync-chips li[data-state="now"] { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
/* What it does, as git's status would count it: ↓ to take, ↑ to give, ⚠ changed on both. */
.sync-counts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.sync-counts li { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid;
  border-radius: var(--radius-m); font-size: .86rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.sync-counts li [data-icon] { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.sync-counts li .what { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
.sync-counts .take { color: var(--sync-take); background: var(--sync-take-bg); }
.sync-counts .give { color: var(--sync-give); background: var(--sync-give-bg); }
.sync-counts .both { color: var(--sync-both); background: var(--sync-both-bg); }
.sync-counts li[data-n="0"] { opacity: .6; }
/* What to sync: a line a part, its box, its name and what it holds and waits. */
.sync-parts { display: grid; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; min-width: 0; }
.sync-part { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 0; cursor: pointer; }
.sync-part + .sync-part { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.sync-part input { flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 2px 0 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.sync-part-words { display: grid; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; }
.sync-part-name { font-weight: 650; }
.sync-part-said { color: var(--muted); font-size: .86rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-part:has(input:disabled) { cursor: default; }
.sync-part:has(input:disabled) .sync-part-name { color: var(--muted); }
.sync-part:has(input:disabled) input { opacity: .45; }
.sync-status { margin: 0; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-status:empty { display: none; }
.sync-status[data-tone="failed"] { color: var(--failed); }
.sync-status[data-tone="running"] { color: var(--muted); }
.sync-status[data-tone="done"] { color: var(--found); }
.sync-status a { font-weight: 650; }
.sync-ends { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px;
  padding-top: 4px; }
.sync-ends .btn { min-width: 96px; min-height: 44px; }
.sync-ends #sync-go { margin-inline-start: auto; }
/* A conflict: the song, "1 of 2", each side's version, and which to keep. */
.sync-card { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-l);
  background: var(--card); }
.sync-card-name { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-card-at { margin: -6px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .84rem; }
.sync-two { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.sync-side { min-width: 0; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  background: var(--surface); }
.sync-side-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: .9rem; }
.sync-side-head [data-icon] { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.sync-lines { display: grid; gap: 6px; margin: 0; font-size: .88rem; }
.sync-lines dt { color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; }
.sync-lines dd { margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-lines[data-state="reading"] { color: var(--muted); }
.sync-ask { margin: 4px 0 0; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; }
.sync-pair { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.sync-pair .btn { gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.sync-pair [data-icon] { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.sync-same { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px;
  color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; cursor: pointer; }
.sync-same input { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
/* On its way. */
.sync-going-line { margin: 0; font-weight: 650; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-going-line:focus { outline: none; }
.sync-going-line[data-tone="failed"] { color: var(--failed); }
.sync-going-line:is([data-tone="running"], [data-tone="queued"]) { color: var(--auto); }
.sync-going-detail { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .86rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-going-detail:empty { display: none; }
/* What it did: the two sides, this device on the left, and a lane a kind of change between them. */
.sync-devs { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 0 2px; }
.sync-dev { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; width: 120px; color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .8rem; text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-dev [data-icon] { width: 40px; height: 40px; color: var(--text); }
.sync-sections { display: grid; }
.sync-section { --lane: var(--muted); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--lane); }
.sync-section[data-kind="taken"] { --lane: var(--sync-take); }
.sync-section[data-kind="given"] { --lane: var(--sync-give); }
.sync-section[data-kind="conflicts"] { --lane: var(--sync-both); }
.sync-section[data-kind="songbooks"] { --lane: var(--sync-book); }
.sync-section[data-kind="indexes"] { --lane: var(--sync-index); }
.sync-lane { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 22px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%;
  min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 0; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer; }
.sync-lane-words { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.sync-lane-said { font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 500; text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-arrow { display: block; width: 100%; height: 14px; }
.sync-arrow svg { stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: butt; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }
.sync-arrow .head { display: none; }
.sync-arrow[data-way~="left"] .head.left, .sync-arrow[data-way~="right"] .head.right { display: inline; }
.sync-section[data-kind="conflicts"] .sync-arrow .shaft { stroke-dasharray: 6 4; }
.sync-chev { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: var(--muted); transition: transform .15s; }
.sync-lane[aria-expanded="true"] .sync-chev { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.sync-rows { display: grid; gap: 4px; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 10px 6px; list-style: none; font-size: .88rem; }
.sync-rows li { padding: 3px 0 3px 10px; border-left: 2px solid currentColor; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-row-name { color: var(--text); }
.sync-row-said { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; }
.sync-up { color: var(--found); }
.sync-down { color: var(--failed); }
.sync-note { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .86rem; }
/* Five tabs on a phone's width (Library, Songbooks, Sites, Requests, Sync: caracole serve's page): the row scrolls
   (library.css), the page never does. Below 380px (a small phone) they take a row of their own under the mark, whose
   summary goes beside it (a badge's pill before them). */
@media (max-width: 379px) {
  .masthead.lib:has(#tab-sync) { grid-template-areas: "app sum" "tabs tabs"; }
  .masthead.lib:has(#tab-sync) { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .masthead.lib:has(#tab-sync):has(.scratch) { grid-template-areas: "app sum" "name tabs"; }
  .masthead.lib:has(#tab-sync) .tabs { justify-content: space-between; }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .sync-ends .btn, .sync-pair .btn, .sync-row .btn, .sync-panel-go .btn { min-height: 44px; }
}
/* The Requests tab (requests.js): under Now the request that runs, a card with its steps (steps.css), and those
   queued, each with Cancel; then what ended, under Today and Earlier, each with its outcome as a coloured word, its
   reason, its next step, when it ended and its Output, folded. On a phone a request's parts stack: its line, the
   reason, the steps; its next step with Output beside it. From 640 px its next step sits beside its line. */
.reqs { padding-top: 10px; }
.reqs-status { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--failed); font-weight: 600; }
.reqs-status:empty { display: none; }
.reqs-empty { margin: 24px 0; color: var(--muted); }
.req-head { margin: 22px 0 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase; }
.req-group:first-child .req-head { margin-top: 6px; }
.req-list { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.req { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 6px 12px;
  padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-l); background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow); scroll-margin-top: 16px; }
.req:focus { outline: none; }
.req:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.req-line { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 10px; min-height: 32px; margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.req-song { font-weight: 650; }
.req-ago { color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; }
.req-says { padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--ignored); background: var(--ignored-bg); }
.req-says:is([data-tone="ready"], [data-tone="removed"], [data-tone="done"]) { color: var(--found);
  background: var(--found-bg); }
.req-says:is([data-tone="running"], [data-tone="added"]) { color: var(--auto); background: var(--auto-bg); }
.req-says:is([data-tone="waiting"], [data-tone="missing"]) { color: var(--wanted); background: var(--wanted-bg); }
.req-says[data-tone="review"] { color: var(--review); background: var(--review-bg); }
.req-says[data-tone="failed"] { color: var(--failed); background: var(--failed-bg); }
.req-reason { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.req-next { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; }
.req-next form { margin: 0; }
.req .btn.act { min-height: 44px; }
.req-when { color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.req-error { flex-basis: 100%; margin: 0; color: var(--failed); font-size: .85rem; }
.req.running { padding: 14px 16px; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--auto) 45%, var(--border)); }
.req.running .req-song { font-size: 1.15rem; }
/* A request's steps, across the card (library.js's list; its step's padding is steps.css's, for the hanging marks). */
.req .step-list { display: grid; grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 2px 0 0; }
/* Its buttons take the page's medium radius, whatever base.css's .btn has. */
.req .btn { border-radius: var(--radius-m); }
.req-line, .req-reason, .req-output[open], .req.running .req-output { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.req-next { grid-column: 1; }
.req.over .req-output:not([open]), .req.queued .req-output:not([open]) { grid-column: 2; }
@media (min-width: 640px) {
  /* The song's line and the reason; beside them the next step, when it ended, and Output, which unfolds under the
     whole request. */
  .req { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; }
  .req-line .req-says { margin-left: auto; }  /* the outcome at the end of the song's line */
  .req.over .req-line, .req.queued .req-line { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .req.over .req-reason { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
  .req-next { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; justify-content: flex-end; }
  .req.over .req-output:not([open]), .req.queued .req-output:not([open]) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1 / span 2; }
  .req-output[open] { grid-row: 3; }
}
.req-output > summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; }
.req-output > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.req-output > summary::before { content: "›"; display: inline-block; width: 1em; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1;
  text-align: center; }
.req-output[open] > summary::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.req-meta { margin: 2px 0 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.req-steps { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.req-steps.stages { margin-bottom: 8px; }  /* a lookup's stages, above the one command that ran them */
.req-step { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-m); background: var(--raised); }
.req-step .req-meta { margin: 4px 0 0; }
.req-step-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-size: .92rem;
  font-weight: 600; }
.req-note { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--review); font-size: .85rem; }
.req .badge:is(.waiting, .skipped, .cancelled) { color: var(--ignored); background: var(--ignored-bg); }
.req .badge.interrupted { color: var(--wanted); background: var(--wanted-bg); }  /* the server stopped it */
.req-output pre { max-height: 22rem; margin: 6px 0 0; padding: 10px; overflow: auto; border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  background: var(--bg); font: .8rem/1.45 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
</style>
</head>
