      const kind = own.call(KINDS, t.type) ? KINDS[t.type] : String(t.type);
      const name = kind + " " + nth[t.type] + " of " + (of[t.type] || nth[t.type]) + (t.label ? " · " + t.label : "");
      const item = el("li", "version");
      item.appendChild(button(name, "small", (e) => choose(t, e.currentTarget), "Fetch " + name + ", " + display));
      const ug = el("a", "on-ug", "on UG");
      ug.href = /^https:[/][/]/i.test(String(t.url || "")) ? String(t.url) : "#";
      ug.target = "_blank";
      ug.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
      ug.setAttribute("aria-label", name + ", " + display + ", on UG");
      item.appendChild(ug);
      versions.appendChild(item);
    }
    const box = el("div", "row-group");
    box.appendChild(el("p", "subhead", "Versions"));
    box.appendChild(versions);
    return box;
  };
  // A song's harmonica tabs on harptabs.com (``tabs``: each one's title, page and chips, the most viewed first), under a
  // "⋯": each a button, ``choose(tab, button)`` what it does, with a link to look at it there.
  const harpTabsOf = (tabs, display, choose) => {
    const list = el("ul", "versions");
    for (const t of tabs) {
      const said = [t.key ? "key " + String(t.key) : "", Number(t.views) ? Number(t.views).toLocaleString("en") + " views"
        : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      const name = String(t.title || "") + (said ? " · " + said : "");
      const item = el("li", "version");
      item.appendChild(button(name, "small", (e) => choose(t, e.currentTarget), "Fetch " + display + " with the tab " +
        String(t.title || "")));
      const there = el("a", "on-ug", "on harptabs");
      there.href = https(t.url) ? String(t.url) : "#";
      there.target = "_blank";
      there.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
      there.setAttribute("aria-label", String(t.title || "") + ", " + display + ", on harptabs");
      item.appendChild(there);
      list.appendChild(item);
    }
    const box = el("div", "row-group");
    box.appendChild(el("p", "subhead", "Harmonica tabs on harptabs"));
    box.appendChild(list);
    return box;
  };
  // A track's tabs on gametabs.net (``tabs``: each one's title, page, views, instruments and composers, the most viewed
  // first), under a "⋯": each a button, ``choose(tab, button)`` what it does, with a link to look at it there.
  const gameTabsOf = (tabs, display, choose) => {
    const list = el("ul", "versions");
    tabs.forEach((t, n) => {
      const said = [...listOf(t.instruments), ...listOf(t.composers).map((c) => "by " + c),
        Number(t.views) ? Number(t.views).toLocaleString("en") + " views" : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      const name = "Tab " + (n + 1) + (said ? " · " + said : "");
      const item = el("li", "version");
      item.appendChild(button(name, "small", (e) => choose(t, e.currentTarget), "Fetch " + display + " with " + name));
      const there = el("a", "on-ug", "on gametabs");
      there.href = https(t.url) ? String(t.url) : "#";
      there.target = "_blank";
      there.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
      there.setAttribute("aria-label", name + ", " + display + ", on gametabs");
      item.appendChild(there);
      list.appendChild(item);
    });
    const box = el("div", "row-group");
    box.appendChild(el("p", "subhead", "Tabs on gametabs"));
    box.appendChild(list);
    return box;
  };
  // A track's instruments as badges: gametabs.net names them ("Guitar", "Bass").
  const gameInstruments = (hit) => listOf(hit && hit.instruments).map((x) => String(x).toLowerCase());
  // An Ultimate Guitar song: Get it (Get it again for a song of yours, looked up as that song), which its name does
  // too (nameDoes), and its versions under "⋯" (versionsOf).
  const ugHit = (h, get, later) => {
    const hit = h && typeof h === "object" ? h : {};
    const mine = yours(hit);
    const artist = String(hit.artist || "");
    const title = String(hit.title || "");
    const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
    const pick = (extra) => Object.assign(mine ? { song: mine.id, identity: mine.identity } : { artist, title }, { ug: hit.ug }, extra);
    let row = null;
    const main = button(mine ? "Fetch again" : "Fetch", "small primary", (e) => get(pick({}), display, row, e.currentTarget),
      (mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display) + " from UG");
    const more = [];
    const tabs = listOf(hit.tabs).filter((t) => t && typeof t === "object");
    if (tabs.length) more.push(versionsOf(tabs, hit.counts, display, (t, go) => get(pick({ tab: t.url }), display, row, go)));
    const opens = mine ? opener(mine.links) : null;
    if (opens) more.push({ heading: "In your logbook", links: [{ label: opens.label, href: opens.href, source: opens.source }] });
    // Not under one of UG's misc-… names ("Misc Mashups"): no one's, the song would never be found by it.
    if (later && !mine && !hit.no_ones) more.push(laterGroup(later, { artist, title }, display, () => row));
    row = resultRow({ title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist), source: "ug", facts: counts(hit.counts),
      badges: [...(mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your logbook" }] : []), ...instrumentBadges(ugInstruments(hit.counts))],
      action: main, more });
    row.classList.add("hit");
    if (held(mine)) row.classList.add("have");
    row.dataset.ug = String(hit.ug || "");
    row.dataset.source = "ug";
    nameDoes(row, main, mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display);
    const dots = row.querySelector(".row-more");
    if (dots && tabs.length) {  // what "⋯" holds, said: its versions
      dots.title = "Versions of " + display;
      dots.setAttribute("aria-label", "Versions of " + display);
    }
    return row;
  };
  // An artist of the offline index, with their most tabbed songs said: ``open(a)`` lists every one.
  const artistHit = (a, open) => {
    const top = listOf(a && a.top).map((t) => t && t.title).filter(Boolean);
    const go = button("Songs", "small primary", () => open(a), "Songs by " + String(a.artist) + " on UG");
    const row = resultRow({ title: a.artist, artist: top.length ? "Artist · " + top.join(", ") : "Artist", source: "ug",
      facts: many(a.songs, "song"), action: go });
    row.classList.add("hit", "artist-hit");
    row.dataset.artist = String(a.artist_key || "");
    row.dataset.source = "ug";
    return row;
  };
  // A page of gtptabs.com's index (a song with a Guitar Pro file there): Get it looks the song up as
  // caracole get does, whose gtptabs.com stage downloads one file for a song that has none; or MuseScore's,
  // a title alone, which caracole never fetches: a link to open; or a song of LaCuerda's index, whose Get it
  // looks the song up and keeps that LaCuerda sheet (``lacuerda``: the song's page, for one with chords
  // there), as Add for tonight's run records it for the nightly run. A song's name does what its Get it does
  // (nameDoes).
  const siteHit = (h, get, later) => {
    const hit = h && typeof h === "object" ? h : {};
    const title = String(hit.title || "");
    let row = null;
    if (hit.source === "lacuerda") {
      const mine = yours(hit);
      const artist = String(hit.artist || "");
      const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
      const chords = /^https:[/][/]/i.test(String(hit.sheet || "")) && /^https:[/][/]/i.test(String(hit.url || ""));
      const picked = chords ? { lacuerda: String(hit.url) } : {};
      const pick = Object.assign(mine ? { song: mine.id, identity: mine.identity } : { artist, title }, picked);
      const main = button(mine ? "Fetch again" : "Fetch", "small primary", (e) => get(pick, display, row, e.currentTarget),
        (mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display) + (chords ? " from LaCuerda" : ""));
      main.title = chords ? "Fetches the song and keeps this LaCuerda sheet"
        : "Fetches the song. LaCuerda has no chords for it.";
      const more = [{ heading: "On LaCuerda", links: [{ label: "Its page", href: hit.url, source: "lacuerda" }] }];
      const opens = mine ? opener(mine.links) : null;
      if (opens) more.push({ heading: "In your logbook", links: [{ label: opens.label, href: opens.href, source: opens.source }] });
      if (later && !mine) more.push(laterGroup(later, Object.assign({ artist, title }, picked), display, () => row));
      row = resultRow({ title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist), source: "lacuerda",
        facts: many(Number(hit.versions) || 1, "version") + (chords ? "" : " · no chords"),
        badges: mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your logbook" }] : [], action: main, more });
      nameDoes(row, main, mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display);
    } else if (hit.source === "harptabs" && hit.artist) {  // harptabs.com's song, by an artist whose page was read
      const mine = yours(hit);
      const artist = String(hit.artist || "");
      const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
      const tabs = listOf(hit.tabs).filter((t) => t && typeof t === "object" && https(t.url));
      const pick = (url) => Object.assign(mine ? { song: mine.id, identity: mine.identity } : { artist, title }, { harptabs: String(url) });
      const main = button(mine ? "Fetch again" : "Fetch", "small primary", (e) => get(pick(hit.url), display, row,
        e.currentTarget), (mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display) + " with its harmonica tab");
      main.title = "Fetches the song and keeps this harptabs tab";
      const more = [];
      if (tabs.length) more.push(harpTabsOf(tabs, display, (t, go) => get(pick(t.url), display, row, go)));
      const opens = mine ? opener(mine.links) : null;
      if (opens) more.push({ heading: "In your logbook", links: [{ label: opens.label, href: opens.href, source: opens.source }] });
      row = resultRow({ title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist), source: "harptabs",
        facts: many(Number(hit.uploads) || 1, "harmonica tab"),
        badges: [...(mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your logbook" }] : []), ...instrumentBadges(["harmonica"])],
        action: main, more });
      nameDoes(row, main, mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display);
    } else if (hit.source === "gametabs") {  // gametabs.net's track of a game: the game is its artist
      const mine = yours(hit);
      const artist = String(hit.artist || "");
      const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
      const tabs = listOf(hit.tabs).filter((t) => t && typeof t === "object" && https(t.url));
      const pick = (url) => Object.assign(mine ? { song: mine.id, identity: mine.identity } : { artist, title }, { gametabs: String(url) });
      const main = button(mine ? "Fetch again" : "Fetch", "small primary", (e) => get(pick(hit.url), display, row,
        e.currentTarget), (mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display) + " with its gametabs tab");
      main.title = "Fetches the song and keeps this gametabs tab";
      const more = [];
      if (tabs.length) more.push(gameTabsOf(tabs, display, (t, go) => get(pick(t.url), display, row, go)));
      const opens = mine ? opener(mine.links) : null;
      if (opens) more.push({ heading: "In your logbook", links: [{ label: opens.label, href: opens.href, source: opens.source }] });
      const composers = listOf(hit.composers);
      row = resultRow({ title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist), source: "gametabs",
        facts: many(Number(hit.uploads) || 1, "tab") + (composers.length ? " · by " + composers.join(", ") : ""),
        badges: [...(mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your logbook" }] : []), ...instrumentBadges(gameInstruments(hit))],
        action: main, more });
      nameDoes(row, main, mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display);
    } else if (hit.source === "ireal" && !alone(hit)) {  // iReal Pro's chart, the composer its artist; or a thread
      const mine = yours(hit);
      const thread = hit.read === false;
      const artist = String(hit.artist || "");
      const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
      const pick = Object.assign(mine ? { song: mine.id, identity: mine.identity } : { artist, title },
        https(hit.url) ? { ireal: String(hit.url) } : {});
      const main = button(mine ? "Fetch again" : "Fetch", "small primary", (e) => get(pick, display, row, e.currentTarget),
        (mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display) + (thread ? ", reading its iReal Pro thread"
          : " with its iReal Pro chart"));
      main.title = thread ? THREAD_FETCH : "Fetches the song and keeps this iReal Pro chart as its sheet";
      const more = [linkGroup({ heading: "On iReal Pro",
        links: [{ label: "Its thread", href: hit.url, source: "ireal" }] })];
      if (thread) more[0].insertBefore(el("p", "hint", THREAD_NAMED), more[0].lastChild);
      const opens = mine ? opener(mine.links) : null;
      if (opens) more.push({ heading: "In your logbook", links: [{ label: opens.label, href: opens.href, source: opens.source }] });
      row = resultRow({ title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist), source: "ireal",
        facts: thread ? THREAD_SAID : many(Number(hit.uploads) || 1, "chart"),
        badges: mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your logbook" }] : [], action: main, more });
      nameDoes(row, main, mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display);
    } else if (own.call(TITLE_SITES, String(hit.source))) {  // MuseScore's, harptabs.com's, iReal Pro's: a title alone
      const site = TITLE_SITES[hit.source];
      row = resultRow({ title, artist: site.said.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + site.said.slice(1), source: hit.source,
        badges: instrumentBadges([site.instrument]), action: { label: "Open", href: hit.url } });
      const open = row.querySelector(".row-action a");
      if (open) open.setAttribute("aria-label", "Open " + title + " on " + site.name + ", new tab");
    } else {
      const mine = yours(hit);
      const artist = String(hit.artist || "");
      const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
      const pick = mine ? { song: mine.id, identity: mine.identity } : { artist, title };
      const main = button(mine ? "Fetch again" : "Fetch", "small primary", (e) => get(pick, display, row, e.currentTarget),
        (mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display) + " with a Guitar Pro file from gtptabs");
      main.title = "Fetches the sheet, then a Guitar Pro file from gtptabs";
      const uploads = Number(hit.uploads) || 1;
      const more = [{ heading: "On gtptabs", links: [{ label: "Its page", href: hit.url, source: "gtptabs" }] }];
      if (later && !mine) more.push(laterGroup(later, { artist, title }, display, () => row));
      row = resultRow({ title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist), source: "gtptabs",
        facts: uploads > 1 ? many(uploads, "upload") : "Guitar Pro",
        badges: mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your logbook" }] : [], action: main, more });
      nameDoes(row, main, mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display);
    }
    row.classList.add("hit");
    if (held(yours(hit))) row.classList.add("have");
    row.dataset.source = String(hit.source || "");
    return row;
  };

  // --- index.html's search: a song of the sites a dense line, under its artist's header --------------------
  // "chords ×9 · tabs ×2": an Ultimate Guitar song's tabs per type, as a line counts them. The index holds no
  // ratings (only the sheets caracole fetched have them), so a line never shows stars.
  const TIMES = { chords: "chords", tabs: "tabs", ukulele: "ukulele chords" };
  const tabCounts = (c) => Object.entries(c && typeof c === "object" ? c : {})
    .map(([kind, n]) => (own.call(TIMES, kind) ? TIMES[kind] : kind) + " ×" + Number(n || 0)).join(" · ");
  const https = (url) => /^https:[/][/]/i.test(String(url || ""));
  // An iReal Pro thread never read, named from its name (``read`` false): its words, and its Fetch's.
  const THREAD_SAID = "thread not read yet";
  const THREAD_FETCH = "Reads this iReal Pro thread and keeps its chart as the song's sheet";
  const THREAD_NAMED = "Named from the thread's name: caracole hasn't read it yet.";
  // One song of the offline indexes (``item``): each site's row of it, as /api/search gives them (``ug``, an Ultimate
  // Guitar song; ``lacuerda`` and ``gtptabs``, a song of theirs; ``removed``, a song caracole removed), on one line
  // with each site's mark and its counts, and its identity (``key``) as the line's ``data-hit``. Get it looks the
  // song up as Ultimate Guitar's song (whose lookup gets gtptabs.com's Guitar Pro file too), else keeping
  // LaCuerda's sheet, else by its names; a removed song's is Add again, which asks for it again as the request form
  // does. Its name does what that button does (nameDoes). Under "⋯": UG's versions, LaCuerda's sheet and page,
  // gtptabs.com's page, Add for tonight's run.
  // ``acts``: { get, later, again }, each called (pick, display, line, button), as ugHit's ``get`` is.
  const indexLine = (item, acts) => {
    const it = item && typeof item === "object" ? item : {};
    const rowOf = (x) => (x && typeof x === "object" ? x : null);
    const ug = rowOf(it.ug);
    const lc = rowOf(it.lacuerda);
    const gtp = rowOf(it.gtptabs);
    const ht = rowOf(it.harptabs);
    const gt = rowOf(it.gametabs);
    const ir = rowOf(it.ireal);
    const mine = [ug, lc, gtp, ht, gt, ir].map(yours).find(Boolean) || null;  // a song of yours the page has no line of yet
    const gone = mine ? null : rowOf(it.removed);
    const first = ug || lc || gtp || ht || gt || ir || gone || {};
    const title = String(first.title || "");
    const artist = String(first.artist || "");
    const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
    const pick = (extra) => Object.assign(mine ? { song: mine.id, identity: mine.identity } : { artist, title }, extra);
    const chords = Boolean(lc) && https(lc.sheet) && https(lc.url);
    const sheet = chords ? { lacuerda: String(lc.url) } : {};
    const harp = ht && https(ht.url) ? { harptabs: String(ht.url) } : null;
    const game = gt && https(gt.url) ? { gametabs: String(gt.url) } : null;
    const chart = ir && https(ir.url) ? { ireal: String(ir.url) } : null;  // iReal Pro's chart, kept as the sheet
    const thread = Boolean(ir) && ir.read === false;
    const a = acts && typeof acts === "object" ? acts : {};
    let line = null;
    const here = () => line;
    let main;
    if (gone) {
      const back = { artist, title };
      main = fetchIcon("Add " + display + " again", (e) => a.again(back, display, here(), e.currentTarget));
      main.title = "Back into wanted.txt, and fetched";
    } else {
      const chosen = ug ? pick({ ug: ug.ug }) : chords ? pick(sheet) : chart ? pick(chart) : harp ? pick(harp)
        : game ? pick(game) : pick(sheet);
      main = fetchIcon((mine ? "Fetch " + display + " again" : "Fetch " + display) + (ug ? " from UG"
        : chords ? " from LaCuerda" : chart && thread ? ", reading its iReal Pro thread"
          : chart ? " with its iReal Pro chart" : harp ? " with its harptabs harmonica tab"
          : game ? " with its gametabs tab" : gtp ? " with a Guitar Pro file from gtptabs" : ""),
      (e) => a.get(chosen, display, here(), e.currentTarget));
      main.title = ug ? "Fetches songs"
        : chords ? "Fetches the song and keeps this LaCuerda sheet"
        : chart ? (thread ? THREAD_FETCH : "Fetches the song and keeps this iReal Pro chart as its sheet")
        : harp ? "Fetches the song and keeps this harptabs tab"
        : game ? "Fetches the song and keeps this gametabs tab"
        : gtp ? "Fetches the sheet, then a Guitar Pro file from gtptabs"
        : "Fetches the song. LaCuerda has no chords for it.";
    }
    const more = [];
    const tabs = ug ? listOf(ug.tabs).filter((t) => t && typeof t === "object") : [];
    if (tabs.length) {
      more.push(versionsOf(tabs, ug.counts, display, (t, go) => a.get(pick({ ug: ug.ug, tab: t.url }), display, here(), go)));
    }
    if (lc) {
      const box = el("div", "row-group");
      box.appendChild(el("p", "subhead", "On LaCuerda"));
      const actions = el("div", "actions");
      if (chords && (ug || gone)) {  // the line's own button is another's: this one keeps LaCuerda's sheet
        actions.appendChild(button("Fetch with this sheet", "small", (e) => a.get(pick(sheet), display, here(), e.currentTarget),
          "Fetch " + display + ", keeping LaCuerda's sheet"));
      }
      actions.appendChild(link({ label: "Its page", href: lc.url, source: "lacuerda" }, "btn small", true));
      box.appendChild(actions);
      more.push(box);
    }
    if (gtp) more.push({ heading: "On gtptabs", links: [{ label: "Its page", href: gtp.url, source: "gtptabs" }] });
    if (ir) {  // iReal Pro's chart: its thread, and a Get it that keeps it when the line's own button is another site's
      const box = el("div", "row-group");
      box.appendChild(el("p", "subhead", "On iReal Pro"));
      if (thread) box.appendChild(el("p", "hint", THREAD_NAMED));
      const actions = el("div", "actions");
      if (chart && (ug || chords || gone)) {
        actions.appendChild(button(thread ? "Fetch with this thread" : "Fetch with this chart", "small",
          (e) => a.get(pick(chart), display, here(), e.currentTarget), "Fetch " + display + (thread
            ? ", reading iReal Pro's thread for its chart" : ", keeping iReal Pro's chart as its sheet")));
      }
      actions.appendChild(link({ label: "Its thread", href: ir.url, source: "ireal" }, "btn small", true));
      box.appendChild(actions);
      more.push(box);
    }
    if (ht) {  // its harmonica tabs, each a Get it that keeps that tab (the line's own button may be another site's)
      const tabs = listOf(ht.tabs).filter((t) => t && typeof t === "object" && https(t.url));
      if (tabs.length) more.push(harpTabsOf(tabs, display, (t, go) => a.get(pick({ harptabs: String(t.url) }), display, here(), go)));
    }
    if (gt) {  // its tabs on gametabs.net, each a Get it that keeps that tab (the line's own button may be another site's)
      const tabs = listOf(gt.tabs).filter((t) => t && typeof t === "object" && https(t.url));
      if (tabs.length) more.push(gameTabsOf(tabs, display, (t, go) => a.get(pick({ gametabs: String(t.url) }), display, here(), go)));
    }
    const opens = mine ? opener(mine.links) : null;
    if (opens) more.push({ heading: "In your logbook", links: [{ label: opens.label, href: opens.href, source: opens.source }] });
    // Not under one of UG's misc-… names ("Misc Mashups"): no one's, the song would never be found by it.
    if (a.later && !mine && !(ug && ug.no_ones)) more.push(laterGroup(a.later, pick(ug ? {} : sheet), display, here));
    const facts = [ug ? tabCounts(ug.counts) : "",
      lc ? "LaCuerda ×" + (Number(lc.versions) || 1) + (chords ? "" : " no chords") : "",
      gtp ? "Guitar Pro file" + ((Number(gtp.uploads) || 1) > 1 ? " ×" + Number(gtp.uploads) : "") : "",
      ht ? "harmonica tab" + ((Number(ht.uploads) || 1) > 1 ? " ×" + Number(ht.uploads) : "") : "",
      gt ? "game tab" + ((Number(gt.uploads) || 1) > 1 ? " ×" + Number(gt.uploads) : "") : "",
      ir ? (thread ? THREAD_SAID : "iReal Pro chart" + ((Number(ir.uploads) || 1) > 1 ? " ×" + Number(ir.uploads) : ""))
        : ""];
    const badges = gone ? [{ kind: "removed", text: "Removed " + shortDate(gone.removed_at) }]
      : mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your logbook" }] : [];
    line = resultRow({ dense: true, title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist),

  const GUITAR = /^guitar-\d+[.]([A-Za-z0-9]+)$/;
  const HARMONICA = /^harmonica-\d+[.]txt$/;
  // A harmonica tab's page beside it (``harmonicaPage``: render.py's harmonica-N.html), which its tile and its row open.
  const harpPage = (f) => (f && f.harmonicaPage && typeof f.harmonicaPage.href === "string" ? f.harmonicaPage.href : "");
  const SCORE = /^score-\d+[.]([a-z]+)$/;
  const GAMETAB = /^gametab-\d+[.]txt$/;  // a text tab of game music from gametabs.net
  const SCORE_FORMATS = { mscz: "MuseScore", mxl: "MusicXML", musicxml: "MusicXML", pdf: "PDF", mid: "MIDI",
    midi: "MIDI" };
  const LYRICS = ["lyrics.txt", "lyrics.lrc"];
  // A file's label without where it came from ("Guitar Pro 1 · gtptabs.com": "Guitar Pro 1").
  const plainLabel = (f) => String(f.label || f.name || "").split(" · ")[0];
  // The files of one kind, by where each came from, in their order: [{ source, files }].
  const bySource = (files) => {
    const groups = [];
    for (const f of files) {
      const key = typeof f.source === "string" && f.source ? f.source : "";
      let group = groups.find((g) => g.source === key);
      if (!group) groups.push(group = { source: key, files: [] });
      group.files.push(f);
    }
    return groups;
  };

  // --- a tile's drawer: a part a source of its versions --------------------------------------------------------
  // A part's head (the source's mark, what it lists, what it counts, and its ``extra``: Back to our pick, the pin's
  // note), then a row a version: a { ver, stars, note, actions, cls } versionRow draws, each of ``note`` and
  // ``actions`` a Node or a text.
  const drawerHead = (source, what, said, extra) => {
    const head = el("div", "drawer-head");
    const mark = sourceMark(source);
    if (mark) head.appendChild(mark);
    head.appendChild(el("h4", "drawer-what", what));
    if (said) head.appendChild(el("span", "drawer-said", said));
    for (const node of listOf(extra)) if (node) head.appendChild(node);
    return head;
  };
  const versionRow = (r) => {
    const row = el("li", "vrow" + (r.cls ? " " + r.cls : ""));
    row.appendChild(el("span", "ver", r.ver));
    const stars = el("span", "stars");
    const cut = String(r.stars || "").indexOf(" (");
    if (r.stars === "New") stars.appendChild(el("span", "new", "New"));
    else if (!r.stars) { /* a file with no rating: an empty cell */ }
    else if (cut < 0) stars.appendChild(el("b", null, r.stars));
    else {
      stars.appendChild(el("b", null, r.stars.slice(0, cut)));
      stars.appendChild(document.createTextNode(r.stars.slice(cut)));
    }
    row.appendChild(stars);
    const note = el("span", "note");
    listOf(r.note).filter(Boolean).forEach((part, n) => {
      if (n) note.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" · "));
      note.appendChild(part instanceof Node ? part : document.createTextNode(String(part)));
    });
    if (note.textContent) note.title = note.textContent;
    row.appendChild(note);
    const acts = el("span", "vbtns");
    for (const node of listOf(r.actions)) if (node) acts.appendChild(node);
    row.appendChild(acts);
    return row;
  };
  const inUse = () => withGlyph(el("span", "inuse"), "check", "In use");
  const openLink = (href, said, how) => {
    const a = anchor(href, "btn small go", how);
    a.textContent = how && how.external ? "Its page ↗" : "Open";
    a.setAttribute("aria-label", said);
    return a;
  };
  const downloadLink = (f, label, said) => {
    const a = anchor(f.href, "dl", { download: typeof f.download === "string" ? f.download : "" });
    withGlyph(a, "download", label);
    a.setAttribute("aria-label", said);
    a.title = said;
    return a;
  };

  // Whether the sheet's drawer has a part of Ultimate Guitar's versions (``versions``, the data's): UG has some, or
  // caracole keeps some.
  const ugListed = (v) => Boolean(v && typeof v === "object" && (Number(v.total) > 0 || listOf(v.list).length));
  // Ultimate Guitar's versions of the sheet (the data's ``versions``): the kept ones in rank order, the one in use,
  // and the rest counted, with what fetches them (``acts``).
  const ugDrawer = (s, part, acts) => {
    const v = s.versions;
    const list = listOf(v.list).filter((x) => x && typeof x === "object");
    const title = String(s.title);
    const ukulele = listOf(s.instruments).indexOf("ukulele") >= 0;
    const extra = [];
    if (v.pinned && acts.clear) extra.push(acts.clear());
    part.appendChild(drawerHead("ug", "UG · " + (ukulele ? "ukulele chords" : "chord sheets"),
      Number(v.total || 0).toLocaleString("en") + " on UG · " + list.length + " in your logbook", extra));
    const ol = el("ol", "vrows");
    for (const x of list) {
      const ver = "Ver " + (Number(x.number) || "?");
      const share = lyricsShare(x.complete, x.coverage);
      const note = [];
      if (x.gone) note.push("gone from UG");
      if (typeof x.label === "string" && x.label) note.push(x.label.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + x.label.slice(1));
      if (share) note.push(share);
      if (x.note) note.push(String(x.note));
      if (x.chosen) note.push(v.pinned ? "your choice" : "our pick");
      const actions = [];
      if (x.chosen) actions.push(inUse());
      else if (!x.gone && acts.choose) actions.push(acts.choose(x, ver));
      actions.push(openLink(x.href, "Open " + ver + " of " + title));
      ol.appendChild(versionRow({ ver, stars: rated(x), note, actions,
        cls: (x.chosen ? "cur" : "") + (x.gone ? " gone" : "") }));
    }
    part.appendChild(ol);
    const rest = Number(v.rest) || 0;
    if (rest > 0) {
      const more = el("div", "drawer-rest");
      more.appendChild(el("span", "rest-said", rest + " more on UG, not kept"));
      const fetch = acts.keepMore ? acts.keepMore(rest, Number(v.keepMore) || 0) : null;
      if (fetch) {
        more.appendChild(fetch);
      } else if (acts.keepMoreCommand) {
        const said = el("span", "rest-command", "Keep them: ");
        said.appendChild(el("code", null, acts.keepMoreCommand));
        more.appendChild(said);
      }
      part.appendChild(more);
    }
  };
  // The LaCuerda sheets caracole met for the song (``lacuerdaVersions``), best first: each its page on LaCuerda, its
  // share of the lyrics, and In use for the sheet, else what keeps it (``acts.useLaCuerda``). A UG version you chose
  // (a [pin]) outranks a LaCuerda pick: while one does, its part says so and keeps none; what takes the pin out is the
  // UG part's Back to our pick, right above it, which its note points to (one button in the drawer), or its own when
  // the drawer has no UG part.
  const lacuerdaDrawer = (s, part, acts) => {
    const met = listOf(s.lacuerdaVersions).filter((x) => x && typeof x === "object");
    const title = String(s.title);
    const pinned = Boolean(s.versions && s.versions.pinned) && Boolean(acts.useLaCuerda);
    const extra = [];
    if (pinned && ugListed(s.versions)) {
      extra.push(el("p", "pin-note", "Your UG choice is in use: Back to our pick, above, first."));
    } else if (pinned) {
      extra.push(el("p", "pin-note", "Your UG choice is in use. Back to our pick first."));
      if (acts.clear) extra.push(acts.clear());
    }
    part.appendChild(drawerHead("lacuerda", "LaCuerda · chord sheets", many(met.length, "version") + " seen",
      extra));
    const ol = el("ol", "vrows");
    met.forEach((x, n) => {
      const ver = "Version " + (n + 1);
      const actions = [];
      if (x.sheet) actions.push(inUse());
      else if (acts.useLaCuerda && !pinned) actions.push(acts.useLaCuerda(x, ver));
      actions.push(openLink(x.href, ver + " of " + title + " on LaCuerda, new tab", { external: true }));
      ol.appendChild(versionRow({ ver, note: [lyricsShare(null, x.coverage) || "not scored"], actions,
        cls: x.sheet ? "cur" : "" }));
    });
    part.appendChild(ol);
  };
  // The auto sheet beside a human one (``autoSheet``): its viewer, and its files.
  const autoDrawer = (s, part) => {
    const a = s.autoSheet;
    const title = String(s.title);
    part.appendChild(drawerHead("auto", "Auto sheet · from the recording", "made by us from the audio"));
    const ol = el("ol", "vrows");
    const downloads = listOf(a.files).filter((f) => f && f.href)
      .map((f) => downloadLink(f, String(f.label), "Download the auto sheet's " + String(f.label) + " of " + title));
    ol.appendChild(versionRow({ ver: "Auto sheet", note: downloads.length ? downloads : [],
      actions: [openLink(a.href, "Open the auto sheet of " + title)] }));
    part.appendChild(ol);
  };
  // One source's files of a tile (``group``): a row each, its label, Open where the page shows it, and Download.
  const filesDrawer = (s, part, t, group) => {
    const title = String(s.title);
    part.appendChild(drawerHead(group.source, nameOf(group.source) + " · " + t.plural,
      many(group.files.length, t.unit)));
    const ol = el("ol", "vrows");
    for (const f of group.files) {
      const label = plainLabel(f);
      const actions = [];
      const opens = t.opener ? t.opener(f) : null;
      if (opens) actions.push(openLink(opens.href, "Open " + label + " of " + title, opens));
      actions.push(downloadLink(f, "Download", "Download " + label + " of " + title));
      ol.appendChild(versionRow({ ver: label, note: [String(f.name)], actions }));
    }
    part.appendChild(ol);
  };

  // --- the tiles ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // A tile, one thing to play from (``things``): its body opens what it holds (``open``, ``said`` its name for a screen
  // reader), its subtitle says which (``from``); after it the marks of where its versions came from (``sources``, two
  // at most, as its line's button), or, for one source that links back to its page (a fixed chip's ``href``:
  // Megalobiz's or AZLyrics' lyrics), that link; then a chevron, which opens its drawer (``tiles``), when that would
  // hold anything: its downloads (``downloads``), then a part a source of its versions (``partsOf``). More than one
  // version: a small stack. Every tile alike, none first; an auto sheet's in its own colour.
  const MARKS_SHOWN = 2;  // a tile's marks, and its line's button's
  const UNIT_WORDS = { version: "versions", file: "files", tab: "tabs" };
  // The parts of a tile's drawer: its chips that list something (``fill``), but a tile's one chip with one version,
  // which its mark says all of.
  const partsOf = (t) => {
    const chips = listOf(t.chips);
    return chips.length === 1 && chips[0].fixed ? [] : chips.filter((c) => typeof c.fill === "function");
  };
  const tileOf = (t) => {
    const box = el("div", "tile tile-" + t.kind + (t.auto ? " auto" : ""));
    const chips = listOf(t.chips);
    if (chips.reduce((n, c) => n + (Number(c.count) || 0), 0) > 1) box.classList.add("stack");
    const open = anchor(t.open.href, "tile-open", t.open);
    open.setAttribute("aria-label", t.said);
    const ico = el("span", "tile-ico");
    ico.appendChild(glyph(t.glyph));
    const words = el("span", "tile-words");
    const name = words.appendChild(el("span", "tile-name", t.name));
    name.id = idFor("tile");
    if (t.version) {  // the sheet's version in use: its number, its rating whole or not at all, and "in use"
      const from = words.appendChild(el("span", "tile-from", t.version.ver));
      if (t.version.rated) from.append(" · ", el("span", "tile-rated", t.version.rated));
      from.appendChild(el("span", "tile-in-use", " · in use"));
      from.id = idFor("from");
      open.setAttribute("aria-describedby", from.id);
    } else if (t.from) {
      const from = words.appendChild(el("span", "tile-from", t.from));
      from.id = idFor("from");
      open.setAttribute("aria-describedby", from.id);
    }
    const go = el("span", "tile-go");
    go.appendChild(glyph(t.open.download !== undefined ? "download" : "open"));
    open.append(ico, words, go);
    box.appendChild(open);
    const one = chips.length === 1 && chips[0].fixed ? chips[0] : null;
    if (one && one.href) {
      const back = anchor(one.href, "tile-source", { external: true });
      back.setAttribute("aria-label", t.name + ": its page on " + nameOf(one.source));
      const mark = sourceMark(one.source);
      if (mark) back.appendChild(mark);
      back.appendChild(el("span", "tile-source-name", nameOf(one.source)));
      box.appendChild(back);
    } else {
      const marks = el("span", "tile-source");
      for (const key of listOf(t.sources).slice(0, MARKS_SHOWN)) {
        const mark = sourceMark(key);
        if (mark) marks.appendChild(mark);
      }
      if (marks.childNodes.length) box.appendChild(marks);
    }
    const holds = [partsOf(t).length ? UNIT_WORDS[t.unit] || "versions" : "",
      listOf(t.downloads).length ? "downloads" : ""].filter(Boolean);
    if (holds.length) {
      const more = el("button", "tile-more");
      more.type = "button";
      const said = t.name + ": its " + holds.join(" and ");
      more.setAttribute("aria-label", said);
      more.title = said;
      more.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      more.appendChild(glyph("chevron"));
      box.appendChild(more);
    }
    return box;
  };

  // What a song of yours holds to play from, in this order: its chord sheet (the human one, else the auto one; UG's
  // Ukulele Chords), its Guitar Pro files, its text tab, its harmonica tabs, its tabs of game music, its lyrics and the
  // scores you filed; a tile each in its card (tiles), and but its lyrics a button each on its line (plays). Each
  // { kind, glyph, name, open, said, from, version, chips, downloads, opener, auto, sources, count, unit }: ``from``,
  // which it is; ``version``, the sheet's version in use ({ ver, rated }), which its tile's from line is made of;
  // ``chips``, its versions a source each ({ source, count, unit, fixed, href, fill(part) }: ``fixed``, one version
  // and nothing to choose; ``href``, a fixed source's page to link back to; ``fill``, what draws that source's part
  // of its drawer);
  // ``downloads``, its formats' links; ``sources``, where its versions came from, the one in use first; ``count``, how
  // many versions of it the card lists (in its drawer, or as files), in ``unit``s. ``opts``: ``guitar``, caracole
  // serve shows Guitar Pro files (alphaTab); ``acts``, what a drawer's versions do (Use this one, Fetch them, Back to
  // our pick, LaCuerda's Use this one: each makes its control; or, from the file, ``keepMoreCommand``, the command
  // that fetches them). ``claimed``, given, gets every file a tile shows.
  const things = (s, opts) => {
    const o = opts || {};
    const acts = o.acts || {};
    const title = String(s.title);
    const files = listOf(s.files).filter((f) => f && typeof f.name === "string" && f.href);
    const named = (n) => files.find((f) => f.name === n) || null;
    const claim = (f) => {
      if (f && o.claimed) o.claimed.add(f);
      return f;
    };
    const made = [];

    // The chord sheet: the human one, else the auto one; its versions from each source.
    const primary = files.find((f) => f.primary) || null;
    const autoOnly = s.auto === true;
    if (primary && (HUMAN.test(primary.name) || AUTO.test(primary.name))) {
      const auto = s.autoSheet && typeof s.autoSheet === "object" && !autoOnly ? s.autoSheet : null;
      files.filter((f) => (autoOnly ? AUTO : HUMAN).test(f.name) || (auto && AUTO.test(f.name))).forEach(claim);
      const ukulele = listOf(s.instruments).indexOf("ukulele") >= 0;
      const name = autoOnly ? "Auto sheet" : ukulele ? "Ukulele chords" : "Chord sheet";
      const v = s.versions && typeof s.versions === "object" ? s.versions : null;
      const one = v ? listOf(v.list).find((x) => x && x.chosen) : null;
      const version = one ? { ver: "Ver " + (Number(one.number) || "?"), rated: rated(one) } : null;
      const from = version ? [version.ver, version.rated, "in use"].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")
        : autoOnly || s.source === "auto" || s.source === "youtube" ? "from the recording"
        : s.source ? nameOf(s.source) : "";
      const chips = [];
      if (ugListed(v)) {
        chips.push({ source: "ug", count: Number(v.total) || listOf(v.list).length, unit: "version",
          fixed: Number(v.total) <= 1 && !(Number(v.rest) > 0), fill: (part) => ugDrawer(s, part, acts) });
      }
      const met = listOf(s.lacuerdaVersions);
      if (met.length) {
        chips.push({ source: "lacuerda", count: met.length, unit: "version",
          fixed: met.length === 1 && Boolean(met[0] && met[0].sheet),
          fill: (part) => lacuerdaDrawer(s, part, acts) });
      }
      if (auto) {
        chips.push({ source: "auto", count: 1, unit: "version", fixed: false, fill: (part) => autoDrawer(s, part) });
      }
      if (!chips.length && s.source) chips.push({ source: String(s.source), count: 1, fixed: true });
      const downloads = (autoOnly ? AUTO_FILES : SHEET_FILES).map(([n, label]) => [named(n), label])
        .filter(([f]) => f).map(([f, label]) => downloadLink(f, label, "Download the " + label + " of " + title));
      for (const f of files.filter((x) => typeof x.version === "string" && x.version)) {
        claim(f);
        downloads.push(downloadLink(f, "PDF · " + f.version, "Download the PDF of " + title + " in " + f.version));
      }
      // Its versions the card lists: UG's kept, LaCuerda's met, the auto sheet beside it; and the one in use, if none
      // of those is it (a sheet from your inbox, say). Where they came from, the one in use first.
      const kept = v ? listOf(v.list).filter((x) => x && typeof x === "object").length : 0;
      const listed = kept + met.length + (auto ? 1 : 0);
      const inUse = (s.source === "ug" && kept > 0) || (s.source === "lacuerda" && met.some((x) => x && x.sheet));
      const sources = [s.source, kept ? "ug" : "", met.length ? "lacuerda" : "", auto ? "auto" : ""];
      made.push({ kind: "sheet", glyph: ukulele ? "ukulele" : "sheet", name, auto: autoOnly,
        open: { href: primary.href }, said: "Open the " + name.toLowerCase() + " of " + title, from, version,
        chips, downloads, sources: distinct(sources), count: listed + (inUse ? 0 : 1),
        unit: "version" });
    }

    // Guitar Pro files (or a Power Tab file); and a text tab, a thing of its own.
    const guitar = files.filter((f) => GUITAR.test(f.name));
    const tab = named("tab.txt");
    const browser = (f) => (o.guitar && typeof f.guitarPage === "string" && f.guitarPage ? { href: f.guitarPage }
      : null);
    if (guitar.length) {
      guitar.forEach(claim);
      const first = guitar[0];
      const shown = browser(first);
      const ext = "." + GUITAR.exec(first.name)[1].toLowerCase();
      const t = { kind: "guitar", glyph: "guitar", name: "Guitar Pro", plural: "Guitar Pro files", unit: "file",
        open: shown || { href: first.href, download: typeof first.download === "string" ? first.download : "" },
        said: (shown ? "Open the Guitar Pro tab of " : "Download the Guitar Pro file of ") + title,
        from: String(first.name),
        downloads: [downloadLink(first, ext, "Download " + plainLabel(first) + " of " + title)],
        opener: (f) => browser(f), count: guitar.length };
      t.chips = bySource(guitar).map((g) => ({ source: g.source, count: g.files.length, unit: "file",
        fixed: g.files.length === 1, fill: (part) => filesDrawer(s, part, t, g) }));
      made.push(t);
    }
    if (tab) {
      claim(tab);
      made.push({ kind: "tab", glyph: "guitar", name: "Guitar tab", open: { href: tab.href },
        said: "Open the guitar tab of " + title, from: tab.source ? nameOf(tab.source) : "a text tab",
        chips: tab.source ? [{ source: tab.source, count: 1, fixed: true }] : [],
        downloads: [downloadLink(tab, "Text", "Download the guitar tab of " + title)], count: 1, unit: "tab" });
    }

    // Harmonica tabs.
    const harp = files.filter((f) => HARMONICA.test(f.name));
    if (harp.length) {
      harp.forEach(claim);
      const first = harp[0];
      const t = { kind: "harmonica", glyph: "harmonica", name: "Harmonica tab", plural: "harmonica tabs", unit: "tab",
        open: { href: harpPage(first) || first.href }, said: "Open the harmonica tab of " + title,
        from: plainLabel(first).replace(/^Harmonica tab/, "Tab"),
        downloads: [downloadLink(first, "Text", "Download " + plainLabel(first) + " of " + title)],
        opener: (f) => ({ href: harpPage(f) || f.href }), count: harp.length };
      t.chips = bySource(harp).map((g) => ({ source: g.source, count: g.files.length, unit: "tab",
        fixed: g.files.length === 1, fill: (part) => filesDrawer(s, part, t, g) }));
      made.push(t);
    }

    // Text tabs of game music from gametabs.net, opened as text, as Ultimate Guitar's tab.txt is.
    const games = files.filter((f) => GAMETAB.test(f.name));
    if (games.length) {
      games.forEach(claim);
      const first = games[0];
      const t = { kind: "gametab", glyph: "guitar", name: "Game music tab", plural: "game music tabs", unit: "tab",
        open: { href: first.href }, said: "Open the game music tab of " + title,
        from: plainLabel(first).replace(/^Game music tab/, "Tab"),
        downloads: [downloadLink(first, "Text", "Download " + plainLabel(first) + " of " + title)],
        opener: (f) => ({ href: f.href }), count: games.length };
      t.chips = bySource(games).map((g) => ({ source: g.source, count: g.files.length, unit: "tab",
        fixed: g.files.length === 1, fill: (part) => filesDrawer(s, part, t, g) }));
      made.push(t);
    }

    // Lyrics, plain and timed: LRCLIB's, or Megalobiz's or AZLyrics', whose tile links to their page there
    // (``lyricsFrom``).
    const lyrics = LYRICS.map(named).filter(Boolean);
    if (lyrics.length) {
      lyrics.forEach(claim);
      const plain = named("lyrics.txt");
      const timed = named("lyrics.lrc");
      const downloads = [];
      if (plain) downloads.push(downloadLink(plain, "Text", "Download the lyrics of " + title));
      if (timed) downloads.push(downloadLink(timed, "Timed (.lrc)", "Download the timed lyrics of " + title));
      const source = lyrics[0].source;
      const from = s.lyricsFrom && s.lyricsFrom.source === source && typeof s.lyricsFrom.href === "string"
        ? s.lyricsFrom.href : null;
      made.push({ kind: "lyrics", glyph: "lyrics", name: "Lyrics", open: { href: lyrics[0].href },
        said: "Open the lyrics of " + title, from: timed ? "timed" : "plain",
        chips: source ? [{ source, count: 1, fixed: true, href: from }] : [], downloads });
    }

    // Scores you filed.
    const scores = files.filter((f) => SCORE.test(f.name));
    if (scores.length) {
      scores.forEach(claim);
      const first = scores[0];
      const format = (f) => SCORE_FORMATS[SCORE.exec(f.name)[1]] || f.name;
      const pdf = /[.]pdf$/i.test(first.name);
      const t = { kind: "score", glyph: "score", name: "Score", plural: "scores", unit: "file",
        open: pdf ? { href: first.href } : { href: first.href, download: typeof first.download === "string"
          ? first.download : "" },
        said: (pdf ? "Open the score of " : "Download the score of ") + title, from: plainLabel(first),
        downloads: scores.map((f) => downloadLink(f, format(f), "Download " + plainLabel(f) + " of " + title)),
        opener: (f) => (/[.]pdf$/i.test(f.name) ? { href: f.href } : null), count: scores.length };
      t.chips = bySource(scores).map((g) => ({ source: g.source, count: g.files.length, unit: "file",
        fixed: g.files.length === 1, fill: (part) => filesDrawer(s, part, t, g) }));
      made.push(t);
    }

  const shownSongs = new WeakMap();  // a song's line -> the song's data it shows (lineFor; refill carries it over)
  const removeForm = (s) => {
    const form = songForm("remove", "/remove", s);
    const back = form.appendChild(hidden("back", ""));
    form.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
      back.value = location.hash.slice(1);
      e.preventDefault();
      startRemoval(s, itemOf(form));
    });
    const go = el("button", "btn small remove", "Remove");
    go.prepend(glyph("trash"));
    go.type = "submit";
    go.setAttribute("aria-label", "Remove " + String(s.title) + " by " + String(s.artist) + " from your logbook");
    go.title = "Deletes our files for it; we won't bring it back. Undo within " + REMOVE_WAIT + " seconds.";
    form.appendChild(go);
    return form;
  };
  // The song's line, and the one that showed it elsewhere (#requested's), if any: where its removal shows.
  const removalItems = (id, r) => {
    const i = byIndex.get(id);
    const own = i === undefined ? [] : [lines.get(i)];
    return own.concat([r.spot]).filter((item, n, all) => item && all.indexOf(item) === n);
  };
  // The buttons of ``node``'s forms wait while a removal (``r``) counts down: each disabled, and given back when it is
  // undone or refused (stopRemoval); one disabled already is left as it is.
  const holdForms = (node, r) => {
    for (const b of node.querySelectorAll("form button")) {
      if (!b.disabled) {
        b.disabled = true;
        r.held.add(b);
      }
    }
  };
  // A removal's line while it counts down: a screen reader hears it once ("Removing Creep in 5 seconds."), the
  // seconds left are for the eye; then Undo, and what goes. The item's other buttons wait meanwhile, and those of its
  // card (wherever it is: partsOf), made the first time it opens, once it is (cardFor).
  const countdownIn = (item, r) => {
    const s = r.song;
    const p = progressIn(item);
    drawSteps(p, null);  // what the line says now is the removal, not a lookup
    p.dataset.key = "";  // drawn here: the next showLine draws its own
    p.dataset.tone = "waiting";
    p.textContent = "";
    const shown = el("span");
    shown.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    shown.append("Removing in ", el("span", "left", r.left), " s");
    const dot = el("span", "dot", "·");
    dot.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    const undo = el("button", "undo", "Undo");
    undo.type = "button";
    undo.setAttribute("aria-label", "Undo: keep " + String(s.title) + " by " + String(s.artist));
    undo.addEventListener("click", () => undoRemoval(Number(s.id)));
    p.append(shown, el("span", "visually-hidden", "Removing " + String(s.title) + " in " + REMOVE_WAIT +
      " seconds."), dot, undo, el("span", "goes", r.brief));
    for (const part of partsOf(item)) holdForms(part, r);
    return undo;
  };
  const eachLine = (id, r, part, text) => {
    for (const item of removalItems(id, r)) {
      const node = item.querySelector(".progress " + part);
      if (node) node.textContent = text;
    }
  };
  // The removal over before it was sent: undone, or refused (``view``'s line says why). Its buttons are back.
  const stopRemoval = (id, view, focusBack) => {
    const r = removals.get(id);
    if (!r) return;
    removals.delete(id);
    clearTimeout(r.timer);
    const items = removalItems(id, r);
    const from = items.find((item) => partsOf(item).some((part) => part.contains(document.activeElement)));
    for (const item of items) {
      const p = progressIn(item);
      p.style.minHeight = "";
      showLine(p, view);
    }
    for (const b of r.held) b.disabled = false;
    // Remove is behind the card's "⋯": the button when its menu is open, else the "⋯" that leads to it.
    const go = focusBack && from ? inItem(from, "form.remove button") : null;
    const menu = focusBack && from ? inItem(from, ".foot-more > summary") : null;
    if (go && go.checkVisibility()) go.focus();
    else if (menu) menu.focus();
  };
  const undoRemoval = (id) => stopRemoval(id, { line: { tone: "kept", text: "Not removed" } }, true);
  const startRemoval = (s, item) => {
    const id = Number(s.id);
    if (removals.has(id)) return;
    const r = { song: s, left: REMOVE_WAIT, timer: 0, brief: "Checking what goes…", key: null, ready: null,
                spot: item && !isOwn(s, item) ? item : null, held: new Set() };
    removals.set(id, r);
    let undo = null;
    for (const at of removalItems(id, r)) {
      const made = countdownIn(at, r);
      if (at === item) undo = made;
    }
    if (undo) undo.focus();
    // The question alone: what goes. It changes nothing; the removal is sent once the seconds are over. Both name
    // the song by the line's identity too, never by what the server answers: an id another song has since the page
    // was made removes nothing (409).
    r.ready = postTo("/remove", new URLSearchParams({ csrf: String(server.csrf || ""), song: String(id),
                                                      identity: String(s.identity || "") }))
      .then((answer) => {
        const plan = answer.ok && answer.body && answer.body.removal;
        if (!plan || typeof plan !== "object") throw failure(answer);
        r.key = String(s.identity || plan.key || "");
        r.brief = String(plan.brief || "");
        eachLine(id, r, ".goes", r.brief);
      }, () => { throw UNREACHABLE; });
    r.ready.catch((said) => {
      if (removals.get(id) === r) stopRemoval(id, said && said.line ? said : UNREACHABLE, false);
    });
    const tick = () => {
      if (removals.get(id) !== r) return;
      r.left -= 1;
      if (r.left > 0) {
        eachLine(id, r, ".left", String(r.left));
        r.timer = setTimeout(tick, REMOVE_SECOND);
      } else {
        sendRemoval(id, r);
      }
    };
    r.timer = setTimeout(tick, REMOVE_SECOND);
  };
  // The seconds are over: the removal, sent with the line's key (an id the library gave another song since
  // removes nothing); its line follows the job from here, as tall as it was, so that nothing under it moves.
  const sendRemoval = (id, r) => {
    for (const item of removalItems(id, r)) {
      const p = progressIn(item);
      const tall = p.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      if (tall) p.style.minHeight = tall + "px";
      showLine(p, { line: { tone: "running", text: "Removing…" } });
    }
    r.ready.then(() => {
      if (removals.get(id) !== r) return;
      const body = new URLSearchParams({ csrf: String(server.csrf || ""), song: String(id), key: r.key || "",
                                         confirm: "1" });
      postTo("/remove", body).then((answer) => {
        const view = answer.ok && answer.body && answer.body.job;
        if (!view || typeof view !== "object") {
          stopRemoval(id, failure(answer), false);
          return;
        }
        removals.delete(id);
        removing.add(id);
        if (r.spot) spots.set(Number(view.id), r.spot);
        track(view);
      }, () => stopRemoval(id, UNREACHABLE, false));
    }, () => {});  // refused already: its line says why
  };

  // --- caracole serve: requests answered on the page ------------------------------------------
  // The forms post with fetch(), so the page stays where it is, and each song's line says on a line of its own how
  // its request goes. /jobs.json gives each request's line, and its song's data once it is over; the page asks
  // it every POLL ms while one it shows waits or runs. Without JavaScript the forms post as forms, and the
  // server sends the browser to the request in the Requests tab (requests.js).
  const POLL = paced("poll", 1500);
  const BACKGROUND_POLL = 6000;  // a page in a background tab asks less often
  const UNREACHABLE = { line: { tone: "failed", text: "No answer from caracole serve. Is it running?" } };
  const UNREACHABLE_NOW = "No answer from caracole serve. Trying again…";
  const MISSES = 3;  // asked in vain this many times in a row, the lines say so
  const views = new Map();  // job id -> what the server last said of it
  const songJob = new Map();  // song id -> the newest job of the song this page shows
  const watched = new Set();  // the jobs this page shows: asked for here, or waiting or running when it loaded
  const settled = new Set();  // watched jobs that are over, their lines drawn again
  const spots = new Map();  // job id -> what shows it outside the list (a result's row, #requested's line)
  const byIndex = new Map(songs.map((s, i) => [Number(s.id), i]));  // song id -> its place in songs
  const isActive = (view) => view.state === "queued" || view.state === "running";
  const jobOfSong = (id) => (songJob.has(Number(id)) ? views.get(songJob.get(Number(id))) : null);
  // Whether node is the song's own line in the list, which the page draws again itself; any other (#requested's,
  // a result's row) is a spot of the job's.
  const isOwn = (s, node) => {
    const i = byIndex.get(Number(s.id));
    return i !== undefined && lines.get(i) === node;
  };
  // A request's line, written into p only when it changed, so a screen reader hears each change once.
  // Its link says where to go next; details, the request's output in the Requests tab, follows it. ``onLine``: a
  // song's line or a result's row (showRequest), where a lookup that runs, with its steps (the view's ``steps``, none
  // for its first second, outcome.py's BAR_AFTER), is a bar of them in place of its words (p ``barred``): a segment a
  // step, then the step in hand, its site and its place, "Sheet · Ultimate Guitar · 3 of 7" (``at``, ``count``),
  // which is what a screen reader hears; while a nightly run holds the book (``waits``), "Waiting for the book · 1 of
  // 7", the step drawn waiting. Anywhere else (the tray, a set list) and once it is over, its words.
  // A request that waits, on a served page (the view's id): Cancel beside its place takes it out of the queue
  // (POST /jobs/cancel, the Journal's), never one that runs. Answered, the line says Cancelled, as the next view does;
  // refused or unanswered, what went wrong, and the next view draws the line again.
  const cancelButton = (p, view) => {
    const b = el("button", "cancel", "Cancel");
    b.type = "button";
    b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Cancel " + String(view.display || "request"));
    b.addEventListener("click", () => {
      b.disabled = true;
      postTo("/jobs/cancel", new URLSearchParams({ csrf: String(server.csrf || ""), job: String(view.id) })).then(
        (answer) => showLine(p, answer.ok ? { line: { tone: "cancelled", text: "Cancelled" } } : failure(answer), true),
        () => showLine(p, UNREACHABLE, true));
    });
    return b;
  };
  const showLine = (p, view, onLine) => {
    const line = view && view.line && typeof view.line === "object" ? view.line : {};
    const to = line.link && typeof line.link === "object" ? line.link : null;
    const more = typeof line.details === "string" ? line.details : "";
    const chips = chipsOf(view);
    const barred = Boolean(onLine && line.tone === "running" && view && isActive(view) && chips.length);
    const cancels = Boolean(onLine && server && line.tone === "queued" && view && view.state === "queued"
      && Number.isInteger(view.id));
    const key = (barred ? ["bar", JSON.stringify(chips.map((c) => [c.name, c.site, c.state])), view.at, view.count,
      view.waits === true] : [line.tone, line.text, to ? to.href : "", more, cancels ? view.id : ""]).map(String).join("|");
    if (p.dataset.key === key) return;
    const focused = p !== document.activeElement && p.contains(document.activeElement);
    p.dataset.key = key;
    p.dataset.tone = String(line.tone || "");
    p.classList.toggle("barred", barred);
    if (barred) {
      const shown = waitsIn(chips, view);
      p.replaceChildren(segsOf(shown), ...stepWords(shown, view));
      if (focused) focusOn(p);
      return;
    }
    p.textContent = "";
    p.appendChild(el("span", null, line.text || ""));
    for (const go of [to, more ? { label: "Details", href: more } : null]) {
      if (!go) continue;
      const dot = el("span", "dot", "·");
      dot.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      p.appendChild(dot);
      const a = link(go, null, false);
      if (go === to) a.addEventListener("click", (e) => pickHere(e, p));
      p.appendChild(a);
    }
    if (cancels) {
      const dot = el("span", "dot", "·");
      dot.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      p.append(dot, cancelButton(p, view));
    }
    if (focused) focusOn(p);  // its link is gone: the focus stays on the line
  };
  // A request's steps (the view's ``steps``: outcome.py's, each its name, the site it names in full, ``site``, its
  // state and what it found), those that are steps at all.
  const STEP_STATES = ["waiting", "running", "done", "failed", "plain", "skipped"];
  const stepState = (c) => (STEP_STATES.indexOf(c.state) >= 0 ? String(c.state) : "waiting");
  const chipsOf = (view) => listOf(view && view.steps).filter((c) => c && typeof c === "object" && c.name);
  // The bar's segments (steps.css's), one a step in its state, a failed one with its "!": for the eye alone, as the
  // words beside them say how it goes.
  const segsOf = (chips) => {
    const segs = el("span", "step-segs");
    segs.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    for (const c of chips) {
      const state = stepState(c);
      segs.appendChild(el("i", "seg " + state, state === "failed" ? "!" : null));
    }
    return segs;
  };
  // The words beside the bar: the step in hand (the view's ``at``), its site, and its place among them all
  // (``count``, "3 of 7"); none when the view names no step in hand. While it waits for the book (``waits``), the
  // wait in place of the step's name.
  const WAITS = "Waiting for the book";
  const stepWords = (chips, view) => {
    const at = view ? view.at : null;
    if (!Number.isInteger(at) || at < 0 || at >= chips.length || typeof view.count !== "string") return [];
    const c = chips[at];
    const words = el("span", "step-at");
    words.appendChild(el("b", null, view.waits === true ? WAITS : String(c.name)));
    if (c.site) words.append(" · " + String(c.site));
    return [words, el("span", "step-count", " · " + view.count)];
  };
  // The steps as the bar draws them: while a nightly run holds the book (the view's ``waits``, outcome.py's), the step
  // in hand waiting, unlit and steady, as nothing moves.
  const waitsIn = (chips, view) => (view && view.waits === true && Number.isInteger(view.at) && chips[view.at]
    ? chips.map((c, i) => (i === view.at ? Object.assign({}, c, { state: "waiting" }) : c)) : chips);
  // A lookup's steps under its request line ``p`` (steps.css's ``div.steps``, the one sibling right after it, which
  // refill keeps): once ``p`` is no longer the bar (the request ended otherwise than Ready, or its line says something
  // else), the bar as it left them, frozen (``.step-bar``: its segments, and the step that failed first and its place,
  // "Sheet · LaCuerda · 3 of 7"), for a screen reader a picture its name says ("Steps: Song: done; …"); then always the
  // list of them (stepList), which shows while the line's card is open, in the frozen bar's place. No live region: the
  // line says how it goes; these are to look at and read. None in the view (a request that runs no lookup, or ended
  // Ready, its steps folded away): none drawn. A line with no steps is no bar either (a removal counting down draws its
  // own words in p).
  const stepsAfter = (p) => (p && p.nextElementSibling && p.nextElementSibling.classList.contains("steps")
    ? p.nextElementSibling : null);
  const stepSaid = (c) => {
    const state = stepState(c);
    return String(c.name) + (c.site ? ", " + String(c.site) : "") + ": " + (state === "plain" ? "done" : state);
  };
  const drawSteps = (p, view) => {
    const chips = chipsOf(view);
    let box = stepsAfter(p);
    if (!chips.length) {
      p.classList.remove("barred");
      if (box) box.remove();
      if (selected && p.parentNode === selected) showSteps();
      return;
    }
    const barred = p.classList.contains("barred");
    const over = !isActive(view);
    const shown = waitsIn(chips, view);
    const key = JSON.stringify([shown.map((c) => [c.name, c.site, c.state, c.found]), barred, over, view.at,
      view.count, view.waits === true]);
    if (box && box.dataset.key === key) return;
    if (!box) {
      box = el("div", "steps");
      p.after(box);
    }
    box.dataset.key = key;
    const parts = [];
    if (!barred) {
      const bar = el("div", "step-bar");
      bar.setAttribute("role", "img");
      bar.setAttribute("aria-label", "Steps: " + shown.map(stepSaid).join("; "));
      bar.append(segsOf(shown), ...stepWords(shown, view));
      parts.push(bar);
    }
    parts.push(stepList(shown, over));
    box.replaceChildren(...parts);
    if (selected && p.parentNode === selected) showSteps();  // its card in the pane: listed there
  };
  // A request's steps as a list (``ol.step-list``, steps.css's), one line a step in its place: its mark, for the eye
  // alone (done and plain ✓, the one that runs ◐ and the current step, those to come ○, a skipped one –, a failed one
  // !), its name and the site it names, its state for a screen reader right after them (a plain one, "Match · not on
  // UG", done), and what it found. ``over``: the request is over, and its skipped steps, which had nothing to do for the
  // song, leave their places for one last line, "Skipped: PDF, Songbooks". The one function that draws a list of
  // steps: the open card's (drawSteps) and the Journal's (requests.js, through window.caracoleLibrary).
  const STEP_GLYPHS = { done: "✓", plain: "✓", running: "◐", waiting: "○", skipped: "–", failed: "!" };
  const stepList = (chips, over) => {
    const steps = el("ol", "step-list");
    steps.setAttribute("aria-label", "Steps");
    const skipped = [];
    for (const c of listOf(chips).filter((x) => x && typeof x === "object" && x.name)) {
      const state = stepState(c);
      if (over && state === "skipped") {
        skipped.push(String(c.name));
        continue;
      }
      const item = steps.appendChild(el("li", "step " + state));
      if (state === "running") item.setAttribute("aria-current", "step");
      item.appendChild(el("span", "step-glyph", STEP_GLYPHS[state])).setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      const name = item.appendChild(el("span", "step-name"));
      name.appendChild(el("b", null, String(c.name)));
      if (c.site) name.append(" · " + String(c.site));
      item.appendChild(el("span", "visually-hidden", ": " + (state === "plain" ? "done" : state)));
      if (c.found) item.appendChild(el("span", "step-found", String(c.found)));
    }
    if (skipped.length) {
      const item = steps.appendChild(el("li", "step skipped-all"));
      item.appendChild(el("span", "step-glyph", STEP_GLYPHS.skipped)).setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      item.append("Skipped: " + skipped.join(", "));
    }
    return steps;
  };
  // How a song's request goes on its line, a result's row or #requested's line under the search box: its request
  // line, a bar of its lookup's steps while it runs, and the steps under it once it ended otherwise than Ready. Ended
  // Ready, the steps fold away and the line's words are for a screen reader alone (rows.css), which hears the request
  // end: the line is the song's, its buttons opening what it holds now. The focus, if the request line had it (Fetch
  // now hands it there), goes to the first of them (a row's, a line's action that is a link: its Open).
  const showRequest = (item, view) => {
    const p = progressIn(item);
    showLine(p, view, true);
    drawSteps(p, view);
    if (p.dataset.tone === "ready" && p === document.activeElement) {
      const open = item.querySelector(".line-plays a") || item.querySelector(".line-action a, .row-action a");
      if (open) open.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    return p;
  };
  // A song in review's line sends you to its picker (review?song=ID): on a line whose card has the picker (canPick),
  // it opens that one, where you are, rather than the picker's own page. The list of requests has none: it goes there.
  const pickHere = (e, p) => {
    const item = itemOf(p);
    const s = item ? shownSongs.get(item) : null;
    const href = e.currentTarget.getAttribute("href") || "";
    if (!s || !canPick(s) || !/^review\?song=\d+$/.test(href)) return;
    if (showPicker(item)) e.preventDefault();
  };
  // A line's card (its chevron's panel, wherever the page puts it: under the line, or in the laptop's pane; its
  // chevron's ``aria-controls`` names it), opened or closed by its chevron, as a hand would, unless it is so already:
  // opened the first time, it is made (cardFor). None for an item with no chevron.
  const chevronOf = (item) => (item ? item.querySelector(":scope > .line-more") : null);
  const pane = byId("card-pane");  // from 1200 px, beside the list: the card of the line selected (selectLine)
  let selected = null;  // the line whose card the pane holds
  const cardOf = (item) => {
    const more = chevronOf(item);
    if (!more) return null;
    const id = more.getAttribute("aria-controls");
    const near = (box) => (box ? Array.from(box.children).find((c) => c.id === id) || null : null);
    return near(item) || near(pane) || (item.isConnected && document.getElementById(id)) || null;
  };
  // The line a node is part of: its own, or, for a node in the pane, the line whose card it holds.
  const itemOf = (node) => (node && node.closest ? node.closest("article") : null)
    || (pane && node && pane.contains(node) ? selected : null);
  // A line and, when it is elsewhere (in the pane), its card: where the line's forms and buttons are.
  const partsOf = (item) => {
    if (!item) return [];
    const card = cardOf(item);
    return card && !item.contains(card) ? [item, card] : [item];
  };
  // The first node ``selector`` finds in the line or its card, wherever that is.
  const inItem = (item, selector) => {
    for (const part of partsOf(item)) {
      const found = part.querySelector(selector);
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return null;
  };
  const openCard = (item) => {
    const more = chevronOf(item);
    if (more && more.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true") more.click();
    return cardOf(item);
  };
  const closeCard = (item) => {
    const more = chevronOf(item);
    if (more && more.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true") more.click();
  };
  // Opens a line's picker where it is, in its card, which opens first (made, the first time). Opened, the picker
  // takes the focus to its first candidate (its toggle); open already, the focus goes there. Whether its card has a
  // picker to pick with.
  const showPicker = (item) => {
    const shown = openCard(item);
    const box = shown && shown.querySelector("details.picker");
    if (!box || !box.querySelector("form")) return false;
    if (!box.open) {
      box.open = true;
      return true;
    }
    const first = box.querySelector("input[name=pick]:checked") || box.querySelector("input[name=pick]");
    if (first) first.focus();
    return true;
  };
  const focusOn = (p) => {
    p.tabIndex = -1;
    p.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  };
  // A song's request line, made the first time: role="status" has it read out when it changes. A live region
  // put in the page with its text already in it is not read out, so a song's line (or a result's row) keeps its
  // request line from the first text to the last (refill), and only that text changes.
  const progressIn = (item) => {
    let p = item.querySelector(".progress");
    if (!p) {
      p = el("p", "progress");
      p.setAttribute("role", "status");
      // A line of its own across the song's line, under its status (a row's, under its artist).
      const after = item.querySelector(":scope > .line-meta") || item.querySelector(".row-sub") ||
        item.querySelector(".row-title");
      if (after) after.after(p);
      else item.appendChild(p);
    }
    return p;
  };
  // The line old, drawn again as fresh (lineFor's) where it is, around its own request line, which never leaves
  // the page, and its steps under it, which the request's next view draws again; returns the line. The focus, if it was
  // on something of old's that goes, moves to that line. Opened, it stays open (its card made again, from fresh's song),
  // a drawer of its card closed; closed, its card waits to be made until it opens. Its card in the pane (old selected),
  // fresh's takes its place there, opened; a line with no card (a song gone) leaves the pane empty (placeAgain).
  const refill = (old, fresh) => {
    const was = chevronOf(old);

    if (was && was.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true") openCard(fresh);
    if (was) awayGone(was);  // it leaves the page: fresh's is watched in its place
    if (shownSongs.has(fresh)) shownSongs.set(old, shownSongs.get(fresh));
    else shownSongs.delete(old);
    const kept = old.querySelector(".progress");
    placedAt.delete(old);  // its buttons placed again, as it is now
    if (!kept) {
      if (old.parentNode) old.replaceWith(fresh);
      if (shown) placeAgain(old, fresh, shown);
      placePlaysSoon();
      return fresh;
    }
    const at = document.activeElement;
    const focused = at !== old && old.contains(at) && !kept.contains(at);  // on something that goes
    const steps = stepsAfter(kept);
    const drawn = progressIn(fresh);  // where fresh has its line
    const freshSteps = stepsAfter(drawn);
    for (const child of Array.from(old.childNodes)) if (child !== kept && child !== steps) child.remove();
    let before = true;
    for (const child of Array.from(fresh.childNodes)) {
      if (child === drawn) before = false;
      else if (child === freshSteps) continue;  // old's stay where they are
      else if (before) old.insertBefore(child, kept);

    old.tabIndex = fresh.tabIndex;
    for (const name of Object.keys(old.dataset)) delete old.dataset[name];

    if (focused && old.isConnected) focusOn(kept);

    return old;
  };
  const failure = (answer) => ({ line: { tone: "failed", text: (answer.body && answer.body.error) ||

  const postTo = (path, body) => fetch(path, {

  const unpicked = (s) => {

  let searchFor = () => {};
  let setProg = () => {};
  // The line over the list while it shows a progression's songs alone: "Songs with I–V–vi–IV, the pop progression ·
  // Show all".
  const drawProg = () => {
    progLine.hidden = !state.prog;
    if (progLine.dataset.prog === state.prog) return;

    progLine.replaceChildren();
    if (!state.prog) return;
    progLine.append("Songs with " + progSaid(state.prog) + " · ", button("Show all", "small", () => {
      state.prog = "";
      render();
      save();
      focusList();
    }, "Show every song, not only " + progNumerals(state.prog)));
  };
  // The song's progressions, as it plays them, for its card: each shows the songs that play it too.
  const progressionsOf = (s) => card.progressions(progsOf(s).map((p) => ({ text: String(p.plays || progLabel(p.key)),
    said: "Songs with " + progSaid(p.key), go: () => setProg(p.key) })));

  // Lines: a song a line (resultRow's dense form, from ROWS_SCRIPT: the seam the module docstring describes), in
  // its artist's group. A line is an article titled by its h3; the A-Z strip moves the focus to its group.
  // A song's main action on its line when the server's control holds the line's button (``held``): a wanted

  // line then says how it goes. Not held, none: what the song holds has a button each after its title (card.js
  // plays), on the file too. ``pickable``: its card's picker picks (canPick).
  const serverAction = (s, pickable) => {
    const held = (action) => ({ held: true, action });
    if (server && removing.has(Number(s.id))) {
      const job = jobOfSong(s.id);
      if (job && job.kind === "remove") return held(null);
      const going = el("a", "line-busy", "Removing…");
      going.href = "#tab=requests";
      going.title = "See requests";
      return held(going);
    }
    if (server && s.status === "wanted") {
      const job = jobOfSong(s.id);
      if ((job && isActive(job)) || busy.has(Number(s.id))) return held(null);

        pick.type = "button";

        pick.title = "Which UG song is this";
        pick.addEventListener("click", () => showPicker(pick.closest("article")));

      }
      if (s.fetchable === false) return held(reviewFirst("btn small"));
      return held(fetchForm(s));
    }
    return { held: false, action: null };
  };
  // A line's one word for where its song stands, when it needs something or isn't plainly yours: Needs review, Wanted
  // or Ignored. A song found, nearly every one, says nothing: null; nor does one UG's index has nothing for, whose
  // sites' marks say which site has what (``sites``).
  const statusOf = (s) => (SHOWS.review(s) ? { kind: "review", text: "Needs review" }
    : s.notFound && s.status === "wanted" ? null
    : s.status === "found" ? null
    : { kind: s.status, text: label(STATUS_TEXT, s.status) || s.status });
  // What a song holds, for its line's glyphs (rows.js ``holds``), read from its files and its instruments: its sheet
  // (the auto one, when it has no other; UG's Ukulele Chords), a Guitar Pro file or else a text tab, a harmonica tab,
  // its lyrics and a score you filed.
  const holdingsOf = (s) => {
    const names = listOf(s.files).map((f) => String((f && f.name) || ""));
    const has = (pattern) => names.some((n) => pattern.test(n));
    const plays = (x) => listOf(s.instruments).indexOf(x) >= 0;
    const holds = [];
    if (s.auto === true) holds.push("auto");
    else if (has(/^sheet[.](html|pdf|txt|cho)$/)) holds.push(plays("ukulele") ? "ukulele" : "sheet");
    if (has(/^guitar-\d+[.]/)) holds.push("guitar");
    else if (names.indexOf("tab.txt") >= 0 || has(/^gametab-\d+[.]txt$/)) holds.push("tab");
    if (plays("harmonica")) holds.push("harmonica");
    if (has(/^lyrics[.](txt|lrc)$/)) holds.push("lyrics");
    if (plays("score")) holds.push("score");
    return holds;
  };
  // What a song has something for, as the Filter panel asks it (``inst=``, any of them): its closed line's holds,
  // read the same way: a chord sheet (the auto one, UG's Ukulele Chords), a guitar's (a Guitar Pro file or a text
  // tab), and, from its instruments, UG's Ukulele Chords, a harmonica tab and a score you filed.
  const INSTRUMENTS = ["sheet", "guitar", "ukulele", "harmonica", "score"];
  const instruments = new WeakMap();  // a song's data -> what it has something for, until the data changes
  const instOf = (s) => {
    if (!instruments.has(s)) {
      const holds = holdingsOf(s);
      const plays = listOf(s.instruments);
      const has = new Set();
      if (holds.some((h) => h === "sheet" || h === "auto" || h === "ukulele")) has.add("sheet");
      if (holds.indexOf("guitar") >= 0 || holds.indexOf("tab") >= 0) has.add("guitar");
      for (const x of ["ukulele", "harmonica", "score"]) if (plays.indexOf(x) >= 0) has.add(x);
      instruments.set(s, has);
    }
    return instruments.get(s);
  };

  const instList = (names) => INSTRUMENTS.filter((x) => names.indexOf(x) >= 0).join(",");
  // Each as a tag names it, and as a sentence does ("with a harmonica tab or a score").
  const INST_TAG = { sheet: "Chord sheet", guitar: "Guitar tab", ukulele: "Ukulele", harmonica: "Harmonica",
    score: "Score" };
  const INST_SAID = { sheet: "chord sheet", guitar: "guitar tab", ukulele: "ukulele chords",
    harmonica: "harmonica tab", score: "score" };
  // A song's facts, under its line's chevron: the key in words and where it came from, the PDF's transposition, the
  // lyrics, when the song came, and its other artists.
  const factsOf = (s) => {
    const facts = el("p", "facts");
    if (typeof s.key === "string" && s.key) facts.appendChild(el("span", "key", keyText(s)));
    const shift = Number(s.transpose) || 0;
    if (shift) {
      const t = el("span", "transpose", (shift > 0 ? "+" : "−") + Math.abs(shift));
      t.title = "PDF transposed " + (shift > 0 ? "up " : "down ") + Math.abs(shift) +
        " semitone" + (Math.abs(shift) === 1 ? "" : "s");

    if (s.added) facts.appendChild(el("span", "added", "Added " + shortDate(s.added)));
    const others = listOf(s.artists).slice(1).map(String);
