  // library since (Get it, a request) has none until the page is loaded again, as it would do nothing.
  const bookButton = (s) => {

  const versionsForm = (s, action, label, aria, title, fields) => {

  // that LaCuerda sheet. From the file, which can ask nothing, the command that fetches the versions not kept.
  const drawerActs = (s) => {
    if (!server) return { keepMoreCommand: "caracole versions --keep-more " + shellNames(String(s.display)) };
    const id = Number(s.id);
    const title = String(s.title);
    const names = title + " by " + String(s.artist);
    const free = () => {
      const asked = jobOfSong(id);
      return s.status !== "ignored" && !removing.has(id) && !busy.has(id) && !(asked && isActive(asked));
    };
    return {
      choose: (v, ver) => (free() ? versionsForm(s, "/versions/choose", "Use this one", "Use " + ver + " of " + names,
        "Makes it the sheet the title opens: a [pin] in overrides.toml",
        { tab: String(v.tab) }) : null),
      clear: () => (free() ? versionsForm(s, "/versions/clear", "Back to our pick",

        "Takes your choice out of [pin]. We pick the sheet again.") : null),

        if (!free() || !(n > 0)) return null;
        const some = n < rest;
        return versionsForm(s, "/versions/keep-more", some ? "Fetch " + n + " more" : "Fetch them",
          "Fetch " + (some ? n + " more versions" : rest === 1 ? "the version" : "the " + rest + " versions") + " of " +
          title + " from UG",
          "Keeps them beside the sheet, 1 request each");
      },
      useLaCuerda: (x, ver) => (free() ? lookupForm(s, "Use this one", "Use LaCuerda's " + ver + " of " + names,

  };
  // A song's card (card.js), under its line's chevron, which its title opens too, its parts in the phone's order: its
  // head (cardHead), its facts, then what needs you (its picker or what to do about its match, where its audio comes
  // from, a LaCuerda pick, Look in the index), what you play from it as tiles and their versions' drawer, its foot
  // (Fetch again, Use LaCuerda's sheet, Add to a songbook…, info.json, Remove), its other files, which sites have it,
  // where else to find it and its progressions. Made the first time the chevron opens it (rows.js foldMore), once a
  // line, from the song and its request as they are then: a card first opened while the song's request waits or runs

  // buttons waiting with the line's (countdownIn). ``chevron``: its line's, which its head's close presses.
  const cardFor = (s, chevron) => {

    if (facts) more.push(facts);

    const picker = SHOWS.review(s) && listOf(s.candidates).length > 0 ? makePicker(s) : null;
    if (picker) {

    if (fromVideo) more.push(fromVideo);
    const transcribe = server ? transcribeOffer(s) : null;
    if (transcribe) more.push(transcribe);
    const picked = lacuerdaNote(s);
    if (picked) more.push(picked);
    if (server && s.notFound && s.status === "wanted" && !removing.has(id)) {
      const look = el("div", "actions");
      look.appendChild(lookLink(s, "btn small"));
      more.push(look);
    }
    // What you play from it, and every file a tile shows: the rest, any, a group of their own.
    const claimed = new Set();
    const shown = card.tiles(s, { guitar: Boolean(server && server.guitar), acts: drawerActs(s), claimed });
    if (shown) more.push(shown);
    const info = listOf(s.files).find((f) => f && f.name === "info.json") || null;
    const asked = server ? jobOfSong(id) : null;
    const again = server && !removing.has(id) && !busy.has(id) && !(asked && isActive(asked)) ? againActions(s) : null;
    const foot = card.foot(s, { actions: [again], book: byIndex.has(id) ? bookButton(s) : null, info,
      remove: server && !removing.has(id) ? removeForm(s) : null });  // removing: its action says so
    if (foot) more.push(foot);
    const others = listOf(s.files).filter((f) => f && !claimed.has(f) && f !== info);
    if (others.length) more.push({ heading: "Files", links: others });
    if (server && !server.guitar && listOf(s.files).some((f) => f && typeof f.guitarPage === "string" && f.guitarPage)) {
      more.push(el("p", "note", "Guitar Pro files are downloads until caracole serve has alphaTab " +
        "(CARACOLE_ALPHATAB_DIR)."));
    }
    const sites = card.sites(listOf(s.sites));  // which sites have it, had nothing, or weren't asked yet
    if (sites) more.push(sites);
    const elsewhere = card.findElsewhere([{ heading: "Find the chords", links: s.links },
      { heading: "Scores on MuseScore", links: s.museScore }, { heading: "Buy the track, for an auto sheet", links: s.buy }]);
    if (elsewhere) more.push(elsewhere);
    const progs = progressionsOf(s);

    const r = removals.get(id);  // counting down: its buttons wait as the line's do, until it is undone
    if (r) for (const part of more) if (part instanceof Element) holdForms(part, r);

  };
  // A card's head: the song's name and artist, as the line shows them, and a close button. In place it shows only
  // once the whole of its line is under the bar kept at the top (watchAway), and a screen reader never hears it there
  // (the line says the same, so it hears it once), the chevron the keyboard's way to close; the pane's heading, its
  // button closing the card. Its close presses the chevron of the line it is on now (refill moves it into the line
  // drawn before), and gives that chevron the focus.
  const cardHead = (s, chevron) => {
    const head = el("div", "card-head");
    head.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    const inner = head.appendChild(el("div", "card-head-in"));
    const title = shownName(s, s.title);
    const name = inner.appendChild(el("h2", "card-name", title));
    name.id = "card-name-" + s.id;
    const artists = listOf(s.artists);
    const by = artists.length > 1 ? artists.join(", ") : shownName(s, s.artist);
    if (by) name.appendChild(el("span", "card-by", " \u00b7 " + by));
    const close = inner.appendChild(el("button", "card-close"));
    close.type = "button";
    close.setAttribute("aria-label", "Close " + String(title));
    close.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
    close.appendChild(glyphFor("close"));
    close.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (!chevron) return;
      const fromPane = Boolean(pane && pane.contains(close));
      closeCard(chevron.parentNode);
      chevron.focus({ preventScroll: !fromPane });  // the line's own close, where the head's was; from the pane, in view
    });
    return head;
  };
  // While a card open in place is on the screen, and its line, all of it (the title's row, the request's line and its
  // steps), is under the bar kept at the top, its head shows, stuck under the bar (``head-away`` on the card,
  // library.css), so that it never lies over a part of the line still showing. One IntersectionObserver, whose screen
  // begins under the bar (its height, which the bar's ResizeObserver gives it), watches each card open in place and the
  // mark at the top of it (``.card-top``, library.css: where the card begins, under the line): the head shows while the
  // mark is above that screen and the card still in it. It reads no layout. A card closed in place, however it was,
  // brings its line back into view, under the bar (its scroll-margin-top, library-screens.css), with no motion where
  // less is asked for.
  const awayCards = new Map();  // a chevron -> its card open in place: { card, top, above, on }
  const awayOf = new Map();  // a card, or the mark at its top -> its chevron
  let awayWatch = null;
  const awayGone = (chevron) => {
    const away = awayCards.get(chevron);
    if (!away) return;
    away.card.classList.remove("head-away");
    awayCards.delete(chevron);
    for (const target of [away.card, away.top]) {
      awayOf.delete(target);
      if (awayWatch) awayWatch.unobserve(target);
    }
  };
  // A line a search leaves out keeps its card open, and its card watched for when it shows again.
  const awaySeen = (seen) => {
    for (const entry of seen) {
      const away = awayCards.get(awayOf.get(entry.target));
      if (!away) continue;
      if (entry.target === away.card) away.on = entry.isIntersecting;
      else away.above = !entry.isIntersecting && Boolean(entry.rootBounds)
        && entry.boundingClientRect.top < entry.rootBounds.top;
      away.card.classList.toggle("head-away", away.card.isConnected && away.above && away.on);
    }
  };
  const watchAway = (barHeight) => {
    if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window)) return;
    if (awayWatch) awayWatch.disconnect();
    awayWatch = new IntersectionObserver(awaySeen, { rootMargin: "-" + Math.round(barHeight) + "px 0px 0px 0px" });
    for (const target of awayOf.keys()) awayWatch.observe(target);
  };
  // A card open in place, watched for its head (above).
  const watchInPlace = (card, chevron) => {
    let top = card.querySelector(":scope > .card-top");
    if (!top) {
      top = card.appendChild(el("span", "card-top"));
      top.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    }
    awayGone(chevron);
    awayCards.set(chevron, { card, top, above: false, on: false });
    for (const target of [card, top]) {
      awayOf.set(target, chevron);
      if (awayWatch) awayWatch.observe(target);
    }
  };
  // --- the laptop's pane (body.html #card-pane, library.css) --------------------------------------------------------
  // From 1200 px a song's line opened (its chevron, its title) is selected: its card leaves the line for the pane
  // beside the list (selectLine), the line marked (.selected, aria-current), the card's head the pane's heading, heard,
  // its close a stop of Tab's, the pane named by it; opened by the keyboard (Enter or Space on the chevron), the focus
  // goes to the song's name there. Closed (its chevron again, the head's close, another line's opened, its line gone
  // from the list), the card goes back under its line's chevron, closed, and the pane says what it is for (unselect).
  // Narrower than 1200 px the card in the pane goes back under its line, open; wider, the card opened last of those
  // open under their lines goes to the pane, and the others close. Escape in the pane, one the card's own parts left,
  // gives the focus back to the line's chevron, the card staying where it is. A card, opened or closed, is no step of
  // the browser's history, at any width.
  const paneEmpty = pane ? pane.querySelector(".pane-empty") : null;
  const paneWide = pane && window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia("(min-width: 1200px)") : null;
  const paneSteps = el("div", "steps pane-steps");
  const headOf = (card) => card.querySelector(":scope > .card-head");
  // The card's head: the pane's heading (``on``: heard, its close a stop of Tab's, its name where the keyboard lands),
  // or, in place, the screen reader's never.
  const asHeading = (card, on) => {
    const head = headOf(card);
    if (!head) return;
    if (on) head.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
    else head.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    const close = head.querySelector(".card-close");
    if (close && on) close.removeAttribute("tabindex");
    else if (close) close.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
    const name = head.querySelector(".card-name");
    if (name && on) name.tabIndex = -1;
    else if (name) name.removeAttribute("tabindex");
  };
  // The selected line's steps, listed under its card's head in the pane: a copy of the list drawSteps keeps under the
  // line (steps.css shows it there while the card is open in place; the selected line shows its frozen bar instead).
  const showSteps = () => {
    const card = selected ? cardOf(selected) : null;
    const list = selected ? selected.querySelector(":scope > .steps > .step-list") : null;
    if (!card || !list || card.parentNode !== pane) {
      paneSteps.remove();
      paneSteps.replaceChildren();
      return;
    }
    paneSteps.replaceChildren(list.cloneNode(true));
    const head = headOf(card);
    if (head) head.after(paneSteps);
    else card.prepend(paneSteps);
  };
  // ``line`` selected, its ``card`` in the pane already.
  const toPane = (line, card) => {
    selected = line;
    pane.style.minHeight = "";
    const more = chevronOf(line);
    if (more) awayGone(more);  // no more in place
    line.classList.add("selected");
    line.setAttribute("aria-current", "true");
    asHeading(card, true);
    const name = card.querySelector(".card-name");
    if (name) pane.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", name.id);
    paneEmpty.hidden = true;
    showSteps();
  };
  // The focus on a node of a card that moves (crossing 1200 px: a node moved loses it) given back to it, else (one that
  // can't take it there: the head's close, hidden in place) to ``instead``. Crossing down, the pane is hidden, and the
  // browser blurs its node, before the media query's change is heard: a node of a card that lost the focus to nothing
  // is remembered for two frames (``blurred``), which a deliberate click elsewhere then outlasts.
  let blurred = null;
  document.addEventListener("focusout", (e) => {
    const node = e.target instanceof Element && !e.relatedTarget && e.target.closest(".song-card") ? e.target : null;
    blurred = node;
    if (node) requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (blurred === node) blurred = null; }));
  });
  document.addEventListener("focusin", () => { blurred = null; });
  const focusIn = (card) => (!card ? null : card.contains(document.activeElement) ? document.activeElement
    : blurred && card.contains(blurred) ? blurred : null);
  const focusAgain = (node, instead) => {
    if (!node || document.activeElement === node) return;
    node.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    if (document.activeElement !== node && instead && instead.isConnected) instead.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  };
  const selectLine = (line, card, byKeyboard) => {
    if (selected && selected !== line) closeCard(selected);  // its chevron's click puts its card back (unselect)
    if (selected && selected !== line) unselect();
    const focused = focusIn(card);  // open in place before
    pane.appendChild(card);
    pane.scrollTop = 0;
    toPane(line, card);
    const name = card.querySelector(".card-name");
    if (byKeyboard && name) name.focus();
    else focusAgain(focused, name);
  };
  const unselect = (how) => {
    const line = selected;
    if (!line) return;
    const keepOpen = Boolean(how && how.keepOpen);
    const card = cardOf(line);
    const more = chevronOf(line);
    const focused = focusIn(card);
    selected = null;
    showSteps();  // out of the card
    line.classList.remove("selected");
    line.removeAttribute("aria-current");
    if (card && card.parentNode === pane) {
      asHeading(card, false);
      if (more) more.after(card);
      else line.appendChild(card);
      card.hidden = !keepOpen;
    }
    if (more && !keepOpen) more.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    if (more && keepOpen && card) watchInPlace(card, more);
    pane.removeAttribute("aria-labelledby");
    paneEmpty.hidden = false;
    if (focused && keepOpen) focusAgain(focused, more);  // open under its line now
    else if (focused && more && more.isConnected) more.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  };
  // A selected line drawn again (refill): ``line``, old or fresh, with its new card, opened, in the old one's place in
  // the pane (``shown``); with none (a song gone, seconds after Remove), the pane empty, as tall as it was until it
  // holds another card, so that nothing on the screen moves but the line.
  const placeAgain = (old, line, shown) => {
    const had = shown.contains(document.activeElement);
    const more = chevronOf(line);
    const card = more && more.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true" ? cardOf(line) : null;
    if (old !== line) {
      old.classList.remove("selected");
      old.removeAttribute("aria-current");
    }
    if (!card) {
      const tall = pane.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      if (tall) pane.style.minHeight = tall + "px";
      selected = null;
      showSteps();
      shown.remove();
      line.classList.remove("selected");
      line.removeAttribute("aria-current");
      pane.removeAttribute("aria-labelledby");
      paneEmpty.hidden = false;
      const p = line.querySelector(".progress");
      if (had && p && line.isConnected) focusOn(p);
      return;
    }
    shown.replaceWith(card);
    toPane(line, card);
    const name = card.querySelector(".card-name");
    if (had && name) name.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  };
  // A card closed where it is, quietly (no scroll back to its line), as the pane takes another.
  const shut = (more) => {
    const away = awayCards.get(more);
    const had = Boolean(away && away.card.contains(document.activeElement));
    more.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    if (away) away.card.hidden = true;
    awayGone(more);
    if (had && more.isConnected) more.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  };
  // From 1200 px the card opened last of those open under their lines goes to the pane, and the others close; while
  // another tab shows (no line to see), they stay open where they are until the Library shows again.
  const toWide = () => {
    if (!libraryView.checkVisibility() || selected) return;
    const open = Array.from(awayCards.keys()).reverse();  // the cards open in place, the last opened first
    const last = open.find((more) => more.parentNode && more.parentNode.checkVisibility());
    for (const more of open) if (more !== last) shut(more);
    if (last) selectLine(last.parentNode, awayCards.get(last).card, false);
  };
  // The selected line gone from the list (a search, a filter, the sites' results): its card back under it, closed.
  const keepSelected = () => {
    if (selected && !selected.checkVisibility()) unselect();
  };
  // From 1200 px a folded or flat line's buttons stay on its row while they fit beside its title and its artist, and
  // go on a row of their own under the title where they don't (``plays-under``, library.css): measured in the one row,
  // where they wrap (the last below the first), once a line, and again once the list's width, Select, or the line
  // itself (refill, an action gone) changes; a line hidden is measured once it shows, and a line of a run off the
  // screen (render's runs, which content-visibility leaves unlaid) once its run comes near it, never by laying the
  // run out to read it. Under 1200 px, none.
  const placedAt = new WeakMap();  // a line -> the list's width, the text's size and Select its buttons were placed at
  const unplace = (line) => {  // placed again when it is a folded or flat line beside the pane next
    line.classList.remove("plays-under");
    placedAt.delete(line);
  };
  let playsFrame = 0;
  const PLACED = "section.artist.folded .line, section.flat .line";
  const placeable = (line) => !line.matches(".hit, .miss") && line.querySelector(":scope > .line-title > .line-plays");
  // ``lines`` (folded or flat lines, placeable) placed where they are laid out, or in ``shown`` (runs on the screen),
  // and weren't at this width, text and Select.
  const placeLines = (lines, shown) => {
    const main = libraryView.querySelector(".lib-main");
    const at = [main ? main.clientWidth : 0, getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).fontSize,
      document.body.classList.contains("selecting")].join(" ");
    const todo = lines.filter((line) => placedAt.get(line) !== at
      && (line.checkVisibility({ contentVisibilityAuto: true })
        || Boolean(shown && line.checkVisibility() && shown.has(line.closest(".cv")))));
    for (const line of todo) line.classList.remove("plays-under");
    const wraps = todo.filter((line) => {
      const chips = line.querySelectorAll(":scope > .line-title > .line-plays > .play");
      return chips.length > 1 && chips[chips.length - 1].getBoundingClientRect().top
        > chips[0].getBoundingClientRect().top + 1;
    });
    for (const line of todo) placedAt.set(line, at);
    for (const line of wraps) line.classList.add("plays-under");
  };
  const placePlays = () => {
    if (playsFrame) cancelAnimationFrame(playsFrame);
    playsFrame = 0;
    const under = Array.from(libraryView.querySelectorAll(".line.plays-under"));
    if (!paneWide || !paneWide.matches) {
      for (const line of under) unplace(line);
      return;
    }
    const lines = new Set(Array.from(libraryView.querySelectorAll(PLACED)).filter(placeable));
    for (const line of under) if (!lines.has(line)) unplace(line);  // a band's line now
    // A list just drawn has its runs laid out only as the next frame is made, so the lines that frame shows would be
    // placed a frame after it: the runs whose own box is on the screen (read without laying out what they hold) are
    // laid out now for their lines, as they would be in this frame anyway; never one off the screen.
    const shown = new Set(Array.from(list.querySelectorAll(".cv")).filter((cv) => {
      const box = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
      return box.bottom > 0 && box.top < innerHeight;
    }));
    placeLines(Array.from(lines), shown);
  };
  // Placed once a frame, however many lines a frame draws again (a poll's views, their refills), before it is painted.
  const placePlaysSoon = () => {
    if (!playsFrame) playsFrame = requestAnimationFrame(placePlays);
  };
  // A run come near the screen, laid out now (it isn't on the screen yet): its lines alone placed in the next frame,
  // not every line of the list again, as each frame of a scroll may bring one.
  const shownRuns = new Set();
  let runsFrame = 0;
  const placeRuns = () => {
    runsFrame = 0;
    const runs = Array.from(shownRuns).filter((run) => run.isConnected);
    shownRuns.clear();
    if (!paneWide || !paneWide.matches || playsFrame) return;  // every line is to be placed this frame anyway
    placeLines(runs.flatMap((run) => Array.from(run.querySelectorAll(PLACED))).filter(placeable));
  };
  list.addEventListener("contentvisibilityautostatechange", (e) => {
    if (e.skipped || !paneWide || !paneWide.matches) return;
    shownRuns.add(e.target);
    if (!runsFrame) runsFrame = requestAnimationFrame(placeRuns);
  }, true);
  if (pane) {
    pane.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key !== "Escape" || e.defaultPrevented || e.isComposing || !selected) return;
      const more = chevronOf(selected);
      if (!more) return;
      e.stopPropagation();  // the page's own Escape (the search's) hears nothing
      more.focus();
    });
  }
  if (paneWide) {
    paneWide.addEventListener("change", () => {
      placePlays();
      if (!paneWide.matches) {
        unselect({ keepOpen: true });
        return;
      }
      toWide();
    });
  }
  if (pane && "ResizeObserver" in window) {  // the list's width, or the text's size (its lines' height): placed again
    const main = libraryView.querySelector(".lib-main");
    let seen = "";
    if (main) {
      new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
        const now = entries[entries.length - 1].contentRect.width + " " +
          getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).fontSize;
        if (now === seen) return;
        seen = now;
        placePlaysSoon();
      }).observe(main);
    }
  }
  let wasSelecting = document.body.classList.contains("selecting");
  new MutationObserver(() => {  // Select on or off: a line's row has its box, and no chevron
    const now = document.body.classList.contains("selecting");
    if (now !== wasSelecting) {
      wasSelecting = now;
      placePlaysSoon();
    }
  }).observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
  document.addEventListener("caracole:tab", () => {  // the Library shown: its lines placed, an open card in the pane
    if (paneWide && paneWide.matches) toWide();
    placePlaysSoon();
  });
  // A song's card opened or closed (rows.js foldMore's ``onToggle``, ``e`` its click): from 1200 px in the pane;
  // under its line otherwise, where its head is watched while it is open and closing it brings its line back.
  const cardToggled = (open, card, chevron, e) => {
    const line = chevron && chevron.parentNode;
    if (!line) return;
    if (open && paneWide && paneWide.matches && line.isConnected) {
      selectLine(line, card, Boolean(e && e.isTrusted && e.detail === 0));
      return;
    }
    if (!open && line === selected) {
      unselect();
      return;
    }
    if (card.parentNode !== line) return;  // not in place
    if (open) {
      watchInPlace(card, chevron);
      return;
    }
    awayGone(chevron);
    if (line.isConnected) line.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: smooth() });
  };
  // A song's line: its title, then a button for each thing it holds to play from (card.js plays: its sheet, its Guitar
  // Pro file, its tab, its harmonica tab..., each opening it at once, none first), its status when it needs
  // something, its key, its main action (Fetch now's download icon, where it has one), how its request goes and its
  // removal's countdown; and its chevron, which its title opens too, whose card (``song-card``) cardFor makes the
  // first time it opens.
  const lineFor = (s) => {
    const id = Number(s.id);
    let chevron = null;  // its line's, once drawn
    const control = serverAction(s, canPick(s));
    const action = control.held ? control.action : null;
    const artists = listOf(s.artists);
    const keyed = typeof s.key === "string" && s.key;
    const status = statusOf(s);
    const line = resultRow({
      dense: true,
      title: shownName(s, s.title),
      plays: card.plays(s, { guitar: Boolean(server && server.guitar) }),  // a button each, right after the title
      artist: artists.length > 1 ? artists.join(", ") : shownName(s, s.artist),  // shown where no group names it
      status: s.status,
      key: keyed ? s.key : "",
      keyText: keyed ? keyText(s) : "",
      badges: status ? [status] : [],
      action,
      more: () => cardFor(s, chevron),
      onToggle: (open, card, e) => cardToggled(open, card, chevron, e),
      onSearch: () => searchFor(String(s.artist)),  // the name searches for them, served or from a file
    });
    chevron = line.querySelector(":scope > .line-more");
    line.dataset.id = String(s.id);  // the Select mode finds the song's line by it
    shownSongs.set(line, s);
    line.querySelector(":scope > .line-panel").classList.add("song-card");
    // Its title opens its card as its chevron does, a tap's convenience (the chevron is the keyboard's); never one of
    // its buttons, which open what they hold. The line it is in by then (refill moves it into the line drawn before).
    const named = line.querySelector(":scope > .line-title");
    named.classList.add("opens-card");
    named.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (e.target.closest("a, button")) return;
      const more = e.currentTarget.parentNode && e.currentTarget.parentNode.querySelector(":scope > .line-more");
      if (more) more.click();
    });
    if (s.status === "found") line.classList.add("have");  // set apart among a search's results (rows.css)
    // How the song's request goes, on a line of its own, and its lookup's steps under it.
    const job = server ? jobOfSong(id) : null;
    if (job) {
      showRequest(line, job);
    } else if (server && s.status === "wanted" && !removing.has(id) && busy.has(id)) {
      showLine(progressIn(line), { line: { tone: "running", text: "Fetching…" } });
    }
    if (removals.has(id)) countdownIn(line, removals.get(id));  // drawn again while its removal counts down
    return line;
  };
  const lines = new Map();  // song index -> its line, made the first time it shows
  const lineOf = (i) => {
    if (!lines.has(i)) lines.set(i, lineFor(songs[i]));
    return lines.get(i);
  };
  // An artist's group: a header that names them and counts the songs of theirs you have, "Soda Stereo · you have
  // 2" (``counts.mine``: all of them, whatever the search or a filter leaves out), and, while the served page searches
  // the sites, the songs each site's index lists of theirs, "· UG 96 · LaCuerda 140 · Guitar Pro 12" (``counts.ug``,
  // ``counts.lacuerda``, ``counts.gtptabs``: gtptabs.com's; ``counts.note``, any other words); then their lines. The
  // name searches for them, served or from a file (searchFor; not a group that names no artist, ``artist.search``
  // false: MuseScore's). An artist a search may have meant (``artist.meant``, a typo's "Did you mean") says so to a
  // screen reader, and their songs on the site that names them come first in the counts (``counts.theirs``: "7 songs
  // on UG"). Under the lines, the group's tail (``artist.tail``, tailOf's: "+ 57 more by Estopa"), if any.
  // An artist of one line and nothing else (no tail, no typo's, a group that names an artist) folds into it
  // (``folded``, library.css): no band, their name the line's overline, which searches for them; the heading stays, a
  // screen reader's alone, the name in it no button.
  let groupSerial = 0;
  const artistGroup = (artist, items, counts) => {
    const a = artist && typeof artist === "object" ? artist : { name: artist };
    const name = String(a.name || "");
    const c = counts && typeof counts === "object" ? counts : {};
    const mine = Number(c.mine) || 0;
    const tail = a.tail instanceof Node ? a.tail : null;
    const folds = listOf(items).length === 1 && !a.meant && !tail && a.search !== false;
    const section = el("section", a.meant ? "artist meant" : folds ? "artist folded" : "artist");
    section.dataset.artist = String(a.key || "");
    section.tabIndex = -1;  // the A-Z strip moves the focus to it
    const heading = el("h2", "artist-title");
    groupSerial += 1;
    heading.id = "artist-" + groupSerial;
    section.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", heading.id);
    if (a.meant) heading.appendChild(el("span", "visually-hidden", "Did you mean "));
    heading.appendChild(name && a.search !== false && !folds ? artistSearch(name, () => searchFor(name))
      : el("span", "artist-name", name));
    const said = [c.theirs ? String(c.theirs) : "", mine ? "yours " + mine : "",
      Number(c.ug) ? "UG " + Number(c.ug).toLocaleString("en") : "",
      Number(c.lacuerda) ? "LaCuerda " + Number(c.lacuerda).toLocaleString("en") : "",
      Number(c.gtptabs) ? "Guitar Pro " + Number(c.gtptabs).toLocaleString("en") : "",
      Number(c.harptabs) ? "Harmonica " + Number(c.harptabs).toLocaleString("en") : "", c.note ? String(c.note) : ""]
      .filter(Boolean);
    if (said.length) {
      // The counts on the band's right: the separator for a screen reader alone, what shows in a span of its own
      // (yours alone: its number, with "yours" said in the hidden part).
      const counts = el("span", "artist-counts");
      const onlyMine = mine && said.length === 1;
      counts.appendChild(el("span", "visually-hidden", onlyMine ? " · yours " : " · "));
      counts.appendChild(el("span", "", onlyMine ? String(mine) : said.join(" · ")));
      heading.appendChild(counts);
    }
    section.appendChild(heading);
    const box = el("div", "lines");
    for (const item of listOf(items)) box.appendChild(item);
    section.appendChild(box);
    if (tail) section.appendChild(tail);
    return section;
  };
  // For lists the page doesn't make itself (the served page's type-ahead): the same rows and marks.
  window.caracole = Object.freeze({ resultRow, sourceMark, icons: ICONS });

  // mode, tonic: the songs in a mode, on a tonic (its pitch class, "9" for A), or both, in one key.
  // inst: the songs that have something for any of these (INSTRUMENTS, comma-separated), in the panel's order.
  // all: the search of the sites under the bar: served, as you type (searchesAsYouType); on the file, the line that
  // searches them, on Enter.
  // prog: the songs that play a progression alone, by its key (#prog=, from under a song's chevron, a viewer's Harmony
  // panel or the served search).
  const state = { q: "", show: "all", sort: "artist", mode: "", tonic: "", inst: "", prog: "", all: false };
  // The name of the artist whose key (their sortArtist) is ``key``, as your songs write it; "" for none of yours.
  const artistName = (key) => {
    const s = key ? songs.find((song) => String(song.sortArtist || "") === key) : undefined;
    return s ? String(s.artist) : "";
  };
  // What the address says of the list (save() writes it): what the page opens on, and what Back brings again.
  const addressed = () => {
    const at = { q: "", show: "all", sort: "artist", mode: "", tonic: "", inst: "", prog: "", all: false };
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1));
      at.q = params.get("q") || "";
      if (own.call(SHOWS, params.get("show"))) at.show = params.get("show");
      if (SORTS.indexOf(params.get("sort")) >= 0) at.sort = params.get("sort");
      // key: an exact key, as the Key menu wrote it once, in any spelling the library has; else a mode, a tonic.
      const exact = keyId(params.get("key"));
      const tonicAt = keyId(params.get("tonic"));
      if (keyGroups.has(exact)) {
        [at.tonic, at.mode] = exact.split(" ");
      } else {
        if (MODES.indexOf(params.get("mode")) >= 0) at.mode = params.get("mode");
        if (tonicAt) at.tonic = tonicAt.split(" ")[0];
      }
      at.inst = instList(String(params.get("inst") || "").split(","));
      at.prog = progKeyOf(String(params.get("prog") || "").slice(0, 200));
      at.all = params.get("all") === "1" && sitesCan(at.q) && (!server || typedEnough(at.q));
      // by: an artist's name, as a sheet viewer's artist line links here (viewer/page.py artist_line); artist: an
      // artist's key (their sortArtist), as the one-artist view wrote it once (a bookmark, a link kept). Each is what
      // pressing their name here does, served or from a file and in the Android app's copy: the search for them
      // (searchFor's: their name in the box; served, the sites' indexes too, which asks no site). Read once: the page
      // then writes its own address for it (``cameBy``, below).
      const by = normal(params.get("by") || "");
      const named = artistName(params.get("artist") || "");
      if ((by || named) && !at.q && !at.prog) {
        at.q = by || named;
        at.all = searchesAsYouType(at.q);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // A malformed address: the defaults.
    }
    return at;
  };
  Object.assign(state, addressed());
  const tonicButtons = CIRCLE.map((pc) => {
    const b = el("button");
    b.type = "button";
    b.dataset.pc = String(pc);
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
    byId("tonics").appendChild(b);
    return b;
  });
  // The filters of the panel that are on, as Filter counts them: the status, each instrument, and the key.
  const instsChosen = () => (state.inst ? state.inst.split(",") : []);
  const keyChosen = () => Boolean(state.mode || state.tonic);
  const filtersOn = () => (state.show !== "all" ? 1 : 0) + instsChosen().length + (keyChosen() ? 1 : 0);
  // The key chosen in words: "A minor" (both), "a minor key" (the mode), "E major or minor" (the tonic).
  const keySaid = () => (state.mode && state.tonic ? keyNamed(Number(state.tonic), state.mode)
    : state.mode ? "a " + state.mode + " key" : tonicName(Number(state.tonic), "") + " major or minor");
  // The filters the songs list keeps to, the search aside: the panel's. Clear (the toolbar's), Clear all (the
  // panel's) and an empty list's Show all let every one go; the search stays.
  const filtered = () => filtersOn() > 0;
  const clearFilters = () => {
    state.show = "all";
    state.inst = "";
    state.mode = "";
    state.tonic = "";
  };
  // Them in words, for an empty list: "wanted songs with a harmonica tab in B minor", "songs needing review".
  const STATUS_SAID = { found: "found songs", wanted: "wanted songs" };
  const filtersSaid = () => {
    const words = [label(STATUS_SAID, state.show) || "songs"];
    if (state.inst) words.push("with " + instsChosen().map((x) => INST_SAID[x]).join(" or "));
    if (keyChosen()) words.push("in " + keySaid());
    if (state.show === "review") words.push("needs review");
    return words.join(" ");
  };
  const filterCount = byId("filter-count");
  const filterLive = byId("filter-live");
  const showN = byId("show-n");
  const glyphFor = caracoleRows({}).glyph;
  filterButton.prepend(glyphFor("sliders"));
  for (const c of instChips) c.prepend(glyphFor(c.dataset.inst));
  sort.before(glyphFor("sort"));
  const save = () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    let was = new URLSearchParams();
    try {
      was = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1));
    } catch (err) {
      // A malformed address: nothing of the Songbooks tab's to keep.
    }
    for (const name of ["tab", "book"]) if (was.get(name)) params.set(name, was.get(name));  // songbooks.js's
    if (state.q) params.set("q", state.q);
    if (state.show !== "all") params.set("show", state.show);
    if (state.sort !== "artist") params.set("sort", state.sort);
    // An exact key, as the address had it before (the library's commonest spelling); else its mode and its tonic.
    if (state.mode && state.tonic && keyGroups.has(state.tonic + " " + state.mode)) {
      params.set("key", keyGroups.get(state.tonic + " " + state.mode).value);
    } else {
      if (state.mode) params.set("mode", state.mode);
      if (state.tonic) params.set("tonic", tonicName(Number(state.tonic), state.mode));
    }
    if (state.inst) params.set("inst", state.inst);
    if (state.prog) params.set("prog", state.prog);
    if (state.all) params.set("all", "1");
    try {
      history.replaceState(history.state, "", "#" + params.toString());
    } catch (err) {
      // Some browsers refuse this for local files; the page works the same, it just isn't remembered.
    }
  };

  const plural = (n, word) => n + " " + word + (n === 1 ? "" : "s");
  const arrived = new Map();  // song id -> the data of a song new to the library since the page loaded
  // A song removed since the page loaded counts nowhere, though its line says Removed until the next load.
  const counted = (s) => s.status !== "removed";
  const narrow = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia("(max-width: 719px)") : null;  // a phone: the placeholder is short
  const summarize = () => {
    const by = { found: 0, wanted: 0, ignored: 0 };
    const every = songs.concat(Array.from(arrived.values())).filter(counted);
    for (const s of every) if (own.call(by, s.status)) by[s.status] += 1;
    const summary = byId("summary");
    summary.textContent = "";
    const stat = (n, word) => {
      const item = el("li", "stat");
      item.appendChild(el("b", null, n));
      item.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" " + word));
      summary.appendChild(item);
    };
    if (by.wanted) stat(by.wanted, "wanted");
    if (by.ignored) stat(by.ignored, "ignored");
    input.placeholder = server && !(narrow && narrow.matches) ? "Search songs and sites"
      : "Search " + plural(every.length, "song");
    const when = String(data.generated || "").replace("T", " ").slice(0, 16);
    if (when) byId("updated").textContent = "Updated by caracole " + when + " UTC. ";
  };
  if (narrow && narrow.addEventListener) narrow.addEventListener("change", () => summarize());
  const smooth = () => (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
    ? "auto" : "smooth");

  // How many of the songs the search and filters match each option of the panel would show; a line drawn again
  // changes it. matchingNow: the songs the search and the progression leave, the panel's filters aside.
  let matchingNow = [];
  let shownNow = [];
  // While the sites' results show (drawGroups): how many lines they show, yours and the sites' songs, and what the
  // sites' songs among them have something for, the Matches aside (each chip's count of them).
  let resultsShown = 0;
  let resultsHas = null;
  const keyFits = (i) => (!state.mode || modeOf(i) === state.mode) && (!state.tonic || pitchOf(i) === Number(state.tonic));
  const instFits = (i) => !state.inst || instsChosen().some((x) => instOf(songs[i]).has(x));
  // An option's count: the songs it would show chosen, the panel's other groups as they are.
  const tallyChips = () => {
    const tally = { all: 0, found: 0, wanted: 0, review: 0 };
    const having = { sheet: 0, guitar: 0, ukulele: 0, harmonica: 0, score: 0 };
    const onTonic = CIRCLE.map(() => 0);  // by pitch class: the songs on it in the mode chosen
    for (const i of matchingNow) {
      if (!counted(songs[i])) continue;
      const keyed = keyFits(i);
      const held = instFits(i);
      const shows = SHOWS[state.show](songs[i]);
      if (keyed && held) {
        tally.all += 1;
        for (const k of ["found", "wanted", "review"]) if (SHOWS[k](songs[i])) tally[k] += 1;
      }
      if (keyed && shows) for (const x of instOf(songs[i])) having[x] += 1;
      if (held && shows && pitchOf(i) >= 0 && (!state.mode || modeOf(i) === state.mode)) onTonic[pitchOf(i)] += 1;
    }
    // Searching the sites, a Matches chip counts the results' songs of the sites it would show too: they have no
    // status and no key the indexes know, which keep to your songs.
    const sitesToo = Boolean(server) && state.all && resultsHas;
    if (sitesToo) for (const x of INSTRUMENTS) having[x] += resultsHas[x];
    // The Key, there once a song has one: the mode chosen, then each tonic, dashed and not to be pressed where no song
    // is on it in that mode (one chosen can always be let go).
    byId("keys").hidden = keyGroups.size === 0 && !keyChosen();
    for (const b of modeButtons) {
      const on = b.dataset.mode === state.mode;
      b.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(on));
      b.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
    }
    for (const b of tonicButtons) {
      const pc = Number(b.dataset.pc);
      const on = state.tonic === b.dataset.pc;
      const n = onTonic[pc];
      b.textContent = tonicName(pc, state.mode);
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
      b.setAttribute("aria-label", b.textContent + (state.mode ? " " + state.mode : "") + ": " +
        (n ? plural(n, "song") : "no songs"));
      b.disabled = !on && n === 0;
    }
    // An instrument no song has here is greyed and can't be pressed, unless it is on: pressed again, it goes. The
    // group shows once a song has something but a chord sheet, and each line's glyph of one that is on is lit.
    const chosen = instsChosen();
    for (const c of instChips) {
      const on = chosen.indexOf(c.dataset.inst) >= 0;
      c.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
      c.querySelector(".n").textContent = String(having[c.dataset.inst]);
      c.disabled = !on && having[c.dataset.inst] === 0;
    }
    byId("f-insts").hidden = !chosen.length && !songs.some((s) => counted(s) &&
      Array.from(instOf(s)).some((x) => x !== "sheet")) && !(sitesToo && INSTRUMENTS.some((x) => x !== "sheet" &&
      resultsHas[x] > 0));
    libraryView.dataset.lit = chosen.join(" ");
    // Review, only while a song needs it (or while it is the one chosen).
    const reviewing = songs.some((s) => SHOWS.review(s)) || Array.from(arrived.values()).some((s) => SHOWS.review(s));
    for (const b of statusButtons) {
      const on = b.dataset.show === state.show;
      b.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(on));
      b.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
      b.querySelector(".n").textContent = String(tally[b.dataset.show]);
      b.hidden = b.dataset.show === "review" && !reviewing && !on;
    }
    // Filter says how many of its filters are on, in the accent.
    const on = filtersOn();
    filterButton.classList.toggle("on", on > 0);
    filterCount.hidden = !on;
    filterCount.textContent = on ? String(on) : "";
    filterButton.setAttribute("aria-label", on ? "Filter " + on : "Filter");
  };
  // How many songs the list shows, of how many; and in the panel, "4 songs", or on a phone "Show 4 songs": while the
  // sites' results show, how many songs they show, yours and the sites'.
  const tell = () => {
    const total = songs.filter(counted).length;
    const n = shownNow.filter((i) => counted(songs[i])).length;
    count.hidden = n === total;
    count.textContent = n === total ? "" : n + "/" + plural(total, "song");
    const shows = server && state.all ? resultsShown : n;
    filterLive.textContent = plural(shows, "song");
    showN.textContent = "Show " + plural(shows, "song");
  };

  // Search mode (body.search-mode): on as the box takes the focus, or while it holds a query (typed, the address's,
  // an artist's name pressed), with the ← at its left; a blur leaves it on. It ends with the ←, Back, or Escape in
  // the empty box, and nothing else: the box empty, the sites' results closed, the focus out of the box.
  // The browser's history, the page's: entering search from the empty box is a step of its own, an entry marked
  // { search: 1 }, and every entry any script pushes while searching counts one more (search: the count under it
  // + 1: an artist's name pressed, searchFor's; tabs.js's step out of the library), so the ← takes them all back at
  // once (history.go(-n)) and Back one at a time; each script's popstate acts on its own marker alone, and every
  // address written in place keeps the entry's state. A browser that refuses a step (a local file's, in some
  // browsers): search comes all the same, and the ← leaves it in place.
  let leaving = false;  // the ← asked the browser to take search's steps back: popstate ends the search
  const inSearch = () => document.body.classList.contains("search-mode");
  const searchSteps = () => Number(history.state && history.state.search) || 0;
  const searchMode = (on) => {
    if (on && !inSearch()) masthead.style.setProperty("--mast-h", masthead.getBoundingClientRect().height + "px");
    document.body.classList.toggle("search-mode", on);
    leave.hidden = !on;
  };
  // The box focused, out of search: search begins, from the empty box a step of the browser's history (none when
  // this entry is search's already: a reload of it, Forward to it). A box that holds a query is search already.
  const enterSearch = () => {
    if (inSearch()) return;
    if (!input.value && !searchSteps()) {
      try {
        history.pushState({ search: 1 }, "", location.href);  // the address as it is: save() writes it in place
      } catch (err) {
        // A browser that refuses the step: search all the same, the ← leaving it in place.
      }
    }
    searchMode(true);
  };
  // Out of search, here: the box empty (the sites' results with it), the focus out of it, the address written again.
  const leaveSearch = () => {
    setQuery("");
    input.blur();
    searchMode(false);
  };
  // The ←: every step search took taken back at once (popstate then ends it), else, with none (a query the page
  // opened with, a browser that refused them), out of it in place.
  const backFromSearch = () => {
    const steps = searchSteps();
    if (steps > 0) {
      leaving = true;
      try {
        history.go(-steps);
        return;
      } catch (err) {

      }
    }
    leaveSearch();
  };

  // A long list's groups and lines off the screen aren't laid out (``.cv``: content-visibility, library.css): each
  // band group of BIG_GROUP lines or fewer is one, a larger one's lines are in runs of RUN (``div.run``), each one;
  // folded artists in a row, and a flat list's lines, in runs of RUN too, the last of them RUN_MIN or more (a shorter
  // one goes with the run before it, which then holds up to RUN + RUN_MIN - 1), and a row shorter than RUN_MIN in
  // none. Each says what it holds, ``--bands``, ``--lines`` (under a band) and ``--folds`` (folded artists, or a flat
  // list's lines, drawn as theirs), which library.css's heights make its estimate of until it has been laid out once.
  const RUN = 40;
  const RUN_MIN = 8;
  const BIG_GROUP = 50;
  const unlaid = (node, holds) => {
    node.classList.add("cv");
    for (const [name, n] of Object.entries(holds)) node.style.setProperty("--" + name, String(n));
    return node;
  };
  // ``nodes`` (a row of them, in order) cut into runs, each holding ``kind``; too few, as they are.
  const runsOf = (nodes, kind) => {
    if (nodes.length < RUN_MIN) return nodes;
    const sizes = [];
    for (let at = 0; at < nodes.length; at += RUN) sizes.push(Math.min(RUN, nodes.length - at));
    if (sizes.length > 1 && sizes[sizes.length - 1] < RUN_MIN) sizes[sizes.length - 2] += sizes.pop();
    let at = 0;
    return sizes.map((size) => {
      const run = unlaid(el("div", "run"), { [kind]: size });
      run.append(...nodes.slice(at, at + size));
      at += size;
      return run;
    });
  };

  // A smooth scroll's end is set as it starts, the runs it passes as tall as their estimates: laid out on the way, they
  // make a long one land off its mark. Once it ends, the item is taken where it was to go, smoothly too (the runs about
  // it laid out by then, so that one lands); a scroll the reader takes over (a wheel, a touch, a key, a press) is
  // theirs. A jump that won't move the page (the item at the top already, or the page at its end) has no end to wait
  // for, and waits for none, so that no later scroll's end is taken for its; nor does one whose scroll never begins.
  const TAKEN_OVER = ["wheel", "touchstart", "keydown", "pointerdown"];
  const NEVER_BEGUN = 2000;  // ms
  let landing = null;  // the one a smooth scroll is on its way to
  const moves = (item) => {
    const margin = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(item).scrollMarginTop) || 0;
    const end = Math.max(0, document.scrollingElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight);
    const to = Math.min(Math.max(scrollY + item.getBoundingClientRect().top - margin, 0), end);
    return Math.abs(to - scrollY) >= 1;
  };
  const landsOn = (item) => {
    if (landing) landing.off();
    if (smooth() !== "smooth" || !("onscrollend" in window) || !moves(item)) return;
    let timer = 0;
    const begun = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      removeEventListener("scroll", begun);
    };
    const off = () => {
      begun();
      removeEventListener("scrollend", land);
      for (const name of TAKEN_OVER) removeEventListener(name, off, true);
      if (landing && landing.off === off) landing = null;
    };
    const land = () => {
      off();
      if (item.isConnected) item.scrollIntoView({ block: "start", behavior: smooth() });
    };
    landing = { off };
    timer = setTimeout(off, NEVER_BEGUN);
    addEventListener("scroll", begun, { passive: true });
    addEventListener("scrollend", land);
    for (const name of TAKEN_OVER) addEventListener(name, off, true);
  };

  const render = () => {
    const query = parseQuery(state.q);
    const fits = typedMatch(query);
    matchingNow = ORDERS[state.sort].filter((i) => (!state.prog || playsProg(songs[i], state.prog)) && fits(i));
    tallyChips();
    const matching = matchingNow.filter((i) => keyFits(i) && instFits(i));
    const shown = matching.filter((i) => SHOWS[state.show](songs[i]));
    sort.value = state.sort;
    clear.hidden = !state.q;
    if (state.q) searchMode(true);  // a query in the box is search, however it came
    drawTags();
    drawProg();
    // Searching the sites, served: the results take the list's place, its tools with it, until Escape.
    const searchingAll = Boolean(server) && state.all;
    document.body.classList.toggle("searching-all", searchingAll);
    drawBar(matching.length === 0, keyed(state.q));
    let answerInList = false;  // the file's line that searches the sites, in the list's empty state
    if (searchingAll) {
      drawResults(query, false);
      keepSelected();
      placePlays();
      return;
    }

    // By artist, a group of lines per artist, A to Z, each song's line under its artist's name. By title or by
    // when they came, the lines alone, each with its artist. The strip jumps to a letter's first group, or line.
    list.textContent = "";
    jump.textContent = "";
    const letterOf = LETTERS[state.sort];
    const firsts = new Map();
    const first = (letter, item) => {
      if (!firsts.has(letter)) firsts.set(letter, item);
    };
    if (state.sort === "artist") {
      const artists = [];  // ORDERS.artist has each artist's songs together
      for (const i of shown) {
        const key = String(songs[i].sortArtist || "");
        if (!artists.length || artists[artists.length - 1].key !== key) artists.push({ key, items: [] });
        artists[artists.length - 1].items.push(i);
      }
      // How many songs of each artist you have, the songs the search or a filter leaves out too.
      const yours = new Map();
      for (const s of songs.concat(Array.from(arrived.values())).filter(counted)) {
        const key = String(s.sortArtist || "");
        yours.set(key, (yours.get(key) || 0) + 1);
      }
      const groups = el("div", "groups");
      let folds = [];  // folded artists in a row, put in runs once the row ends
      const foldsEnd = () => {
        groups.append(...runsOf(folds, "folds"));
        folds = [];
      };
      for (const { key, items } of artists) {
        const head = songs[items[0]];
        const group = artistGroup({ key, name: String(shownName(head, head.artist)) }, items.map(lineOf),
          { mine: yours.get(key) || 0 });
        first(String(songs[items[0]].artistLetter || "#"), group);
        if (group.classList.contains("folded")) {
          folds.push(group);
          continue;
        }
        foldsEnd();
        if (items.length <= BIG_GROUP) {
          unlaid(group, { bands: 1, lines: items.length });
        } else {  // its band always laid out, its lines in runs
          const box = group.querySelector(":scope > .lines");
          box.replaceChildren(...runsOf(Array.from(box.children), "lines"));
        }
        groups.appendChild(group);
      }
      foldsEnd();
      if (artists.length) list.appendChild(groups);
    } else if (shown.length) {
      const flat = el("section", "flat");
      flat.appendChild(el("h2", "visually-hidden", state.sort === "title" ? "Songs by title"
        : "Newest first"));
      const box = el("div", "lines");
      box.append(...runsOf(shown.map((i) => {
        const line = lineOf(i);
        if (letterOf) first(String(songs[i][letterOf] || "#"), line);
        return line;
      }), "folds"));
      flat.appendChild(box);
      list.appendChild(flat);
    }
    for (const [letter, item] of firsts) {
      const to = el("button", null, letter);
      to.type = "button";
      to.setAttribute("aria-label", "Jump to " + letter);
      to.addEventListener("click", () => {
        landsOn(item);  // first: whether the page moves is read before it does
        item.scrollIntoView({ block: "start", behavior: smooth() });
        item.focus({ preventScroll: true });  // so the next Tab goes on from there
      });
      jump.appendChild(to);
    }
    jump.hidden = firsts.size < 2 || shown.length < JUMP_FROM;

    if (!songs.length) {
      list.appendChild(el("p", "empty", "No songs"));
      const hint = el("p", "empty-hint", "Add a line to wanted.txt, or run ");
      hint.appendChild(el("code", null, "caracole add ARTIST TITLE"));
