    // under the bar, which goes on saying how it goes; a song the list has says it on its own line. With
    // ``dropped``, only the lines a newer answer left out, at once.
    settleSpots = (dropped) => {
      for (const [id, node] of Array.from(spots)) {
        const left = !node.isConnected && node.classList.contains("hit");  // a newer answer has no such row
        if (dropped ? !left : !left && !results.contains(node)) continue;
        const view = views.get(id);
        const song = view ? songOf(view) : null;
        if (song !== null && byIndex.has(song)) {
          spots.delete(id);
          continue;
        }
        const [artist, ...title] = String((view && view.display) || "").split(" - ");
        const card = song !== null && arrived.has(song)
          ? (arrived.get(song).status === "removed" ? goneItem : lineFor)(arrived.get(song))
          : title.length ? placeholder(artist, title.join(" - ")) : placeholder("", artist);
        if (view) showRequest(card, view);
        requestedList.prepend(card);
        requested.hidden = false;
        spots.set(id, card);
      }
    };
    for (const view of listOf(server.jobs)) {
      if (!view || typeof view !== "object") continue;
      watched.add(Number(view.id));
      const song = songOf(view);
      if (view.kind === "songbook") {
        // A songbook's change: on its songbook, in the Songbooks tab (songbooks.js reads the page's jobs itself).
      } else if (requestedList && isActive(view) && view.kind === "song" && (song === null || !byIndex.has(song))) {
        // A song new to the library, on its way since before this page loaded: its line under the bar.
        const [artist, ...title] = String(view.display || "").split(" - ");
        const spot = title.length ? placeholder(artist, title.join(" - ")) : placeholder("", artist);
        requestedList.appendChild(spot);  // newest first, as they come
        requested.hidden = false;
        spots.set(Number(view.id), spot);
      }
      apply(view);
    }
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
      if (!document.hidden && timer) {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = 0;
        poll();
      }
    });
    if (tray) {  // folded, on every width: the lines say how each goes, and it would cover them
      trayToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const open = trayToggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true";
        trayToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
        trayList.hidden = !open;
        tray.classList.toggle("open", open);
      });
      byId("tray-close").addEventListener("click", () => {
        for (const [id, item] of trayItems) {
          if (!isActive(views.get(id) || {})) {
            item.remove();
            trayItems.delete(id);
          }
        }
        trayClosed = true;
        tray.hidden = true;
        document.body.classList.remove("with-tray");
      });
    }
    // The request form, under the results: a line for the song at once, under the bar, which says how its
    // request goes. It is filled in with the artist and the title the search's answer reads in what was searched
    // (``names``: song_names.py's reading, the server's, with the YouTube video suggested for it; the page splits no
    // text itself); else all of it the artist's name when an artist leads, else the title, never the query cut at a
    // space. Each field until you type into it yourself.
    const requestForm = document.querySelector("form.request-form");
    const typedInto = new Set();
    if (requestForm) {
      for (const name of ["artist", "title"]) {
        const field = requestForm.elements.namedItem(name);
        if (field) field.addEventListener("input", () => typedInto.add(name));
      }
      prefill = (lead, names) => {
        const q = normal(state.q);
        const read = names && typeof names === "object" && names.artist && names.title ? names : null;
        const values = read ? { artist: String(read.artist), title: String(read.title) }
          : lead === "artist" ? { artist: q, title: "" } : { artist: "", title: q };
        for (const name of ["artist", "title"]) {
          const field = requestForm.elements.namedItem(name);
          if (field && !typedInto.has(name)) field.value = values[name];
        }
      };
    }
    const refused = new Set();  // the lines of requests the server refused, gone at the next one
    // The line #requested shows already for the job's song (or, before the song is in the library, for the
    // same "Artist - Title"), if any: asked for again, it is the one that says how this request goes.
    const spotOf = (view) => {
      const song = songOf(view);
      for (const [id, card] of spots) {
        const was = views.get(id);
        if (!was || !card.isConnected || !requestedList.contains(card)) continue;
        const same = song !== null && songOf(was) !== null ? songOf(was) === song : was.display === view.display;
        if (same) return [id, card];
      }
      return null;
    };
    if (requestForm && requested) {
      requestForm.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        for (const card of refused) card.remove();
        refused.clear();
        const field = (name) => requestForm.elements.namedItem(name);
        const typed = (name) => String(field(name).value || "").trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
        let spot = placeholder(typed("artist"), typed("title"));
        requestedList.prepend(spot);
        requested.hidden = false;
        if (state.all) spot.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: smooth() });  // under the bar, in view
        const button = requestForm.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
        button.disabled = true;
        send(requestForm).then((answer) => {
          button.disabled = false;
          const view = answer.ok && answer.body && answer.body.job;
          if (!view) {
            showLine(progressIn(spot), failure(answer));
            refused.add(spot);
            return;
          }
          for (const name of ["artist", "title", "album", "duration", "youtube"]) {
            if (field(name)) field(name).value = "";  // a YouTube video's field only where a sheet can be made of one
          }
          typedInto.clear();
          const id = Number(view.id);
          const shown = spots.has(id) ? [id, spots.get(id)] : spotOf(view);
          if (shown) {  // asked for again: its line says how it goes, where it is, still in the page
            if (chevronOf(spot)) awayGone(chevronOf(spot));  // it leaves the page
            spot.remove();
            keepSelected();
            spot = shown[1];
            if (shown[0] !== id) spots.delete(shown[0]);
          } else {
            const i = songOf(view) === null ? undefined : byIndex.get(songOf(view));
            if (i !== undefined) spot = refill(spot, lineFor(songs[i]));  // a song the library has: its line
          }
          spots.set(id, spot);
          track(view);
        }, () => {
          button.disabled = false;
          showLine(progressIn(spot), UNREACHABLE);
          refused.add(spot);
        });
      });
    }
    schedule();
  }
  summarize();
  render();
  // Come from a sheet's artist line (#by=), or an address of the one-artist view's (#artist=): the address the page
  // writes for what it shows, in place of the link's, with no step of its own, so Back goes to the sheet and a reload
  // or a bookmark keeps the search.
  let cameBy = false;
  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1));
    cameBy = params.has("by") || params.has("artist");
  } catch (err) {
    // A malformed address: nothing to write again.
  }
  if (cameBy) save();
  // Back from a page of caracole serve's about a song (Remove's question): its line in view, and the focus
  // on it, as the A-Z strip leaves a group; the address keeps the rest. In the next frame, once every script
  // has drawn what it draws (the Songbooks tab, shown as it was left).
  function toSong() {
    let back = NaN;
    try {
      back = Number(new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1)).get("song"));
    } catch (err) {
      // A malformed address: nothing to show.
    }
    if (!back) return;
    const i = byIndex.get(back);
    const item = i === undefined ? null : lines.get(i);
    if (item && item.isConnected) {
      item.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
      item.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    save();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(toSong);
})();

        const chosen = ev.currentTarget.value;
        const fromShapes = takesCapo(chosen) && takesCapo(playsOn);
        if (!keyless) keySelect.value = String(keys[Number(fromShapes ? at.tonic : at.sounds)] || keySelect.value);
        capoSelect.value = fromShapes ? String(Number(at.capo) || 0) : "0";
        capoSelect.disabled = !takesCapo(chosen);
      });
    }
    const actions = el("div", "actions");
    const go = el("button", "btn small primary", "Play here");
    go.type = "submit";
    actions.appendChild(go);
    if (!e.own) {
      actions.appendChild(button("Its own version", "btn small as-own", () => {
        close();
        if (chip) chip.focus();
        change("/songbook/set", fields(bookName, { song: e.entry, clear: "1" }));
      }, "Play " + e.title + " in its own version here"));
    }
    actions.appendChild(button("Cancel", "btn small edit-cancel", () => {

    }));
    form.appendChild(actions);
    if (keyless) form.appendChild(el("p", "hint", "No key we can read in its sheet: capo only."));
    const close = () => {

      if (chip) chip.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    };
    form.addEventListener("submit", (ev) => {
      ev.preventDefault();

      if (body.get("instrument") === playsOn) body.delete("instrument");  // an instrument only once it changes
      close();
      if (chip) chip.focus();

  };

  // The forms of the songbook (Get the missing songs now, Rename, Delete) and the Select bar's Make songbook (or Add
  // to), once select.js has checked it: posted here, they leave you where you are; the Select bar's lands here.
  const FORM = /^\/songbook\/(make|add|get|rename|delete)$/;
  document.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
    const form = e.target;
    if (e.defaultPrevented || !(form instanceof HTMLFormElement) || !server) return;
    const action = form.getAttribute("action") || "";

    if (!bar && !panel.contains(form)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (bar) {
      fromSelect(form, action);
      return;
    }
    const body = fields(bookName, Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form).entries()));
    const renamed = /\/rename$/.test(action) ? bookName : null;
    if (renamed !== null) {  // its new name as caracole keeps it (songbook.check_name), at once

      for (const control of form.querySelectorAll("button")) enable(control);

      if (view && /\/delete$/.test(action)) lockBook(true);
    });
  });
  const fromSelect = (form, action) => {
    const name = String(form.elements.namedItem("name").value);
    const ids = String(form.elements.namedItem("songs").value).split(",").filter(Boolean).map(Number);
    postTo(action, new URLSearchParams(new FormData(form))).then((reply) => {
      const view = reply.ok && reply.body && reply.body.job;
      form.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("caracole:sent", {
        detail: { ok: Boolean(view && view.songbook), error: view ? "" : failure(reply) } }));
      if (!view || !view.songbook) return;
      const after = String(view.songbook.after || name);
      // One whose make failed, made again (under its name, or with the picks it gave back under another): off the
      // page, its article too; the one sent comes as new, its line where that one's was.
      const sent = ids.join(",");
      for (const [was, b] of Array.from(unmade)) {
        if (was !== after && !(sent && listOf(b.set).map((x) => Number(x && x.id)).join(",") === sent)) continue;
        const li = Array.from(lines.children).find((x) => x.dataset.book === was);
        if (li && !books().some((x) => x.name === after)) li.dataset.book = after;
        letGo(was);
      }
      // Until it is done, the songbook as it will be: its songs as the library names them, at its end.
      let b = books().find((x) => x.name === after);
      if (!b) {
        b = { name: after, songs: 0, missing: 0, files: [], set: [], pending: true };
        shelf = Object.assign({}, shelf, { books: books().concat([b]) });
      }
      const set = listOf(b.set).slice();
      for (const id of ids) {
        const s = songs.find((x) => Number(x.id) === id);
        if (!s || set.some((x) => Number(x.id) === id)) continue;
        set.push({ n: set.length + 1, entry: String(s.display), key: String(s.identity || ""), title: s.title,
                   artist: s.artist, id, pending: true });
      }
      Object.assign(b, { set, songs: set.length });
      showTab("songbooks");
      openBook(after, true);
      follow(view);
    }, () => form.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("caracole:sent", { detail: { ok: false, error: UNREACHABLE } })));
  };

  // --- moving a song: a drag on its grip, or ↑ and ↓ ------------------------------------------------------------
  // A drag moves the line with the pointer, and the lines it passes make room, as transforms (nothing on the page
  // is laid out again until you let go); let go, the line takes its place and its move is sent. ↑ and ↓ move it at
  // once, and the move is sent a moment after the last key, so that ↑ ↑ ↑ is one move.
  const places = () => Array.from(book.querySelectorAll(".set > .set-line:not(.gone)"));
  // Until the server has it, the set list isn't drawn again either: an older change's songbooks would put the line
  // back where it was, for a moment. Refused, it is drawn as the songbook is.
  const sendMove = (li, from) => {
    const to = places().indexOf(li);
    if (to < 0 || to === from) return;
    moving += 1;
    change("/songbook/move", fields(bookName, { song: li.dataset.entry, position: to + 1 })).then((view) => {
      moving -= 1;
      if (!view) draw();
    });
  };
  const smooth = !(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches);
  panel.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    const grip = e.target instanceof Element ? e.target.closest(".grip") : null;
    if (!grip || grip.disabled || e.button !== 0 || !book) return;
    const li = grip.closest(".set-line");
    e.preventDefault();
    grip.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    grip.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    const others = places();
    const from = others.indexOf(li);
    const boxes = others.map((x) => x.getBoundingClientRect());
    const tall = boxes[from].height;
    const middles = boxes.map((r) => r.top + r.height / 2);
    const startY = e.clientY;
    let to = from;
    moving += 1;
    li.classList.add("dragging");
    const move = (ev) => {
      const dy = ev.clientY - startY;
      li.style.transform = "translateY(" + dy + "px)";
      const centre = middles[from] + dy;
      to = from;
      while (to < others.length - 1 && centre > middles[to + 1]) to += 1;
      while (to > 0 && centre < middles[to - 1]) to -= 1;
      others.forEach((x, i) => {
        if (x === li) return;
        const shift = i > from && i <= to ? -tall : i < from && i >= to ? tall : 0;
        x.style.transform = shift ? "translateY(" + shift + "px)" : "";

      });
    };
    // pointerup drops the line where it is; pointercancel (the browser taking the gesture) puts it back and sends nothing.
    const finish = (cancelled) => {
      grip.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
      grip.removeEventListener("pointerup", end);
      grip.removeEventListener("pointercancel", cancel);
      if (cancelled) to = from;
      for (const x of others) {
        x.style.transform = "";
        x.classList.remove("making-room");
      }
      li.classList.remove("dragging");
      if (to !== from) {
        const list = li.parentNode;
        const anchor = others[to];
        list.insertBefore(li, to > from ? anchor.nextSibling : anchor);
        renumber();
        said.textContent = (li.querySelector("h3") || {}).textContent + ": " + (to + 1) + " of " + others.length;
      }

    if (!grip || (e.key !== "ArrowUp" && e.key !== "ArrowDown") || !book) return;
    e.preventDefault();

    const at = all.indexOf(li);
    const to = e.key === "ArrowUp" ? at - 1 : at + 1;
    if (at < 0 || to < 0 || to >= all.length) return;

    clearTimeout(pending.timer);
    li.parentNode.insertBefore(li, e.key === "ArrowUp" ? all[to] : all[to].nextSibling);
    grip.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    renumber();
    said.textContent = (li.querySelector("h3") || {}).textContent + ": " + (to + 1) + " of " + all.length;
    pending.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      keyMoves.delete(li);
      moving -= 1;
      sendMove(li, pending.from);
    }, 700);
    keyMoves.set(li, pending);
  });

  // --- Add a song: your songs and the indexes', as you type -------------------------------------------------------
  const fold = lib ? lib.fold : (text) => String(text).toLowerCase();  // the library's search's, as it reads songs
  const words = (text) => fold(text).split(/\s+/).map((w) => w.replace(/['’‘`´ʼ]/g, "")
    .replace(/^[^\p{L}\p{N}]+|[^\p{L}\p{N}]+$/gu, "")).filter(Boolean);
  const HAN = /\p{Script=Han}/u;
  const enough = (text) => (String(text).match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]/gu) || []).length >= (HAN.test(text) ? 2 : 3);
  const SEARCH_PAUSE = 250;
  // Add a song's id, sent with each search: one typed on stops this box's older ones alone (web/search_routes.py).
  const SEARCH_BOX = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 12) || "songbook";
  function addSong() {
    const box = el("div", "add-song");
    const label = el("label", "add-label", "Add a song");
    const field = el("div", "field");
    const input = el("input");
    input.type = "search";
    input.id = "add-q";
    label.htmlFor = input.id;
    input.placeholder = "Your songs, or any the indexes have";
    input.autocomplete = "off";
    input.setAttribute("autocapitalize", "off");
    input.setAttribute("autocorrect", "off");
    input.spellcheck = false;
    input.setAttribute("enterkeyhint", "search");
    field.appendChild(input);

    note.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
    const found = el("div", "lines add-results");
    found.hidden = true;

    let asking = null;
    let asked = 0;
    let answer = null;  // the newest answer of the server's, for its query
    let failedFor = null;  // the query whose search failed (refused, not JSON, no answer): the note says so
    const inBook = (key, id) => {
      const b = books().find((x) => x.name === bookName);
      return listOf(b && b.set).some((x) => x && ((id !== null && id !== undefined && Number(x.id) === Number(id)) ||
        (key && String(x.key) === key)));
    };
    const line = (hit) => {
      const has = inBook(hit.key, hit.id);
      const go = button(has ? "In it" : "Add", "btn small" + (has ? "" : " primary"), null,
        has ? hit.title + " is in " + bookName + " already" : "Add " + hit.title + " by " + hit.artist + " to " + bookName);
      go.disabled = has;
      const row = rows ? rows.resultRow({ dense: true, title: hit.title, artist: hit.artist, sources: hit.sources,
        facts: hit.facts, badges: hit.id !== null && hit.id !== undefined ? [{ kind: "found", text: "Yours" }] : [],
        action: go }) : el("article", "line", hit.title);
      go.addEventListener("click", () => add(hit, row, go));
      return row;
    };
    const show = (q) => {
      const typed = words(q);
      const hits = [];
      const seen = new Set();
      const push = (hit) => {
        const key = hit.id !== null && hit.id !== undefined ? "id:" + hit.id : "key:" + hit.key;
        if (seen.has(key) || (hit.key && seen.has("key:" + hit.key))) return;
        seen.add(key);
        if (hit.key) seen.add("key:" + hit.key);
        hits.push(hit);
      };
      if (typed.length) {  // yours, as the library's own search reads them
        for (const s of songs) {
          if (s.status === "removed" || !typed.every((w) => String(s.search || "").indexOf(w) >= 0)) continue;
          push({ id: s.id, key: String(s.identity || ""), identity: String(s.identity || ""), title: s.title,
                 artist: s.artist, sources: [s.source] });
          if (hits.length >= 5) break;
        }
      }
      const a = answer && answer.q === q ? answer.data : null;
      if (a) {
        for (const s of listOf(a.library)) {
          if (s && typeof s === "object") push({ id: s.id, key: "", title: s.title, artist: s.artist, sources: [s.source] });
        }
        const keyOf = (r) => String(r.artist_key || "") + "/" + String(r.title_key || "");
        for (const r of listOf(a.index)) {
          if (!r || typeof r !== "object") continue;
          const mine = r.library && typeof r.library === "object" ? r.library : null;
          push(mine ? { id: mine.id, key: keyOf(r), title: mine.title, artist: mine.artist, sources: ["ug"] }
            : { key: keyOf(r), title: r.title, artist: r.artist, sources: ["ug"], pick: { ug: r.ug },
                facts: Object.entries(r.counts && typeof r.counts === "object" ? r.counts : {})
                  .map(([k, n]) => k + " ×" + n).join(" · ") });
        }
        for (const [site, rows_] of [["lacuerda", a.lacuerda], ["gtptabs", a.gtptabs]]) {
          for (const r of listOf(rows_)) {
            if (!r || typeof r !== "object") continue;
            const mine = r.library && typeof r.library === "object" ? r.library : null;
            const chords = site === "lacuerda" && /^https:[/][/]/i.test(String(r.sheet || "")) &&
              /^https:[/][/]/i.test(String(r.url || ""));
            push(mine ? { id: mine.id, key: keyOf(r), title: mine.title, artist: mine.artist, sources: [site] }
              : { key: keyOf(r), title: r.title, artist: r.artist, sources: [site],
                  pick: chords ? { lacuerda: r.url } : {} });
          }
        }
      }
      found.replaceChildren(...hits.slice(0, 8).map(line));
      found.hidden = !hits.length;
      note.textContent = !q.trim() ? "" : hits.length ? ""
        : server && enough(q) && !a ? (failedFor === q ? "No answer from the search. Type on to ask again."
          : "Searching your songs and the indexes…") : "Nothing found yet.";
    };
    const ask = (q) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (asking) asking.abort();
      asked += 1;
      const mine = asked;
      if (!enough(q)) return;
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        asking = new AbortController();
        fetch("api/search?q=" + encodeURIComponent(q.trim()) + "&box=" + SEARCH_BOX, {
          signal: asking.signal, cache: "no-store", headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
        }).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json().catch(() => null) : null)).then((body) => {
          if (mine !== asked) return;
          if (!body || typeof body !== "object") {  // refused, or not JSON (a proxy's page): said, never left waiting
            failedFor = q;
            show(q);
            return;
          }
          if (body.superseded) {
            ask(q);
            return;
          }
          answer = { q, data: body };
          show(q);
        }, () => {
          if (mine !== asked) return;  // aborted for a newer one
          failedFor = q;
          show(q);
        });

      show(input.value);

    });

      if (e.key === "/") e.stopPropagation();  // a title may hold one: the library's own key is for its search

    });
    // A song added: at once a line of its own at the set list's end, which its lookup and the songbook's change say
    // how they go on; the set list draws it again as the songbook has it once it is done.
    const add = (hit, row, go) => {
      go.disabled = true;
      const list = book.querySelector(".set");
      const entry = { n: places().length + 1, entry: hit.artist + " - " + hit.title, key: hit.key, title: hit.title,
                      artist: hit.artist, id: hit.id, pending: true };
      const spot = setLine(entry, entry.n, false);
      showLine(lineIn(spot), { line: { tone: "queued", text: "Sending…" } });  // its height, from the tap
      list.appendChild(spot);

      const pick = hit.id !== null && hit.id !== undefined ? { song: hit.id, identity: hit.identity }
        : Object.assign({ artist: hit.artist, title: hit.title }, hit.pick || {});
      change("/songbook/add-song", fields(bookName, pick), row, (lookup) => placed.set(Number(lookup.id), spot))
        .then((view) => {
          if (!view) {
            spot.remove();
            renumber();
            go.disabled = false;
            return;
          }
          placed.set(Number(view.id), spot);
          go.textContent = "In it";
        });
    };
    return box;
  }

  // --- the jobs on their way when the page loaded, and the first drawing --------------------------------------------
  for (const view of listOf(server && server.jobs)) {
    if (!view || typeof view !== "object") continue;
    if (view.kind === "songbook") {
      changes.set(Number(view.id), view);
      for (const n of namesOf(view)) if (n) newest.set(n, view);
    } else if (view.kind === "song" && view.songId !== null && view.songId !== undefined) {
      songViews.set(Number(view.songId), view);
    }
  }
  if (wide.addEventListener) wide.addEventListener("change", draw);
  draw();
  save();
})();
// The Sites tab (sites.py gives its data, the page's "sites"): each website caracole reads, a line a site. A line says
// what its index holds, what your library keeps from it, the last nightly run's requests and its status; pressed, it
// opens under itself to robots.txt in words (the closed paths worth naming, each with what it closes), the site's
// terms, how far its index has got, caracole's pace and its last request. Drawn once, from the page's data alone: in
// the file read from disk as when served, it asks nothing of anyone. Every text is put in with textContent.
(() => {
  "use strict";
  const byId = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const panel = byId("sites");
  if (!panel) return;
  let data;
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(byId("songs").textContent);
  } catch (err) {
    return;
  }
  const sites = data && data.sites && typeof data.sites === "object" ? data.sites : null;
  if (!sites) return;
  const listOf = (value) => (Array.isArray(value) ? value : []);
  const kit = typeof caracoleRows === "function" ? caracoleRows(data.icons && typeof data.icons === "object"
    ? data.icons : {}) : null;
  const el = (tag, cls, text) => {
    const node = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) node.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined && text !== null) node.textContent = String(text);
    return node;
  };
  const number = (n) => Number(n || 0).toLocaleString("en-US");
  // A big count in a pill: 1.92 M, 642k.
  const short = (n) => {
    const v = Number(n || 0);
    if (v >= 1e6) return (v / 1e6).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") + " M";
    return v >= 1e4 ? Math.round(v / 1e3) + "k" : number(v);
  };
  const share = (part, whole) => (whole ? Math.round((100 * part) / whole) : 0);
  // "<b>1,284</b> words": a figure and its unit.
  const figure = (parent, n, unit) => {
    parent.append(el("b", "", number(n)), " " + String(unit || ""));
    return parent;
  };
  const meter = (done, of, cls, label) => {
    const bar = el("span", "meter" + (cls ? " " + cls : ""));
    bar.setAttribute("role", "img");
    bar.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
    bar.title = label;
    const fill = el("span");
    fill.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(done ? 2 : 0, share(done, of))) + "%";
    bar.append(fill);
    return bar;
  };
  const pill = (parent, parts) => {
    const p = el("span", "stat");
    for (const part of parts) p.append(typeof part === "string" ? part : el("b", "", part.b));
    parent.append(p);
  };

  const head = el("div", "sites-head");
  head.append(el("h2", "", "Sites"));
  const totals = sites.totals || {};
  pill(head, [{ b: number(totals.sites) }, " sites"]);
  pill(head, [{ b: short(totals.indexed) }, " songs indexed"]);
  pill(head, [{ b: number(totals.kept) }, " kept from them"]);
  const run = sites.run;
  if (run && run.started) {
    pill(head, run.finished ? ["Last run ", { b: run.started + " – " + run.finished }, " · ", { b: number(run.requests) },
      " requests"] : ["Running since ", { b: run.started }, " · ", { b: number(run.requests) }, " requests so far"]);
  } else {
    pill(head, ["No run yet"]);
  }

  const ledger = el("div", "ledger");
  const columns = el("div", "site-row head");
  columns.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  for (const name of ["Site", "Indexed", "In your logbook", "Last run", "Status", ""]) columns.append(el("span", "", name));
  ledger.append(columns);

  const indexedCell = (s, cls) => {
    const cell = el("span", cls);
    if (s.indexed) {
      figure(cell, s.indexed.songs, s.indexed.unit);
      if (s.progress) {
        cell.append(meter(s.progress.done, s.progress.of, "index",
          number(s.progress.done) + " of " + number(s.progress.of) + " " + s.progress.what));
      }
    } else {
      cell.append(el("span", "none", s.asked || "—"));
    }
    return cell;
  };
  const keptCell = (s, cls) => {
    const cell = el("span", cls);
    const kept = s.kept || {};
    figure(cell, kept.count, kept.unit);
    cell.append(el("small", "", share(kept.songs, sites.songs) + "% of your songs"));
    return cell;
  };
  const nightCell = (s, cls) => {

// The sync's words (sync.js reads them, on the computer's page and the phone's alike): how two versions of a unit
// differ, each change, each side's name, the numbers and the dates, exactly as the sheet draws them
// (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-03-sync-redesign.md §3.7). It builds no element and asks nothing of anyone: every
// answer is text, which sync.js puts in with textContent.
//
// ``differ(kind, here, there)``: a unit's two documents (GET /api/sync/unit's ``here`` and ``there``, each
// peer_sync.unit_document's ``unit``, or null where a side hasn't got it), told apart aspect by aspect, a line each
// that the two hold differently: ``{what, here, there}``, each value text, "–" for none. A song's own key (its
// ``[version]``), its sheet (the version of the lowest pick rank, its site named as the page's ``icons`` name it), its
// versions, its kept files, its lyrics, its status, its album, length and variant, and any other override; a
// songbook's set list, the songs one has and the other lacks, its order and a song's setting; a removal, an artist's
// slugs or UG page, a blocked tab, by their values. ``changed(change, side)``: "added on the phone".
// ``sides(device, peer)``: this device's and the other side's names, as headings, as places and in sentences, and
// their icons. ``tabs(n, signed)``: 1,503,236 and +12,130 (a minus sign for a fall), digits grouped by hand, no locale.
// ``day(stamp)`` and ``when(stamp)``: dd/mm/yy and dd/mm/yy, HH:MM, in this device's time.
(() => {
  "use strict";
  const NONE = "–";
  const MINUS = "−";
  const own = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty;
  const listOf = (v) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v : []);
  const objOf = (v) => (v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v) ? v : null);
  const text = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined ? "" : String(v));
  const same = (a, b) => JSON.stringify(a === undefined ? null : a) === JSON.stringify(b === undefined ? null : b);

  // --- numbers --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const grouped = (n) => {
    const digits = String(Math.round(Math.abs(Number(n) || 0)));
    let out = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < digits.length; i += 1) {
      if (i && (digits.length - i) % 3 === 0) out += ",";
      out += digits[i];
    }
    return out;
  };
  // A count of tabs: as it is (1,503,236), or ``signed``, a change (+12,130, −210, 0).
  const tabs = (n, signed) => {
    const v = Math.round(Number(n) || 0);
    if (signed) return (v > 0 ? "+" : v < 0 ? MINUS : "") + grouped(v);
    return (v < 0 ? MINUS : "") + grouped(v);
  };
  // "1 song", "12 songs", "1,204 songs".
  const counted = (n, word, many) => {
    const v = Math.round(Number(n) || 0);
    return (v < 0 ? MINUS : "") + grouped(v) + " " + (v === 1 ? word : many || word + "s");
  };
  // A size in bytes, as a person reads it: 0.4 MB, 3.4 MB, 207 MB, 1.2 GB (a megabyte a million bytes).
  const size = (bytes) => {

    const mb = b / 1e6;
    if (mb >= 999.5) return (mb / 1000).toFixed(1) + " GB";
    if (mb >= 9.95) return grouped(mb) + " MB";

  };

  // --- dates, in this device's time -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  const dateOf = (stamp) => {
    if (typeof stamp !== "string" || !stamp) return null;
    const at = new Date(stamp);

  };
  const day = (stamp) => {

  };

  // --- the two sides --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const side = (icon, name, on, the, short) => Object.freeze({ icon, name, on, the, whose: the + "'s", short });
  const sides = (device, peer) => {

      : side("tower", "This computer", "On this computer", "this computer", "this computer's");
    let there;
    if (p.kind === "file") {
      there = side("file", "File", "In the file", "the file", "file's");
    } else if (p.kind === "computer" || device === "phone") {
      there = side("tower", "Computer", "On the computer", "the computer", "computer's");
    } else {  // another caracole serve, by its library's name
      const name = text(p.name).trim() || text(p.address).trim() || "the other caracole";
      there = side("rack", name, "On " + name, name, name + "'s");

  };
  const CHANGED = { new: "added", changed: "changed", gone: "removed" };
  // What a side did to a unit since the two last agreed (peer_sync.change_of's), on that side.
  const changed = (change, where) => {

  // --- a song's own key, as overrides.toml's [version] keeps it --------------------------------------------------
  const ACCIDENTAL = { "#": "♯", b: "♭", "♯": "♯", "♭": "♭", "": "" };
  // The instrument a version is played on (``inst=``, none for the guitar), as a version's name says it

  const INSTRUMENTS = { ukulele: "ukulele", "ukulele-low-g": "low-G ukulele", baritone: "baritone ukulele",
                        piano: "piano", harmonica: "harmonica", flute: "flute", recorder: "recorder" };
  const keyName = (key) => {
    const m = /^([A-Ga-g])([#b♯♭]?)(m?)$/.exec(key);
    return m ? m[1].toUpperCase() + ACCIDENTAL[m[2]] + (m[3] ? " minor" : " major") : key;

    try {
      fields = new URLSearchParams(entry.replace(/^#/, ""));

    const key = fields.get("key");
    const t = fields.get("t");

    if (key) {
      said.push(keyName(key) + (mode ? " (" + mode + ")" : ""));

    if (fields.get("alt")) said.push("some chords swapped");
    if (fields.get("at")) said.push("its own shapes");
    const inst = fields.get("inst");
    if (inst && inst !== "guitar") said.push("on the " + (own.call(INSTRUMENTS, inst) ? INSTRUMENTS[inst] : inst));
    return said.join(", ");

  let titles = null;  // each site's name, as the page's data has it (icons.py's): read once
  const titleOf = (provider) => {

      try {
        const node = document.getElementById("songs");
        const icons = node ? objOf(JSON.parse(node.textContent).icons) : null;
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(icons || {})) {
          if (objOf(value) && typeof value.name === "string") titles[key] = value.name;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        titles = {};
      }
    }
    return own.call(titles, provider) ? titles[provider] : text(provider);
  };
  const versionsOf = (doc) => listOf(doc.versions).filter((v) => objOf(v));
  const sheetOf = (doc) => {
    const ranked = versionsOf(doc).filter((v) => typeof v.pick_rank === "number")
      .sort((a, b) => a.pick_rank - b.pick_rank);
    return ranked.length ? titleOf(ranked[0].provider) + " · tab " + text(ranked[0].tab_id) : NONE;
  };
  const filesOf = (doc) => {
    const names = new Set();
    for (const v of versionsOf(doc)) {
      for (const f of listOf(v.files)) if (objOf(f) && typeof f.name === "string") names.add(f.name);
    }
    return Array.from(names).sort();
  };
  const length = (ms) => {
    const n = Number(ms);
    if (ms === null || ms === undefined || !Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) return NONE;
    const s = Math.round(n / 1000);
    return Math.floor(s / 60) + ":" + pad(s % 60);
  };
  const worded = (v) => text(v).replace(/_/g, " ") || NONE;
  const overrideOf = (value) => {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return NONE;
    if (typeof value === "string") return value || "set";

  };
  const songAspects = (doc) => {
    const song = objOf(doc.song) || {};
    const names = objOf(doc.names) || {};

    const files = filesOf(doc);
    const aspects = [
      ["Its own key", ownKey(overrides.version), overrides.version || null],
      ["Its sheet", sheetOf(doc)],
      ["Its versions", String(versionsOf(doc).length)],
      ["Its kept files", files.length ? files.join(", ") : NONE],
      ["Its lyrics", worded(song.lyrics_status)],
      ["Its status", worded(song.status) + (song.review ? ", in review" : "")],
      ["Its album", text(names.album) || NONE],
      ["Its length", length(names.duration_ms)],
      ["Its variant", text(names.variant) || NONE],
    ];

  };
  const songLines = (here, there) => {
    const a = songAspects(here);
    const b = songAspects(there);
    const lines = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < a.aspects.length; i += 1) {
      const [what, mine, mineKey] = a.aspects[i];
      const [, theirs, theirsKey] = b.aspects[i];
      const differs = mineKey !== undefined || theirsKey !== undefined ? !same(mineKey, theirsKey) : mine !== theirs;
      if (differs) lines.push({ what, here: mine, there: theirs });

      .filter((t) => t !== "version").sort();
    for (const table of tables) {
      if (!same(a.overrides[table], b.overrides[table])) {
        lines.push({ what: "An override: [" + table + "]", here: overrideOf(a.overrides[table]),
                     there: overrideOf(b.overrides[table]) });
      }
    }
    return lines;
  };

  // --- a songbook --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const entriesOf = (doc) => listOf(doc && doc.songs).filter((e) => Array.isArray(e) && typeof e[0] === "string")
    .map((e) => ({ text: e[0], parts: objOf(e[1]) || {} }));

    const said = [];
    if (parts.key !== undefined && parts.key !== null) said.push(text(parts.key) + (parts.mode ? " " + parts.mode : ""));
    else if (parts.mode) said.push(text(parts.mode));

    if (parts.instrument) said.push("on the " + text(parts.instrument));

  // setting changed (the entries of both, by their text).
  const setLists = (from, to) => {
    const a = entriesOf(from);
    const b = entriesOf(to);
    const inA = new Map(a.map((e) => [e.text, e]));
    const inB = new Map(b.map((e) => [e.text, e]));
    const onlyA = a.filter((e) => !inB.has(e.text)).map((e) => e.text);
    const onlyB = b.filter((e) => !inA.has(e.text)).map((e) => e.text);
    const bothA = a.filter((e) => inB.has(e.text)).map((e) => e.text);
    const bothB = b.filter((e) => inA.has(e.text)).map((e) => e.text);
    const settings = bothA.filter((t) => !same(inA.get(t).parts, inB.get(t).parts));
    return { a, b, inA, inB, onlyA, onlyB, bothA, bothB, settings, reordered: !same(bothA, bothB) };
  };
  const bookLines = (here, there) => {
    const s = setLists(here, there);
    const lines = [];
    if (text(here.name) !== text(there.name)) {
      lines.push({ what: "Its name", here: text(here.name) || NONE, there: text(there.name) || NONE });
    }
    if (s.a.length !== s.b.length) {
      lines.push({ what: "Its set list", here: counted(s.a.length, "song"), there: counted(s.b.length, "song") });
    }
    if (s.onlyA.length || s.onlyB.length) {
      lines.push({ what: "Songs added", here: joined(s.onlyA), there: joined(s.onlyB) });
    }

    if (s.settings.length) {
      const said = (map) => s.settings.map((t) => t + ": " + settingOf(map.get(t).parts)).join("; ");
      lines.push({ what: "A song's setting", here: said(s.inA), there: said(s.inB) });
    }
    return lines;
  };
  // A songbook taken or given, in a word: what the side it went to has now that it hadn't (``from`` its document
  // before, null for a new one; ``to`` the one it has now).
  const bookChange = (from, to) => {
    if (!objOf(to)) return "removed";
    if (!objOf(from)) return counted(entriesOf(to).length, "song");
    const s = setLists(from, to);
    const said = [];
    if (s.onlyB.length) said.push(counted(s.onlyB.length, "song") + " added");
    if (s.onlyA.length) said.push(counted(s.onlyA.length, "song") + " taken out");
    if (s.reordered) said.push("its order changed");
    if (s.settings.length) said.push(s.settings.length === 1 ? "a song's setting changed"
      : s.settings.length + " songs' settings changed");
    if (text(from.name) !== text(to.name)) said.push("its name changed");
    return said.join(", ") || "changed";
  };

  // --- any unit --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const valueOf = {
    alias: (doc) => joined(listOf(doc.slugs).map(text)),
    artist_url: (doc) => text(doc.page) || NONE,
    block: (doc) => (doc.tab === undefined || doc.tab === null ? NONE : "tab " + text(doc.tab)),
  };
  const WHAT = { alias: "Its slugs", artist_url: "Its UG page", block: "Blocked" };
  const differ = (kind, here, there) => {
    const a = objOf(here);
    const b = objOf(there);
    if (!a && !b) return [];
    let lines;
    if (kind === "removed") {
      lines = a && b ? [] : [{ what: "Removed", here: a ? "Removed" : "Kept", there: b ? "Removed" : "Kept" }];
    } else if (own.call(valueOf, kind)) {
      const mine = a ? valueOf[kind](a) : NONE;
      const theirs = b ? valueOf[kind](b) : NONE;
      lines = mine === theirs ? [] : [{ what: WHAT[kind], here: mine, there: theirs }];
    } else if (!a || !b) {
      const held = (doc) => (!doc ? NONE : kind === "songbook" ? counted(entriesOf(doc).length, "song") : "Kept");
      lines = [{ what: kind === "songbook" ? "The songbook" : "The song", here: held(a), there: held(b) }];
    } else {
      lines = kind === "song" ? songLines(a, b) : kind === "songbook" ? bookLines(a, b) : [];
    }
    // Two versions that differ only where no line above looks (a version's rating, a record's time): said so.
    return lines.length || same(a, b) ? lines : [{ what: "Its other details", here: "one way", there: "another way" }];
  };

})();
// The sync with another caracole, one flow on both devices (sync-sheet.html, the sheet; on caracole serve's page also

// and what it did; and a library exported to a file, or a file imported and synced with as if its caracole were here.
// Its words are sync-words.js's (window.caracoleSyncWords); it asks the routes both servers answer alike
